tei:div.tei:p: spyi khyab bsdu sgrig 'gan 'khur ba gtso bo/ gzan dkar thub bstan nyi ma/bsdu sgrig 'gan 'khur gzhon pa dang / gtso sgrig pa/ rkarma bde legs/gtso sgrig gzhon pa/ 'gro 'dul rdo rje/bsdu sgrig pa/ mun sel/ thub bstan nyi ma/ bstan 'dzin blo gros/zla ba bstan 'dzin/ shes rab bzang po/zhu dag dang dkar chag sgrig mkhan/ dpal ldan rgya mtsho/ phur pa phrin las/dkon mchog bsam gtan/ thub bstan nyi ma/ bstan ba dar rgyas/par sgrig lag rtsal pa/ tshe ring chos sgron/ shes rab dpal g.yang /bsod nams 'brug rgyas/ ——
gyi pa nga /mi —— 445kyi choge e —— ci sne / ne sa sto nga bge ge mo —— — — ci ༷sha(dzoXñdza blo

〈mes po'i shul bzhag〉 ces pa'i dpe tshogs 'di ni dpal brtsegs bod yig dpe rnying zhib 'jug khang gis bsgrigs shing 'di ga dpe skrun khang dang mnyam 'brel gyis bskrun pa'i dpe rnying dpe tshogs shig yin la/ de yang mkhas dbang gzan dkar rin po che thub bstan nyi ma mchog gis spyi'i gtso skyong gnang ste/ dpal brtsegs bod yig dpe rnying zhib 'jug khang gis nye ba'i lo bcu tsam gyi ring la 'bad brtson chen pos bod kyi sa gnas gang sar bzhugs pa'i bod yig dpe rnying po ti khrir longs pa rang byung dang mi'i gnod 'tshes 'jig la nye ba'i nyen kha las bskyabs te legs par bsgrigs shing dkar chag tu btab/ dpe thum gsol/ dpe sgrom bzhengs te srung skyob mdzad gnang ba dang gnang mus su yod pa ni/rang re'i mes po'i shul nor srung skyob rgyun 'dzin dang bod rig pa'i gal che'i dpyad gzhi mkho 'don gyi dgos pa che ba ma zad/ rang rgyal mi rigs rig gnas nor mdzod dar rgyas dang srung skyob bgyi ba'i 'phrin las gal chen zhig red/nye char dpal brtsegs bod yig dpe rnying zhib 'jug khang dang 'di ga dpe skrun khang gnyis zhib gros byas mthar/ srol rgyun rig gnas srung skyob dang bod rig pa'i dpyad yig myur skyob dang cha tshang du gtong ba'i dmigs yul ngosa'adzin gcig gyur thog 〈bka' gdams dpe dkon gcesabatus〉 zhes pa'i dpe rnying dpe dkon gyi dpe tshogs chen mo zhig mu mthud nas legs sgrig dang dpe skrun byed bzhin yod pa dang / da char yang dmigasayul dgos pa gcig gyur thog 〈mes po'i shul bzhag〉 ces pa'i dpe rnying dpe dkon gal chen gyi dpe tshogs chen mo 'di nyid par skrun bya rgyu yin la/ de yang sngon byon mes po mkhas dbang dam pa du mas shul du bzhag pa'i gsung 'bum dpe dkon gal chen rnams dang / 'thar 'thor du bzhugs pa'i dpe dkon gal chen dag phyogs gcig tu bsdus te bsgrigs pa 'di'i nang don thad la/ nang don rig pa dang / gso ba rig pa/ tshad ma rig pa/ sgra rig pa/ bzo rig pa/ lo rgyus/ rtsis rig sogs bcu phrag rig pa'i gnas kun 'dus pa'i dpe dkon nor bu dgos 'dod kun 'byung lta bu zhig yin/—1—

'a 'dra' dpe skrun mnyam las go skabs legs po nged cag dpe skrun khang la thob pa na tu skal ba bzang zhing gzi brjid kyi 'os 'gan zhig tu brtsis te lo 'ga'i dpe skrun 'char gzhi gtso bo'i nang du bkod zin cing / las gzhi 'di la krung go'i bod rig pa zhib 'jug lte gnas kyi dbu khrid dang rgyal khab phyi nang gi bod rig pa'i mkhas dbang du mas gdeng 'jog dang mthong chen gyis skul ma yang thob/〈mes po'i shul bzhag〉 gi ma phyi phal cher ni dbu med bris rnying sha stag yin pas/ ma dpe gsal mi gsal dang skung yig mang zhing bris tshugs 'dra min gyi dbang gis klog dka' ba'ang shin tu mang po 'dug 'on kyang dpal brtsegs bod yig dpe rnying zhib 'jug khang gis lo mang ring nyams myong bsdu len dang mkhas dbang du mar bka' 'dri zhus par brten yig gzugs gsar rgyag dang phyogs sgrig thub pa byung / par shing du 'khod yod pa rnams kyang dpe rnying gzhan pa dang bsdur te gtan la phab yod pa bcas te zhib cha deb so so'i bsdu sgrig gsal bshad du gzigs par zhu/dpe rnying srung skyob dang phyogs sgrig dpe skrun gyi las ka 'di la rgyab skyor dang thugs khur gnang mkhan gyi mkhas dbang rnams dang / lhag par du krung go'i bod rig pa zhib 'jug lte gnas kyi dbu khrid lhan rgyas dang / mkhas dbang thub bstan nyi ma rin po che mchog sogs kyis rgyab skyor dang mdzub ston gyi bka' drin bskyangs pa la snying thag pa nas thugs rje che zhu rgyu dang / dpal brtsegs zhib 'jug khang gi 'gan 'dzin pa lhan rgyas dang / zhu dag pa/ yig rgyag pa sogs mdor na las gzhi 'di la lhag bsam dang 'bad brtson chen pos zhabs phyi zhu mkhan rnams la snying thag pa nas bka' drin che zhes zhu rgyu dang /dpe tshogs 'di'i dpe sgrig dang zhu dag thad la ha cang nan tan dang zhib tshags bgyi khul byas mod/'on kyang nga tshor shes tshad dman pa'i dbang gis nor 'chug mi nyung ba yod srid pas dpyod ldan dag gis nor bcos yo bsrang gi dgongs 'char lhug stsol gnang bar zhu zhu/zhes spung go'i bod rig pa dpe skrun khang nas/spyi lo 2007lo'i zla ba dang po'i tshes 10la/

de la 'dir rang cag kha ba can gyi zhing 'dir chos rgyal lo paṇa rnams dang / sa dge bka' rnying sogs kyi mkhas shing grub pa brnyes pa'i dam pa'i skyes bu rnams kyis/ bshad sgrub kyi shing rta chen po bco brgyad rjes 'brang dang bcas pa'i chos brgyud dang bka' srol mtha' dag dang / de dang rjes su 'brel ba'i thun mong gi rig gnas sum rtags snyan ngag mngon brjod sdeb sbyor/ skar rtsis 'byung rtsis sgra tshad bzo gso sogs mdo sngags rig gnas dang bcas pa'i gzhung lugs zab cing rgya che ba tshang la ma nor ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa zhig 'chad nyan 'gyur gsum dang / bshad sgrub las gsum gyi sgo nas thog mar srol gtad/bar du gtan la phab/ rim bzhin dar rgyas btang ba sogs 'dzin skyong spel bar mdzad pa'i bka' drin bdag rkyen la brten nas/ dbus gtsang khams gsum du bzhugs so cog gi glegs bam thams cad gcig tu spungs na ri rab lhun po'i gtos dang mnyam zhing / chos tshan gyi rnam dbye ji snyed yod pa grangs su bgrangs na nam mkha'i gza' skar tshogs kyang skyengs par byed pa zhig mchis pa tsam du ma zad rgya bal hor sogs kyi yul gru kun tu'ang dar khyab che/da lta'i char bod rig pa'am bod kyi shes rig ces su grags pa 'di nyid 'dzam gling shar nub kyi yul gru dag tu'ang mched de/ dper na/ oka si phor dhi dang har lid lta bu yo rob dang / a ri sogs su grags chen gyi slob grwa chen mo —1—

rnams su bod yig gi dpe mdzod wo po yod par ma zad/ bod kyi chos dang rig gzhung slob gnyer byed sa'i sde tshan dang slob ma yang mi nyung ba yod/da ni gong du smras pa'i bshad sgrub shing rta chen po bco brgyad ces pa de gang dang gang yin pa'i ngo sprod mdo tsam zhu na/ de yang ji skad du/ 'jam mgon kong sprul rin po che'i zhal nas/ chos blon thon mi be+e ro ska cog zhang / /gnubs chen rin bzang rngog lo sa skya pa/ /bu ston bshad rgyun 'degasapa'i ka chen bcu// zhes dang bod yul sgrub brgyud shing rta chen po brgyad/ /rnying ma bka' gdams lam 'bras bka' brgyud pa/ shangs pa zhi byed sbyor drug bsnyen sgrub bo/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ shes bya'i gzhung lugase sna tshogs kyi 'gyur khyad dang 'chad tshul gyi dbye bas bshad rgyun 'degs pa'i ka chen bcu dang / sgrub pa nyams su len tshul la brgyud pa'i khyad par dang man ngag gi dbye bas sgrub brgyud 'dren pa'i shing rta brgyad de/ bshad sgrub shing rta chen po bco brgyad rjes 'brang dang bcas pa'i gsung rab rgya mtsho lta bu zhig bdag cag gi yab mes gong ma rnams kyis gces pa'i lus srog longs spyod thamasacad phangs pa med par btang ste/ phyi rabs rang re'i brgyud 'dzin rnams la 'phran yun phan bde'i dpal la dmigs nas bzhag pa'i nor bu rin po che yid bzhin dbang gi rgyal po mtha' yas pa zhig mchis/de dag las mang che ba rig gsar lo bcu'i god chag chen po sogs dus kyi rgud pa'i dbang gis sems med 'byung bzhi'i 'jig pa dang / sems ldan mi dang mi min gyi gnod pas nyams nyes chen por gyur pa ni rgya bod yongs grags ltar lags/—2—

rig gnas gsar brje'i mthug sgril ba dang chabs cig tang gi yang dag pa'i srid jus kyi nyi 'od slar yang 'phros te/ tang dang rgyal khab kyis 'go khrid dang rtsa 'dzugs gnang nas/ dpe rnying 'thor bsdu dang / legs sgrig dpe skrun/ sgyur spel sogs kyi sgo nas rang rigs kyi rig gnas nyams pa sor chud dang / mi nyams gong 'phel gyi bya bar so so'i 'khos bstun gyi sri zhu sgrub pa'i skal ba bzang po'i dpal la longs su spyad du yod pa'i skabs 'dir/ rang re'i yab mes rnams kyis bzhag pa'i pha nor mang po zhig da dung yang nged cag gi bsod nams kyi bgo skal du lhag yod pa rnams la gces spras chen pos srung skyob dang dar spel byed rgyu ni mes rgyal gyis gnang ba'i las 'gan yin par ma zad/ 'u cag bod kyi rig gnas slob gso'i bya bar legs skyes 'bul mkhan gyi rgan dar 'bring gsum gyi shes yon can la mtshon na/ rang re'i phrag par bab pa'i gzhan dring mi 'jog pa'i gzi 'od bla na 'bar ba'i 'os 'gan mchog tu gyur pa cig kyang yin par sems der brten/ phyogs dang ris su ma chad pa'i skyes bu dam pa rnams kyis ljags rtsom gnang ba'i gsung rab/ bshad sgrub shing rta bco brgyad las grub pa'i mdo sngags kyi gzhung bshad dang / chos 'byung dang gdan rabs/ rnam thar dang gsan yig brda sprod dang snyan ngag /rtsis dang gso rig sogs dpe dkon 'thor ba rnams bsdus/ chad pa rnams bsab/ nyams pa rnams gsos/ 'khrugasapa rnams bsgrigs te dpe tshogs 'ga' rim pa bstar chags su par du bskrun pa dang bskrun rtsis las/—3—

da lan 'dir jo nang rje bcun tā ra nā tha'i gsung 'bum dpe bsdur ma 'di rgya che'i gzigs pa po rnams kyi spyan lam du phul ba yin/'byung char nga tsho'i dpe tshogs dpar skrun zhu rgyu'i skor la lhag bsam ldan zhing mkhyen spyan yangs pa'i mkhas dbang rnams kyis dgongs 'char gyi bka' slob stsol gnang dang / dpe dkon gyi ma phyi g.yar gnang gi skyabs 'jug yong ba mkhyen mastegan/ /zhor 'phros gsal 'debs zhu ba/ lhag par du da lta lus kyi lang tsho rgyas shing sems kyi blo gros cibakra ba'i gzhon skyes rnams la mtshon na/ snying pos dben pa'i kha pho 'don pa las/ zol med kyi lhag bsam dkar po snying la 'chang / don ldan gyi rnam dkar bya ba dang du len/ lhad med kyi chos dang rig gzhung slob gnyer byed/ 'khos bstun gyi sri zhu'i las ka cung zad re sgrub nus na/mes rgyal la zhabs tog 'grub/ rang rigs la legs skyes 'bul/ rang nyid kyi la rgya mngon thub pa zhig kyang 'ong ba ni mthong chos mngon gyur lags pas/ de bzhin dgongs dbyings su chub par zhu'o/ /phran 'brog rgan 'khyams po thub bstan nyi mas/spyi lo 2007pa'i zla tshes la gus phul/—4

bsdo/ sgrig gsal ngatand/da lam nga tsho'i jo nang rje btsun tā ra nā tha'i gsung 'bum phyogs gcig tu bsgrigs te par skrun zhus pa 'di ni/ gzan dkar mchog sprul thub bstan nyi ma'i bka' slob dang bdag rkyen 'og byung ba zhig yin/de yang spyir khong la gsung 'bum pod bzhi bcu tsam zhig yod tshul phyis su bris pa'i rnam thar 'ga' las gsal yang / dngos su pod bzhi bcu'i dkar chag kha gsal zhig da sngon nga tsho'i mjal rgyu ma byung / da lam dngos su mjal rgyu byung ba'i pod bco lnga ni/ deng sang yongs grags su rtag brtan par ma zhes 'bod pa 'di ni/ bod rab byung bcu pa'i me 'brug (spyi lo1616) la/ mnga' ris smad kyi gung thang gi rgyal rabs nyi shu rtsa gsum pa'am/ yang lugs gcig la dmar po sde bsgrangs na nyi shu rtsa bzhi pa bsod nams dbang phyug sdes yon bdag byas/ tā ra nā tha'i dngos slob gnya' yi ban+de dkon mchog legs pas/ thog ma'i mtshams sbyor dang par byang 'bri ba sogs byas te/ dus 'khor sngags phreng dang skad gnyis shan sbyar sogs chos tshan bcu bzhi shing par du bkos pa/ rtag brtan dam chos gling du spyan drangs te bzhugs su gsol/ de'i steng du rtag brtan rang nas brkos pa bcas pod —1—

bco lnga tsam zhig yod pa de'i bu dpe par ma tshar gcig /rgyal dbang lnga pa chen pos 'bras spungs dpe mdzod khang du gdan drangs ba/ phyis dus 'gyur skabs su pe cing mi rigs pho brang du bzhugs kyang / deng seng bod ljongs dpe mdzod khang du spyan drangs te bzhugs pa de yin/yang gangs can mkhas grub rim byon gyi ming mdzod las/ khong la gsung rtsom shin tu mang po yod par grags kyang rgyal dbang lnga pa chen pos/gsung 'bum shing par rnams bka' rgya btab ste par mi chog nga mdzad pas da lta khong gi gsung rtsom rnams kha tshang ba ha cang dka'/ rgyal dbang lnga pa zhing du gshegs rjes/ blo gros brtan pas khong gi gsung 'bum la dkar chag bsdus pa zhig rimadzad 'dug /de'i rjes zha lu ri phug sprul skus mdzad pa'i tā ra nā tha'i gsung 'bum dkar chag dwangs gsal me long zhes pa'i nang du/ pod ka nas tsa bar bcu bdun la chos tshan nyis brgya don gnyis dang / ldeb grangs bdun stong brgyad brgya lnga bcu bzhugs/da lta pe cing mi rigs pho brang du pod bcu bdun la chos tshan nyis brgya don brgyad dang / ldeb grangs bdun stong dgu brgya lnga bcu rtsa brgyad bzhugs zhes gsal yang nga tsho'i gong gi dkar chag gnyisapo da sngon mjal rgyu ma rnyed/ de yang zha lu ri phug sprul skus dkar chag dwangs gsal me long zhes pa ljags rtsom gnang ste/ sngar rtag brtan gyi shing par dus zing dbang —2

gis nyams chag shor ba rnams/ kha gso mdzad tshul thos kyang zhib phra'i lo rgyus kha gsal mjal rgyu ma byung / da lta dgen 'jam dbyangs rnams rgyal gyi dpe mdzod du bzhugs pa'i par rnying pod bcu bdun 'di/ zha lu ri phug sprul skus nyams gso mdzad pa de yin nam snyams ste/ da lta rtag brtan gyi par rnying bod ljongs dpe mdzod khang du bzhugs pa pod bco lnga dang / pod grangs dang chos tshan mang nyung tshig mtshams sogs cung mi 'dra ba yod pa'i phyir/da lam nga tshos khong gi gsung 'bum glog klad nang du bcug skabs kyi thog ma'i ma dpe ni/ nye char bla ma yon tan bzang pos 'dzam thang du shing par la brkos pa'i glegs bam nyer bzhi can de la byas te zhu dag thengs gsum byas/ de rjes sngar jo nang rtag brtan du bzhugs pa rtsom pa po tā ra nā tha rang nyid kyi phyag dpe skabs 'gar phyag mchan yod pa/ da lta 'bras spungs gnas bcu lha khang nang bzhugs bris ma pod chung bcu la chos tshan43la bsdur gzhi dang / jo nang rtag brtan gyi par rnying pod bco lnga bod ljongs dpe mdzod khang du bzhugs pa dang / a ri ba dgen 'jam dbyangs rnam rgyal gyi dpe mdzod du bzhugs pa par rnying pod bcu bdun yod pa gnyis phyogs bsdoms kyis/ par rnying pod nyi shu tsam la chos tshan 314byung ba la sdur byed byas te dpe bsdur thengs dang po zhus/—3

de nas rtag brtan gyi par pod nyi shu la bsdur gzhi dang / 'dzam thang gi par mas sdur byed byas te dpe bsdur theng gnyis pa zhus pa yin/ 'on kyang par ma snga phyi gnyis dang bris ma gcig bcas dpe gsum po rtsa ba'i cha nas gcig mtshungs su bzhugs pa las khyad par chen po mi 'dug /cho ga'i skor la mi 'dra ba cung zad yod pa ni mchan dkyus su shor ba yin 'dug pa rnams kyang / gug rtags nang du bcug te gsal po byas yod/ rtag brtan par rnying dang 'bras spungs bris ma gnyis su dpe ma bzhugs pa/ 'dzam thang par ma'i nang bzhugs gsung thor bu'i skor wa rtags can dang / zha rtags can gnyis dang / za rtags can dbu ma theg mchog gi zin bris rab byed drug pa yan chad/ tā ra nā tha'i zhal gsung slob ma ye shes rgya mtshos zin bris su bkod pa dang / rab byed bdun pa brgyad pa gnyis dza 'go'i dge bshes mchog grub rgya mtshos gsar du bsnan pa/ 'a rtags can nyang yul gyi lo rgyus tā ra nā thas zhabs btags mdzad par grags pa bcas chos tshan121la 'dzam thang gi par ma'i dbe+e gcig pu las/ rtag brtan par rnying dang 'bras spungs bris ma gnyis kyi bsdur gzhi ma rnyed/ rtag brtan par rnying gcig pu las gzhan gnyis la med pa chos tshan4/ yang rtag brtan dang 'dzam thang par ma gnyis char med pa/ 'bras spungs gnas bcu lha khang du bzhugs pa'i gral nas chos tshan bco brgyad la ldeb192gsar rnyed byung —4

ba bcas la/ zhu dag byas te kha skong gi tshul du bzhag yod pa bcas khyon bsdoms deb bzhi bcu zhe lnga la chos tshan900yod/ da lta nga tsho'i ma dpe g.yar rgyu ma rnyed pa sngon rtsom pa po'i phyag dpe'i gral nas yin pa/ 'bras spungs gnas bcu lha khang / dpe rtags phyi298nang bzhugs gtam du bya ba nor bu'i 'byung gnas ldeb6/ yang phyi508nang bzhugs 'khor lo gsum gyi rnam bzhag chos dbyings rgya mtsho'i rgyan rnam par bkod pa ldeb92/ ste lag bris kyi chos tshan gnyis po ma 'ongs par dpe g.yar thabs bya dgos/da lta nga tshos dpe bsdur dang zhu dag gi skabs su ma dpe rtsa 'dzin byas te/ dpe gsum mi 'dra ba'i tshe rtag brtan la〈〈rta〉〉rtags 'di dang /'dzam thang la rtags〈〈〈 〉〉'di/ dag cha nor bcos la gug rtag 'di/ 1dang / mchan rnams gug rtagang 〉'di'i nang du blug yod/gsal bshad zhu rgyu zhig la deb bzhi pa'i nang du/ kun mkhyen dol po pa'i gsung chos tshan bzhi/ rig 'dzin tshe dbang kun khyab kyi gsung lho sgo'i cho ga zhes pa'i chos tshan gcig bcas 'dzam thang par mar bzhag yod pa dang / yang sa bzang ma ti paṇa chen gyi gsung dus 'bor phyag rgya'i skor chos tshan gcig rtag brtan par rnying du yod pa rnams rang 'jag bzhag yod pa dang / khong gi rang rnam gtso bor gyur pa'i lo rgyus zhal gdams rnams su/gtsang gi yul skad yin nam snyam pa'i tha snyad go dka' ba mang po zhig —5

bed spyad gnang ba dag kyang rang sor bzhag yod/ da lam bka' 'bum 'di rtsis 'khor nang du blugs pa'i 'gro song tsā 'dra tshogs pa nas zhus shing / par skrun tshar lnga brgya'i 'gro song bod rig pa dpe skrun khang nas bgyis/ tshar brgyad brgya'i 'gro song hrin sprin sogs kyi rgya'i sbyin bdag rnams kyis gnang zhing / tshar nyis brgya'i 'gro song tsā 'dra tshogs pa nas bgyis pa bcas kyi mthun rkyen las/ da lam dngos su par du bskrun thub pa byung ste rgya che'i klog pa po rnams kyi spyan lam du phul ba yin/las gzhi 'dir bod ljongs dpe mdzod khang nas ma dpe pod bco lnga g.yar gnang byung ba dang / 'dzam thang bla ma mun sel mchog nas kyang ma dpe btsal rogs dang / go rim sgrig rgyu/ zhu dgo bcas la rogs ram gang mang gnang ba dang / khams sprul bsod nams don grub mchog nas nyang yul chos 'byung zhu dag gi rogs ram gnang ba dang / bla ma dpal ldan rgya mtshos zhu dag gi las ka spyi'i thugs 'gan che bzhes gnang ba bcas la thugs rje che zhu rgyu ba'o/ /dpal brtsegs bod mig dpe rnying zhib 'jug khang nas darme bde legs kyis/—6

khong ni slob dpon li pyu shārnyi 'byehūṃ dzinas rdeng / paṇ+ḍi ta gha ya dha ra/gnyos lo tsā ba/ kha rag sgom chung sogs skyes chen mang pos byin gyis brlabs shing / bod skyong brtan ma bcu gnyis kyi nang tshan kha rag khyung btsun gyi gnas jo mo kha rag ces pa'i 'dabs/ chu bo chen po lo hi ta'i nye 'gram du rwa lo tsā ba chen po'i brgyud pa bar ma chad par byon pa la/ shar nub gnyis su gyes pa las shar ba kun dga' seng ge'i gdung brgyud/ sngags 'chang tshul khrims rgya mtsho'i sras rnam rgyal phun tshogs dgung lo bzhi bcu zhe dgu pa rje 'di'i yab dang /yum rdo rje bu dga' dgung lo bcu dgu pa gnyis kyi sras su bod rab byung bcu pa'i shing phag (spyi lo1575)la/ ngo mtshar ba'i ltas dang bcas sku zhabrungs te mes pos pad+ma sri gcod rdo rje zhes mtshan gsol/sku bltams te zla ba brgyad song rjes bzhengs nas gom pa spo thub pa dang / dgung lo gcig tsam nas gsung byon te nga bla ma kun dga' grol mchog yin zhes zhal gyis bzhes pa dang / gzhan yang sku gong ma'i rten gsum dang sbyin bdag / nye gnas sogs kyi lo rgyus gsal bar gsungs pa sogs kyis/jo nang bla ma kun dga' grol mchog gi yang srid zhabrul med du shes te/ dgung lo bzhi par jo nang mkhan chen lung rigs rgya mtsho dang / zhabs drung bkra shis —1—

stobs rgyas dbang po sogs rta pa brgya dang drug cu rtsa lnga tsam gdan 'dren du byung nas/ gtsang phyogs su gdan drangs te sku gong ma'i slob ma rdo ring kun dga' rgyal mtshan/ lha dbang grags pa/ mkhan chen lung rigs rgya masnarto/ mkhas dbang byams pa lhun grub/ rje drung kun dga' dpal bzang sogs kyis chos lung byang rtser khri ston mdzad/ rdo ring pa chen po 'jam dbyangs kun dga' rgyal mtshan gyi drung du/ thog ma'i rten 'brel du sgrol dkar gyi rjes gnang dang / gshed dmar lha lnga'i dbang / lam 'bras gtso bor gyur pa'i dbang dang gdams pa mang po gsan/de nas dgung lo drug pa nas yi ge sbyor klog phul du phyin pa mkhyen te/dbang dang rjes gnang sogs yig thog nas gnang ba la dka' tshegs med pa byung /dgung lo brgyad par rje gong ma'i dngos slob mkhas dbang byams pa lhun grub yongs 'dzin du bsten nas/ tshad ma rigs gter sbyangs pas gzhung don la go ba rnyed rung blo 'dzin la zla ba lnga tsam 'gor/ gzhan yang mdo rgyud kyi gzhud lugs mang por gsan bsam mdzad pas mkhyen rtogs rgyas/dgung lo brgyad la phebs skabs stag lung kun dga' bkra shis rgyal mtshan gdan drangs te thog mar bka' gdams glegs bam gyi lung zhus te/ de nas bod rab byung bcu pa'i chu rta khrums stod zla ba'i tshes lnga (spyi lo1582)la/ chos lung byang rtse'i mchod khang gi yang thog tu/ dpal stag lung pa chen po rje btsun kun dga' bkra shis rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po'i zhal snga nas kyi —2

mkhan po dang /'jam dbyangs kunadaga'argyalamatshanadapal(zangaposaslob dpon dang / rje drung kun dga' dpal bzang pos dus go ba/chos rje mchod gnas pas grogs dan bgyis te yongs rdzogs dge bsnyen dang bar ma rab byung sngon du 'gro bas dge tshul gyi sdom pa bzhes te/ mtshan kun dga' snying po bkra shis rgyal mtshan zhes gsol/ dag pa'i gzigs snang du rgya gar gyi paṇa chen dz+wa la nā thas tā ra nā tha zhes pa'i mtshan gsol/chos rje brag stod pa lha dbang grags pa'i drung nas chos drug dang phyag chen sogs/ zab chos mang po gsan pas nang zab lam gyi rtogs pa mngon du gyur/ rje drung kun dga' dpal bzang las dus 'khor gtso bor gyur pa'i zab chos mang po gsan/ mkhan po lung rigs rgya mtsho'i mdun dus kyi 'khor lo'i dbang dang rgyud bshad/ dpal rgyal ba jo nang pa'i lugs kyi sbyor drug gi zab khrid mtha' dag gsan te nyams len mdzad/ bu lugs kyi sbyor drug gi khrid kyang rdzogs par gsan/ gzhan yang jo zhal bla ma mang po'i gdams khrid dang bka' bstan sogs rgya gzhung gi man ngag mang po dang / kun mkhyen dol bo pa'i gsung 'bum sogs lung mang po gsan/ mkhas grub sangs rgyas ye shes/rdo rje 'dzin pa ye shes dbang po sogs las/ sa skya jo nang shangs pa zhwa lu 'brug pa rka tshang / stag lung sogs kyi chos skor bcas rgyud sde bzhi'i dbang khrid man ngag mtha' dag ma lus par gsan/ gzhan yang rgya gar gyi grub chen gu ru lho phyogs pa sangs rgyas sbas pa'i mgon po/ 'jam dbyangs kun dga'i mtshan can sogs bshes gnyen mang po'i zhabs la gtugs te/ zhang tshal pa'i chos —3

skor dang / yang dgon pa'i bka' 'bum/ dwags po lha rje'i bka' 'bum/ ri chos ma drug gi khrid/ mi tri bcu gsum ma'i dbang / sangs rgyas thod pa'i dbang /o rgyan bsnyen sgrub skor gyi khrid lung yongs rdzogs/ mar pa nas brgyud rngog pa'i bka' babs dgyes rdor yab yum/ gur rigs bsdus/ gdan bzhi yab yum/ ma hā mā ya ste drug : ti nas brgyud pa 'jam dpal gsang ldan bcas rngog dkyil bdun/rngog ṭīka rin chen rgyan 'dra'i mdzub khrid/brtag gnyis sa rngog gnyis ga'i bshad srol/ stag lung thang pa'i bka' 'bum/sgrub thabs brgya rtsa'i rjes gnang /nigu chos drug 'jam dkar gyi rjes gnang /'grel chen dri med 'od dang /rdo rje snying 'grel dang / dgyes pa rdo rje'i rgya gzhung / dgyes rdor skor la gtso che'i chos sna sum cu so dgu dang / gdan bzhi'i khrid tshul rgyas pa/ ār+ya de wa'i chos lnga sogs rgya gzhung bcu/ sa ra ha'i chos lnga/ nag po'i gzhung drug lha hi smad lnga/dril bu skor gsum/ gshed dmar bi rū pa'i gzhung brgyad/ ku ku ri pa'i chos bdun/ sgrub thabs mtsho skyes sogs dgyes rdor gyi gzhung shin tu mang po dang / dpe med 'tsho'i sbyor drug rtsa 'grel/dza lan+dha ri'i do ha/ sems kyi phyag rgya sogs mdo sngags spyi dang / khyad par du gsang sngags rgyud sde'i dbang bskyed rdzogs mtha' yas pa gsan/de nas dgung lo bcu bdun pa rab byung bcu pa'i lcags yos hor zla bcu gcig pa'i tshes bcu bdun (spyi lo1591)la/ 'jam dbyangs kun dga' rgyal mtshan gyis mkhan po/ bla ma byams pa lhun grub kyis las kyi slob dpon/dge ba'i bshes gnyen blo bzang pa dang / rje drung kun dga' bsod nams —4

sogs kyis kha skong gnang ste bsnyen par rdzogs pa dge slong gi sdom pa bzhes te/ phyi ltar ngur smig gi rgyal mtshan 'chang ba'i dge slong 'dul ba 'dzin pa/nang ltar gzhan phan snying rje chen pos thugs rgyud yongs su brlan pa'i rgyal sras sems pa chen po/ gsang ba bskyed rdzogs kyi zab gnad la mnga' brnyes pa'i sngags 'chang rdo rje 'dzin pa zhig tu gyur/de nas bsam sdings su dpal ldan bla ma dam pa byams pa'i mtshan can gyi drung du rdo rje phreng ba'i dbang yongs rdzogs dang / dpal mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho'i dbang bcas zhus/ bla ma dpal ldan chos kyi bzang po'i zhal snga nas/ rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor la brten nas dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i dbang yongs su rdzogs pa bdag po chen po'i mthar thug pa dang / gsang bdag 'khor lo chen po/dril bu lha lnga/ gzungasagrwa lnga/ dril bu lusadakyil sogs dbang mang po gsan/gzhan yang dge ba'i bshes gnyen rnams las/ gsang 'dus 'phags lugs dang / zhabs lugs/ gshin rje gshed dgra gdong 'jigs gsum/gshed dmar bram ze dpal 'dzin gyi lugs/ gdan bzhi'i gzhung bdun/sangs rgyas thod pa phyogs kyi rgya gzhung mang po dang / rgyud sde 'og ma ci rigs pa dang / grub pa sde bdun/ snying po skor drug yid la mi byed pa'i chos skor rnams dang / phreng ba skor gsum/ rgyud 'grel grags can phal che ba dang /bslab btus dang / byang sa sogs gzhung mang por thos bsam gnang bas blo gros kyi lus stobs ches cher rgyas te gzhung lugs rab 'byams smra ba'i mkhas pa chen por gyur/—5

de nas bla ma kun dga'i mtshan can dang slob dpon rin po ches bka' bzhin/ rje 'di nyid dgung lo nyer gcig pa rab byung bcu pa'i shing lug hor zla brgyad pa'i tshes lnga(spyi lo1595)la/ ri khrod chen po jo mo nang gi gdan sa par bskos pa bzhin bla brang gi rtsis sprod rtsis len gnang rjes/ skyid phug tu zla gcig lhag tsam bcad mtshams la bzhugs te phag snardzo'i ljags bsnyen gnang skabs/ rmi lam du ngo bo slob dpon pad+ma yin pa'i rnal 'byor pa gzi brjid che ba zhig gi drung du/ dwags po rnyi ba rin po che dge bshes bsres song gi rnam par bzhugs 'dug pa las/ rnal 'byor pa'i zhal nas nga dang dol po pa ngo bo gcig yin gsung pa dang / bod kyi dge bshes bgres song des kyang nga yang ngo bo gcig yin gsung pa rmis pas/dang po pad 'byung gi rten 'brel de sad de sgom gyi sa bon thebs/ bar skabs su dwags po rin po ches chos kyis rtogs pa brnyes/ phyis kun mkhyen chen po'i bzhed dgongs ltar nyams su myong ba'i brda ru go /de nas rgya gar gyi paṇ+ḍi ta pur+ṇa nan+da dang pra yā mā nan+da gnyis dang mjal 'phrad mdzad de gsung gleng gnang barmi/ khong gnyis grub mtha' nang par 'dug kyang pha mes kyi chos rig byed la yang zhen che bas/ phyi rol pa'i lha gcig gnyis bsten gyin 'dug pas dbang chos sogs ni ma zhus/ rig pa'i gnas thams cad la shin tu mkhas par 'dug pas dogs gcod mang du bgyis shing bstan bcos kyang than thun bsgyur/ bha ra ta dang rā ma ya ṇa la sogs pa'i lo rgyus kyang mang du thos/ de skabs rā ma ya ṇa'i srung ma ha nu ma tha'i cho 'phrul lus —6

byang chen gyi ri dang mnyam pa'i spre'u dang / bha ra ta'i srung ma rgyal po sgyi ma dngos su mthong bas paṇ+ḍi ta na re/ khyod la 'go bar 'dug mthu dang snyan grags longs spyod chen po yong gsungs na yang / chos la mi dad pa'i lha 'dre bsten pas ci bya snyam nas yal bar dor ba yin zhes gsungs/lo dus chag med jo nang du sbyor drug gi khrid gsungs pas ngo ma 'phrod pa gcig kyang ma byung / rgya gar gyi slob dpon su ni r+pā ṇa shrī dang pud+dha badz+ra sogs las zab khrid kyi gdams pa mang po gsan/ jo nang du sgrub mchod la dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor bzhengs te/ 'dus pa bdun brgya tsam la dbang bcu gcig pa rdzogs par gnang / dgung grangs nyer drug skor rwa sgreng du phebs te tshogs su chos 'brel tsam dang / rje tsong kha pa'i bzhugs khri'i steng nas lam rim gsungs/dgung lo nyer dgu par jo nang du bzhugs skabs tho rengs shig la rje btsun byams pas zhal gzigs te/ khong rang la thim pa'i gzigs snang byung bas gzhan stong dbu ma'i grub mtha' la nges shes gting nas rnyed/ kun mkhyen dol po pas zhal yang yang gzigs nas lung bstan gnang ba dang /gzim lam du sham+bha lar phyin nas rigs ldan sprul pa'i sku dang mjal te chos gsan pa'i snang ba sogs gzigs snang mang po byung /dgung lo so dgu par chos 'khor lha sar phebs nas dar chen mang po bslangs te jo bo'i mdun thugs smon zab —rgyas gnang / de nas kun mkhyen dol po pa'i sku brnyan gsung byon ma dang / thugs rje chen po/ tshe dpag med bcas —7

byin rlabs can gyi rten gsum po'i mdun du mchod 'bul dang thugs smon rgya chen gnang ste smon lam rgyal ba rgya mtsho yang brtsams/dgung lo zhe gcig pa rab byung bcu pa'i shing yos hor zla gnyis pa'i tshes bcu gcig (spyi lo1615)la/ gtsang pa sde srid phun tshogs rnam rgyal gyis chos gzhis dang / lha 'bangs sogs rgya cher phul nas mthun rkyen sbyar ba las/dpal rtag brtan dam chos gling nges don dga' ba'i tshal gyi gnas gzhi'i las grwa btsugs te/ phyi gtsug lag khang dang grwa khang brgya phrag tsam lcags ri dang bcas pa/ nang gi rten sangs rgyas rabs bdun dang / tshe dpag med/ sgrol ma/yum chen mo/ dzam bha la sogs gser zangs las grub pa mang po dang / dpal 'khor lo sdom pa'i sku zhal phyag yongs rdzogs gser zangs las grub pa dang /bde gshegs mchod rten cha brgyad sogs rten gsum dpag tu med pa bzhengs/jo nang du yang lha khang gsar bzhengs dang nang rten byams chen thog tshad gnyis tsam gser zangs las grub pa sogs mang po bzhengs/ gzhan yang lha bzo sogs lag rtsal pa rnams dang po rgya bal sogs nas gdan drangs/ de nas bris pa dang / spar brko shing bzo sogs lag rtsal pa gso skyong gnang bas/las rigs lag rtsal pa rnams kyang gzhan la re mi dgos pa byung ste/ bka' bstan 'gyur ro cog tshar mang po dang / bka' 'bum skor po ti bzhi bcu shing par du brkos pa sogs rten gsum mang po gsar bzhengs gnang /skabs shig ri bo che nas rgya dpe pod bcu tsam zhig 'byor byung ba'i nang / yar klung lo tsā ba'i phyag dpe ngo ma dus 'khor 'grel chen pod gnyis —8—

'dug dus 'khor rgyud kyi dpe de dbus phyogs nas snga mo zhig tu lag son byung ba dang / 'grel pa 'di skabs su rnyed pa la ya mtshan chen po byung ste thengs mang bklags pas zung sbyor la yang blo skyed chen po byung / gzhagayangadabang mdor bstan gyi 'grel pa don dam bsdus pa'i mdzad byang la nā ro pa'i mtshan yod pa dang / kyai rdo rje'i 'grel pa rdo rje'i tshig bsdus kyi mdzad byang du byang chub bzang po'i skad dod bo dhi bha dra zhes yod pa sogs mang po byung /yang skabs shig gtsang pa sde srid kyis sog po'i steng du dmag dpung chas rtsis la srung 'khor dang sku rim gnang ba'i tshe/ khong ni rje tsong kha pa chen por lhag tu dad pa che ba dang / khyad par du chos sde chen po 'bras spungs la nye sems kyi bag chags shin tu che ba zhig yod pas/ chos sde chen po de nyid dar zhing rgyas pa dang rtsod pa 'jam po'i sgo nas zhi ba'i smon lam btab kyang / nus pa ma thon pa ni phyogs gnyis ka las ngan gyi dbang gis ded pa la g.yol thabs bral zhes gsungs/ de nas dpal 'khor bde chen/ rtse chen chos sde/'jag bsam gnyis/ thar pa gling / rtag brtan chos 'phel sogs dbus gtsang gi chos sde mang por chos dang longs spyod kyi bsnyen bkur rgya chen gnang ste bskyangs/de nas dgung grangs re gcig bzhes pa rab byung bcu gcig pa'i shing phag (spyi lo1635)la/ rtag brtan dam chos gling nges don dga' ba'i tshal gyi gdan sa 'jam dbyangs sprul sku sangs rgyas rgya mtsho la gtad de/ chos lung rtse dang jo mo nang du dus khrid phyag len rgyas pa gnang nas/ da res ma gtogs —9

'dir chos mi 'chad gsungs te bu slob rnams la zhal ta mang po gnang ste/ lo de'i nag pa zla ba'i tshes nyer brgyad la zhi bar gshegs so//slob ma/ sprul sku sangs rgyas rgya mtsho/ mkhas dbang ye shes rgya mtsho/mkhan chen rin chen rgya mtsho/ mkhas grub blo gros rnam rgyal rnams dang / sgam po sprul sku/ chos rje ngag dbang pa/ bla ma chu bo chung ba'i sku skye/ mkhan po kun dga' bkra shis rgyal mtshan/ sprul sku ngag gi dbang po/ tre bo sprul sku/chos rje rin stengs pa/ dus 'khor shar chen pa/ chos rje lha bo pa/ dge slong snying po mtha' yas/ byams pa yon tan mgon po/ ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams/ mi pham dkon mchog legs pa/ kun dga' 'phrin las dbang mo/gtsang gi rgyal sras kun dga' bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan sogs mang po byung /gzhan yang bstan pa'i sbyin bdag gtsang pa sde srid phun tshogs rnam rgyal/ byang bdag bkra shis stobs rgyal/ yar 'brog bstan 'dzin mi 'gyur dbang gi rgyal po sogs mang ngo/ / dpal brtsegs bod yig dpe rnying zhib 'jug khang nas rkarma bde legs kyis/— —10

zhes bya ba bsdokyigs/oṃ swasti/ yi dam rgya mtsho'i sgrub thabs rin chen 'byung gnasazhes bya ba/phyogs bcu dus gsum na bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad dang / bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro chos skyong srung ma'i tshogs dang bcas pa rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rgyal ba rnam 'dren shākya seng ge dang / /bla ma rdo rje 'dzin pa dbyer med sku/ /thar pa'i lam ston de la gusapa'i yid/ /rab tu rgyasapas dngos po kun gyis 'dud/ /dpal ldan bde chen sku ni ye shes lang tsho'i nyams 'gyur bye bas 'byud/ /kun rtog sder bcas dbyings su zhi bsadri bral 'od kyis phyogs cha 'gengs/ /mtha' yas yon tan gser gyi dra bas mngon par khebs 'di srid zhi'i dpyid/ /dpal ldan rdo rje 'dzin pa gang desamatha' yasa'agro la dge bar mdzod/ /tha mal rtog pa'i yid kyi chom rkun ni/ /mi bzad srid pa'i lam du rtag par rgyu/ /rang yid mgron po rang gnas 'tshol 'dod kyang / /srid zhi'i longasaspyod 'joms par byed mthong nas/ /gang zhig stobs ldan ye shesadapung gi tshogs/ /snang stong lha sku'i go cha chu khur 'phreng / /rab 'byamasa'aphrin las mtshon char dkrigs pa des/ /rab bsrung bde ba'i gnasasu phyin byed 'gyur/ /bar chad sa rdul mi bzad zhi byed cing / /grub pa'i lo tog rnam par rgyasa'adod la/ /sgrub thabasabadud rtsi'i char wo 'di phab 1—

kyi/ /skal ldan zhing pa'i tshogasakun dga' bar gyis/ /dpal ldan rdo rje 'chang chen po'i rgyud sde rnams lasayang dag par bstan zhing gsungs pa sgrub pa'i thabs bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho lta bu dag lasagrub pa'i slob dpon so so'i yul dus gnas skabs tha dad par sems can so so'i bsam pa dang mthun par/ lha'i rnal 'byor dang rjesasu 'brel ba'i sgrub thabasasna tshogasapa mdzad pa rnams deng 'dir chabasacig tu 'god par bya ste/ ji ltar rgya mtsho las char sprin gyi phung po dag byung la/ de dag lasakyang yan lag brgyad dang ldan pa'i char dag yul sosor babs so/ /de dag kyang sa'i bye brag tha dad pa dang 'brel bas/ chu mig dang / lteng ka dang / lu ma dang / mtshe'u dang / mtsho rdzing sna tshogs par gyur nas/ yul dang yul dag tu chu phran rnam pa mang po dag 'babasapa de dag kyang mthar gyi yongs su 'du ba'i rgya mtsho chen po zad mi shesapa rin po che du mas gang bar 'gyur ba bzhin no/ /deng 'dir rdo rje 'chang chen po nas brtsams te/skyesabu dam pa gcig nas gcig tu yongs su brgyud pa/ bla ma dam pa'i byin rlabs kyi bka' ma nyams pa rnams bdag gisayongasasu mnosapa las/ slob ma rjes bzung gi bya ba/ dbang bzhi'i don tshang yang dbang gi cho ga dngos ma yin zhing / byaba'i rim pa yang shin tu zor yang ba rnams la byin rlabs kyi cho ga zhes rdo rje'i slob dpon rnamasal rab tu grags te/ de ltar na/ byin rlabasadang /rjes gnang dang / rig gtad dang / bzlas lung dang kha cig lung tsam gyis 'grub pa ste/ de thams cad kyang dang por dbang bskur ba rnam par dag pa zhig yang dag par thob pas/ sngagasakyi dam tshig dang ldan pa dag rjes su bzung —2

bar bya ba yin gyi/ gzhan du na yi dam lha'i sgrub thabs rnams kyang 'brasabu mchog dang bral ba'o/ khyad par 'di na rnal 'byor bla med las 'byung ba'i sgrub thabs mchog tu zab pa mang du yod pa'i phyir/ 'dus pa la sogs pa'i gang yang rung ba'i dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur ba nod pa la 'di dag sbyin par bya'o//slob dpon yang 'di dag thob pa tsam gyis chog pa ma yin te/ rab tu na dkyil 'khor gyi bdag po/ 'dir bshad kyi lha rigs gtso bo gtso mo rnams kyi bsnyen pa song ba zhig dgos shing / min na'ang dam tshig can theg pa bla na med par dkyil 'khor chen po gcig gi bsnyen pa mthar phyin pa/ 'di'i rjes gnang gi bya ba thams cad shes pa/ dkyil 'khor chen po gcig gi las la mkhas pa zhig nges par dgos so/ /de la sgrub pa'i thabs grags che ba rnams nye bar mkho ba'i don dang / shin tu dkon pa kha cig ni brgyud pa mi'achad par bya ba'i phyir dang / gzhan yang bdag gis thob pa rnams che long du bsdus pa ni/ 'di ltar thog ma kho nar sgrol dkar yid bzhin 'khor lo dang / 'phags ma dbyangs can ma dkar mo dang / 'phags ma sgrol ma ljang khu las gnyan sgrol du grags pa dang / rje btsun ma rig byed ma/ khro bo 'dod pa'i rgyal po/ tshogs bdag dmar chen/ rdo rje sems dpa' ser po/ 7 bdun po de dag cung zad tshig sna ring bar byas te/ bkra shis pa'i don du/ thog mar blo yul du 'jebs pa'i phyir brjod do/ /de nas de bzhin gshegasapa rab tu byung ba'i cha lugs can gyi sgrub thabs la/ sgrub thabs brgya rtsa'i rjes gnang gi chings shes pa'i don du brgya rtsa'i nang gi thub pa rdo rje gdan gyi sgrub thabasadang / sgrub thabs rgya mtsho'i —3—

chings shes pa'i don du/ de'i nang gi dam tshig gsum bkod lha lnga'i sgrub thabs dang / zur bka' la thub chen gnas brtan bcu drug gis bskor ba dang /bka' gdams lha bzhi'i nang gi thub pa chen po dang / bcom ldan 'das sman bla dang / sangs rgyas klu dbang rgyal po ste/ 13 skabs 'di drug go /rnala'abyor bla med las 'byung ba dkyil 'bor gyi gtso bo'i sgrub thabs las/ gsang ba 'dus pa 'jam pa'i rdo rje gtso rkyang / mi bskyod rdo rje lhan skyesamahā mā ya/ 10'khor lo bde mchog lhan skyes/ go cha'i dpa' bo drugago cha'i dpal mo drugabade mchog dkar po byang chub sgrub lam/ bde mchog dkar po'i tshe sgrub/ mi tra dzo gi'i lugs kyi bde mchog spyan ras gzigs/ kyai rdor lhan skyes/ dusa'akhor lhan skyes/ khro rgyal rdo rje shugs/ gshed dmar lhan skyes/ rdo rje 'jigs byed bsdus pa ste/ ( 〈rja〉 28) 'dir bcu bzhi'o// //de nasardo rje rnal 'byor ma'i phyogasal/ nā romakha' spyod/ zhal gnyis ma dpyal lugs/ mitri mkha' spyod/ in+d+ra mkha' spyod/ phag modon grub ma/phag mo dbu bcad ma/ phag mo gnam zhabs ma/ phag mo kurma pa dī/ phag mo bram ze dpal 'dzin lugs/ go zlog lhan cig skyes ma/ phag mo khrosanag lha dgu/ phag dkar shes rab gsal byed de/ skabs 'dir bcu gnyis so/ // de nas spyan ras gzigs kyi skor la/ 'phags pa yi ge drug pa jo bo lugs rgyas pa/ bka' gdams lha bzhi'i nang gi spyan ras gzigs/ bcu gcig zhal dpal mo lugs/ don zhagasalha lnga ba ri lugs/ don zhags kha che paṇa chen lugs/ kha sar pa ṇa lha lnga/ yid bzhin nor bu lha lnga/ sems nyid —4

ngal gso/ gsang sgrub mi tra dzo gi'i lugs/ spyan ras gzigs nam mkha' rgyal po/ 'phags pa yid bzhin nor bu 'khor los bsgyur ba/ bcu gcig zhal 'jigs pa brgyad skyob/ spyan rasagazigs rdo rje snying po/ 'phags pa seng ge sgra/ 'phags pa rgyal ba rgya mtsho ste/ skabs 'dir bco lnga'o/ /༈ sgrol ma'i skor la/ bka' gdams lha bzhi'i nang gi sgrol ma/ kha che paṇa chen lugs kyi sgrol ljang dang / sgrol dkar/ sgrol ma nyin zhi mtshan khro/ u rgyan sgrol ma/ sgrol ma yid bzhin nor bu/ sgrol ma dmar mo sa lugs/ sgrol ma nor sbyin ma/ sgrol ser gtso 'khor gsum pa/ rmi lam sgrol ma/ sgrol ma lha lnga/phyag brgyad sgrol ma/ ka pa li tā ra/ tsan+da tā ra ste/ skabs 'di bcu bzhi'o/ // phyag rdor gyi skor la 'phags pa u tsarla/ gos sngon can jo bo lugs/gos sngon can ba ri lugs/ ras chung lugs kyi gtum chen bsrung ba'i mkhar dang / gas chung khra thogs/ gas po dmar po/ gos sngon can 'gro bzang lugs/ gsang bdag khang brtsegs ma/ dpal chen 'byung po 'dul byed de/skabs 'dir dgu'o/ // rta mgrin gyi skor la/ rta mgrin dpa' gcig lhan skyesasu grags pa dang / rta mgrin khyung gzhog can dang / rta mgrin shā na bzhiskor te/ jo bo lugs gsum dang / rta mgrin kha che paṇa chen lugs/ skyer sgang lugs/ lcags ral can te/ skabs 'dir drug go // migayo ba'i rigs la/ mi g.yo sngon po pus btsugasam/ sngon po jo lugasa'adi bka' gdamasalha bzhir bgrang rgyu yin/ mi g.yo dkar po/ mi —5

g.yo phyag bzhi pa/ mi g.yo zhabadra'ibazhi pa/ mi g.yo spre'u brgyad ma ste/ skabs 'dir drug go // tshesgrub kyi rigasal/ tshe dpag med sprul sku/ tshe dpag med ba rilugs/ tshe dpag med dkar po mi tra lugs/ dkar po phyag bzhi pa/ gtsug gtor rnam rgyal lha dgu/ 'chi med rdo rje lha mo ste/ skabasa'adir drug go /༈ shes rab kyi lha'i rigasal/ 'jam dkar kha che paṇa chen lugs/a ra pa tsa na dmar ser/ gang blo ma'i bstod sgrub/ 'jam dpal smra seng /'jam dkar shesarab 'bor lo ste/ 'jam dbyangasakyi rigasalnga dang / byamasapa'i sgrub thabasani ri ti ba'i lugs/ sher phyin ser mo/ sher phyin dkar mo/dbyangasacan ma dkar yophyag bzhi ma/ dbyangasacan ma dmar moste/ skabs 'dir bcu'o/ // rdorje gdan pa lha drug tu gragasapa las/ mi g.yo ba gong du song /'od zer can ma/ thub pa mi ru shi ṣa dang / spyan rasagazigasayi ge phyed dang bzhi pa/ sangs rgyasaspyan ma/ dam tshig gsum bkod gtso rkyang ste/ 'dir lnga'o// dbang bsdud kyi lha'i rigasal/ ku ru kul+le gsang sgrub/ dmar chung skor gsum du gragasapa'i dpal mo gser gyi snying thig can/ nor rgyun ma dmar mo/ lha mo te nu rnams dang / mkha' 'grom thod rgyan/ mkha' 'gro ma gsang ba ye shes te/ skabs 'dir drug go // de nasasna tshogasapa'i sde la/ rnam 'joms ljang khu/ rnam 'joms dkar po/ gsang 'dusalasa'abyung ba'i khro bo bgegasamathar byed/ sna tshogs—6

yum dkar mo/ sosor 'brang ma/ gtsug tor gdugs dkar/ ri khrod ma lo ma gyon ma ser mo/ ri khrod ma rigs bzhi la le tshan gcig gza' yum/ rme brtsegs dud kha/ rme brtsegs ljang khu/ khro mo rme brtsegs/ khro bo reg tshigabade mchog bya khyung / dusa'akhor khyung khra rgyud lugs dang / man ngag lugs/ khyung ser/ 'jam dbyangasanag po/ lha mo shra ma ṇa/ mkha' 'gro seng gdong ma sngon mo dang / dmar mo/ 'jam dpal na ga rak+ṣa ste/ nyi shu rtsa gnyis so/ // de nasargya gar gyi slob dpon pur+ṇa badz+ra las mnos pa'i sgrub thabasa'adi rnams la/ rgyud sde gong 'og dang lha rigasami 'dra ba sna tshogasayod na'ang /lag len mthun zhing brgyud pa gcig pa'i phyir phyogasagacig tu brjod na/sangs rgyas dpa' bo bdun gyi sgrub thabs/ 'od dpag med/ byamasapa/ kun tu bzang po/ nam mkha'i snying po/ sa'i snying po/ sgrib pa rnam sel/ 'phagasapa spyan rasagazigs kyi rigs la/ 'jigs pa brgyad skyob/ sna tshogasadabang po/pad ma'i phyag/su kha wa ti/ don yod lcagasakyu/ don yod mchod pa'i nor bu rnams dang / gsang ba'i bdag po lhan skyes/ lha mo mā ma gī/ lha mo gosadakar mo/ gtsug gtor rnam rgyal phyag gnyis ma/ lha motsan+da phyag mang / khrobo gzhan gyis mi thub pa/ rta mgrin dkar po/ migayo ba dmar po/ 'od zer can ma rta ljang can/ rgyal mtshan rtse mo'i dpung rgyan/ lha mo ro langasam/ gnod sbyin mo 'phrog ma/ tshogs bdag ser po ste/ nyi shu rtsa drug go /༈ de nasanyi ma sbasapa'i lugs sgrol ma nyer gcig gi sgrub thabasasngar sbyar ba 'dir gzhug par bya'o/ /—7

/ de nas nor lha'i rigasal/ rnam thos sras ser chen/ mdung dmar can rta sngon ma/ ljang seng be con can ma/ dmar po gar mkhan mchogagasung mchog lus ngag g.yo/ drag byed nag po rta sngon can/ dkar po tshe 'dzin te/rnam sras rigasachen brgyad du grags pa dang / rnam sras ljang khu dz+nyā na lugs/yang gsang phyag mtshan bzhi pa ste bcu dang / j-i bha la ser po gtso rkyang / gsang 'dus lasa'abyung ba'i dze+e ser/ dpa' bo chig grub las 'byung ba'i lha mang / j-i bha la nag po kha che paṇa chen lugs/ dze+e la dkar po lha lnga/ dze+e la dmar po srog sgrub/ dmar po grwa pa mngon shesakyi lugs/ j-i la ljang khu dus 'khor lugs te brgyad dang / gnod sbyin nor bu bzang po/ srasagar mkhan mchog/sras rgyal ba khyu mchogalha mo dpal chen mo/ gzungs las 'byung ba'i nor rgyun ma/ nor rgyun ma ya mā ri'i lugs/ nor rgyun ma ba lang rdzi/ yid 'phrog nor rgyun ma/ gnod sbyin zha 'on rdo rje bdud 'dul/ gnod sbyin a pa ra dzi ta/ tshogs bdag chags pa rdo rje/ tshogs bdag dkar po phyag bzhi pa/ dmar po phyag bzhi pa/ 174klu rgyal sog ma med/ dbyug gu ma spun gsum/ khol po kun+da li ste sum cu so bzhi'o/ // bstan srung mgon po lcam dral gyi rigasasna tshogs pa'i skor la/ myur mdzad ye shesakyi mgon po phyag drug pa nag po bar chad kun sel/ mgon dkar yid bzhin nor bu/ 200 mgon ser nor srung blo 'phel/ mgon dmar dbang gi rgyal po/ mgon ljang tshe bdag ste/ spyir byin rlabasakyi mgon po 'di la sgrub thabs mi'adra ba khungs ma shin tu mang yang 'dir lnga po de tsam zhig —8—

bkod do/ /de nasaye shes mgon po phyag bzhi pa grub chen zhi ba sbas pa'i lugs/ phyag bzhi pa nags rin lugs/ kun khyab yongs grags rga 61'i lugs/ mgon dmar rkang gling ma/ lha mo tsaṇ+ḍika /lasamagon bya rog gdong can te/ phyag bzhi pa dang 'brel ba drug/gur gyi mgon po lcam dral/ gur lha brgyad gur mgon phur zhabs khyung gshog can/ gur yum can klu sgrub lugs/gur rkyang rngog lugs te lnga dang / legs ldan nag po mgon po sdolnga'i skor ni/sku'i rigs la mgon po stag zhon/ gsung gi rigs la beng bka' ma/ gter ma/ legs ldan mched gsum/ e gho ra/ lha chen dpal 'bar jobo lugs/thugs kyi rigs la/ gri gug dpa' gcigalho nub mgon po/ mgon po bzhi sbrag/gri gug kha che paṇa chen lugs/ gyi ljang lugs kyi mgon po lha bcu bdun ma/ 'di gur gyi rigasasu grags na'ang gur dang gri gug ma ngo bo gcig pa la bsam na rung gi /ngo bo ni gri gug nyid yin no/ /gri gug lha dgu dz+nyā na lugs/ber nag zangs gri can/ gcer bu zangs gri can/ yon tan gyi rigasal/tshogs bdag mgon po seng ge'i gdan can/ 'phrin lasakyi rigs la/ mgon po trakad gnyes lugs/ trakad seng shon jo bo lugs/ trakad gri gug ma/ rkang thang ma/ ma ning ma/ 'brong zhal can/ shwa na'i zhal can rnamasaso/ /sku'i rigs dang mthun pa la/ dpal mgon zhal bzhi pa bsnyen dus de dang las sgrub kyi khyad par/ lasabazhi mgon po la le tshan gcig/zhal bzhi gdong brnyan can/sha za ce sbyang gdong rnams so/ // lha mo'i skor la/ dpal ldan lha mo dud sol ma/ dmag zor rgyal mo/—9

rang byung rgyal mo/ lha modung skyong ma/ bdud more ma tī/ klu mo phyag bzhim/gnod sbyin re ma tī/ rdo rje gshog rgod ma/ lha mo e ka dza ṭī/ lha mo nam mkha'i gos can rnams so/ /chos rgyal lasakyi gshin rje/ dmar mo ma ru rtse bzhi skor/dmar po khrag mdog ste gsum/ dur khrod bdag po lcam dral/ pu tra ming sring bran bdud/ dkar mo nyi zla lcam dral te/ skabasa'adir drug cu re gcig go // de ltar de rnams kyi mthar bkra shis shing dge mtshan dang ldan pa'i don du chosaskyong ba po'i sgrub thabs gsum dgod pa ni/ rgyal chen sde bzhi/mkha' 'gro sde lnga/ bkra shis tshe ring ma mched lnga rnams so/ 202 /de dag lasasgrol dkar dang / dbyangs can ma dkar mo dang / thub pa rdo rje gdan dang /dam tshig gsum bkod dang / phyag rdor u tsa dang / 'jam dkar dang / nā romakha' spyod dang / phag mo dpyal lugasadang / gur mgon/ phyag bzhi pa/ phyag drug pa rnamasakyi rtsa ba'i sgrub thabasare re tsam re thog mar byang por bzung bar bya'o/ /de ltar le tshan nyis brgya drug cu reganyis po rnams lasasgrol dkar la nang tshan sgrub thabs bzhir dbye ba dang / de bzhin du phag dkar la gnyis/don zhagasal gnyis/ ri khrod ma rigs bzhi la bzhi/ rnam 'jomasakyi sgrub thabs snga ma la gnyis/ phyag rdor 'byung 'dul la gnyis/ mgon po phyag bzhi pa rga lo lugs la gsum/ mgon po zhal bzhi pa la sgrub dus lasasbyor gnyis sosor phye/ las bzhi mgon po la sosor phye bsabazhi ste/ de rnamasasgrub thabs kyang mi 'dra zhing / slob ma rjes 'dzin gyi bya ba yang sosor dgosapas/sgrub thabasaso so re re bar byed dgosashing / de bzhin du nyi ma sbas pa'i —10

lugs kyi sgrol ma'i sgrub thabs kyi le tshan la/ spyi'i sgrub thabs su gragasapa rtsa ba'i sgrol ma dang / las chogasakyi sgrol ma nyer gcigasgrub thabs dang / bstod pa rnam dag gtsug nor ma la mi 'dra ba'i khyad par gyi sgrol ma nyer gcig gi dgu pa bstod pa las seng ldeng nags sgrol du bshad/ de dang phyogs mthun seng ldeng nags sgrol gtso 'khor gsum pa 'phros don du bshad pas/ rjes gnang nyer gsum mam/ nyer bzhi 'byung / de rnams kyi nang nas re re nyis brgya drug cu re gnyis dkyus kyi grangs la bcug/lha por sgrol dkar gsum/ phag dkar gcigadon zhags gciga'abyung 'dul gcigarnam 'joms gcigarikhrod ma gsum/ mgon po phyag bzhi pa la gnyis/ zhal bzhi pa la bzhi ste bcu drug dang / nyi ma sbasapa'i lugs kyi sgrol ma la nyi shu rtsa gsum ste bsdoms pas sum cu sodagu yin la/ de dang sngar gyi nyis brgya drug cu re gnyis bsdomasapas gcig gis lhag pa'i sum brgya'o/ /༈ de rnams las/ rgya gar gyi slob dpon las dngos su thob pa'i sgrub thabasanyi shu rtsa brgyad yod pa la/ mahā mā ya dang / nag po chen po grub chen zhi ba'i lugs/ phyag rdor dang mā ma gī 'gro lding ba'i lugs/ lhag ma nyer bzhi shākya rak+ṣi ta nas brgyud pa yin no//gzhan yang sgrol dkar yid bzhin 'khor lo gnyan lugasadang ba ri lugs/ gnyan sgrol/ dmar po skor gsum/ thub pa rdo rje gdan/ bde kyi lhan skyes/ go cha gnyis/ seng ge sgra/ sgrol ma nyin zhi mtshan khro/ sgrol ma dmar mo/ phyag rdor ba ri lugs/ 'byung 'dul ring brgyud/ migayo sngon po sogasardo rje gdan pa'i thugs dam lha drugami g.yo phyag bzhi/ mi —11—

g.yo zhabasabazhi/ tshe dpag med ba ri lugs/ rnam rgyal rdo rje lha mo/ a ra pa tsa na ser po/ sher phyin dkar mo/ ku ru kul+le gsang sgrub/ dmar mo skor gsum/ dmar chung skor gsum/ rnam 'joms ljang khu/ bgegasamathar byed/sosor 'brang ma/ gdugs dkar/ ri khrod ma rigasalnga/ gza' yum/ rme brtsegs dud kha/ khyung khra man ngag lugs/ 'jam nagaseng gdong ma gnyis/j-i dmar srog sgrub/ mgon po gur rigs gsum/ zangs gri rigs gnyis/dur khrod bdag po/ pu tra/ bran bdud/ dkar bdud lcam dral te/ zur bka' de rnams/ dpal ldan sa skya ba yab sras kyi chos so/ /don zhags ser po dang /yid bzhin nor bu lha lnga yang re zhig brgyud pa 'di phyogs su 'ded mod kyi/ de gnyis la rje btsun gong ma lnga'i yig rigs dang man ngag med cing / phyi ma ni jo bo rje nas nges par brgyud dgos pas/ ba ri lots+tsha ba man chad brgyud pa 'di la phyogs gcig tu bzhugs kyang / jo bo'i gdams pa yin no/ /sgrol dkar jo bo lugs/ rdo rje sems dpa'/ thub pa gnab/bcu/ bka' gdams lha bzhi/sman bla/ klu dbang rgyal po spyan ras gzigasayi ge drug pa/ yid bzhin nor bu lha lnga/ yid bzhin 'khor lo/ 'jigs pa brgyad skyob/ sgrol ma lha lnga/ phyag brgyad sgrol ma/ gzungasalas 'byung ba'i phyag rdor/ rta mgrin rigs gsum/rme brtsegs ljang khu/ khyung ser/ shra ma ṇa/ j-i ser lha mang / j-i la dkar po/ a pa ra dzi ta/ chogs bdag dkar po rigasaganyis/ sngags bdag sog ma med/dbyug gu ma/ kun+da li/ rtsis mgon/ gri gug lhan skyes/ lho nub pa/ bzhi sbrag /tshogs bdag mgon po/ trakad seng zhon/ lha mo nam mkha'i gosacan ma —12

rnams phal cher jo bo rje lasabargyud pa dang / bka' gdams lugs so/ /bde mchog dkar po gnyis/ go zlog lhan cig skyes ma/ don yod zhags pa/ sgrol ljang / sgrol dkar/ sgrol ma nor sbyin/ sgrol ser gtso 'khor gsum ma/ rmi lam sgrol ma/ rta mgrin rigs gcigami g.yo ba dkar po/ 'jam dkar rigasaganyis/ byams pa ni ri ti pa'i lugs/ dzinagamagon po gri gug rigs gcig ste/ paṇa chen shākya shrī nas brgyud pa bcu drug yod pa rnams shas che ba zhig khro phu ba dang 'brel/ gsang 'dus mi bskyod pa/ bde mchog spyan rasagazigs/dus 'khor lhan skyes/ phag mo khro mo/ spyan ras gzigasagasang sgrub/ sems nyid ngalagaso/ spyan ras gzigs rdo rje snying po/ sher phyin ser mo/ dbyangs can dkar mo phyag bzhi ma/ rnam sras ser chen gyi brgyud pa'i lugs gcig /nor rgyun ma rigs gsum/ gar mkhan mchogargyal ba khyu mchogalha mo dpal chen mo rnamasakyang khro phu ba'i gdams pa'o/ /gzhan yang phag dkar/sgrol ma yid bzhin nor bu/ dze+e ser phyag gnyis gtso rkyang / gzungasalasabyung ba'i nor rgyun ma rnams rat+na rak+ṣi ta'i man ngag dang / rdo rje shugs/ sna tshogs yum dkar mo/ khyung khra rgyud lugs/ rdzabha la ljang khu rnams dus 'khor las 'byung zhing / jo nang pa'i man ngag gtso bor gyur pa dang / sgrol dkar dang /phag dkar dang / kha sarla ṇa/ mgon po phyag bzhi pa dang / gur rnamasakyi rigasare re nags rin nasabargyud pa sogs sgrub thabasalhag ma rnams brgyud pa'i bka' babs sna tshogs las 'byung ba'i tshul ni 'chad 'gyur brgyud yig la brtags pasashes par 'gyur ro/ /phyisagang las bka' babasapa ni/ sgrol —13

bya'o/ /de bzhin du gzhan dang gzhan las brgyud pa'i rim pa rnams kyang brgyud yig la zhib mor brtagasapasashes la/ kho bos bla ma dam pa bcu gsum tsam las rnyed pa yin no/ /sgrub thabasabargya rtsa dang / rgya mtsho gnyis chingasatha dad yin zhing / thun mong gi bya ba de gnyisal kha 'phangasakyi rigs mang du yod pas/'dir thub pa rdorje gdan dang / dam tshig gsum bkod las shes dgos pas/de dag nges par slob/ de ltar sgrub thabs sum brgya lhag bcas de rnams lasashin tu nye bar mkho ba gtso bo gtso bo dag bsdu bar spro na 'di ltar bya ste/ sgrol dkar jo bo lugs/ dbyangs can ma dkar mo/ gto sgrol/ dmar po skor gsum/ thub pa rdo rje gdan/ dam tshig gsum bkod/ sman bla/ gnasabartan bcu drugaklu dbang rgyal po/ bde mchog kyai rdor/ dusa'abor gsang 'dus te lhan skyes bzhi/ nā ro mkha' spyod zhal gnyis ma dpyal lugs/ yi ge drug pa jo bo lugs rgyas pa/ bcu gcig zhal dpal molugs/ don zhags dkar po ba ri lugs/ kha sarla ṇa lha lnga/ phyag rdor u tsa/ gtum chen/ 'gro bzang / 'byung 'dul/ rta mgrin dpa' gcigaskyer sgang lugs/ lcags ral can/ mi g.yo sngon po pus btsugs ma dang dkar po/ tshe dpag med dkar po mi tra lugs/rnam rgyal lha dgu/ 'jam dkar kha che paṇa chen lugs/ a ra pa tsa na dmar ser/ rnam 'joms ljang khu/ byams pa/ sher phyin dkar mo/ sna tshogs yum/so sor 'brang ma/ gtsug gtor gdugs dkar/ 'od zer can ma/ ri khrod ma ser mo/ gza' yum/ rme brtsegasadud kha/ khyung khra man ngag lugs/ 'jam dbyangs nag po/ seng gdong ma sngon mo/ rnam thos srasaser wo/ j-i ser gtso —15

rkyang / dze+e nag kha che lugs/ gzungs lasa'abyung ba'i nor rgyun ma/ tshogasabadag dkar po phyag bzhi pa/ ye shesamagon po phyag drug pa dkar nag gnyis/phyag bzhi pa rga lo lugs las 'gro mgon phag gru'i phyag bzhes/ gur lcam dral dang lha brgyad/ stag thon/ ber bka' ma/ gri gug dpa' gcig/trakad gnyosalugs/ zhal bzhi pa bsnyen dus/ dud sol ma/ca dmar zor ma/ las gshin mthing kha/ dur khrod bdag po/ rgyal chen sdebazhi rnams so/ /lha'i ngo bo/shāka thub/ sman bla/ tshe dpag med/ klu dbang rgyal po/ bde kyai gsang gsum/dus 'khor/ mā ya/ gshin rje gshed/ rnal 'byor ma/ 'jam dbyangs/ spyan rasagazigs/ phyag rdor zhi khro/ rta mgrin mi g.yo ba/ rnam rgyal/ byams pa/dbyangs can ma/ sher phyin ma/ 'od zer can ma/ ku ru kul+le 'dod rgyal/ te nu/rnam 'joms/ rme brtsegasapho mo/ bdud rtsi 'khyil ba/ sna tshogs yum/ sor 'brang / gdugasadakar/ ri khrod ma/ gza' yum/ khyung / shra ma ṇa/ seng gdong ma/ nā ga rak+ṣa/ yang kun tu bzang po/ nam snying / sasnying / sgrib sel/lha mobazhi/ tsun+da/ khrobo gzhan gyis mi thub pa/ rgyal mtshan rtsemo'i dpung rgyan/'phrog ma/ rnam sras/ dze+e bha la/ nor rgyun ma/ nor bzang / srasaganyis/ a pa ra/ tshogasabadag sog ma med/ dbyug gu ma/ kun+da li/ ye shesamagon po/legs ldan mgon po/ 'dod khamasam dpon g.yog/ral gcig ma/ gshin rje/ dur khrod bdag po/ pu tra/ dkar bdud/ rgyal chen/ mkha' 'gro sde lnga/tshe ring ma rnamasasu 'dusal/ de dag la yang dper na/ spyan rasagazigasakyi khongasasu sgrol ma/ kul+le/ rta mgrin sogasa'adusapa re re la/ nang tshan yang —16

dkar po lasa.ut+pal dkar po'i sdong po ze'u 'bru la 〉yig dkar posamatshan par gyur/ de lasa'od zer 'phros/ 'phagasapa mchod/ sems can thams cad kyi don byas/ slar 'dusashing thim pa yongasasu gyur pa las/ rang nyid lha mo sgrol ma yid bzhin 'khor lo sku mdog zla ba ltar dkar ba/ nor bu chu shel ltar dwangs la dri ma med pa 'od zer lnga ldan du 'phro ba/ rab tu zhi ba chen po'i 'dzum zhal can/ ut+pa la'i 'dab ma ltar rab tu rgyas pa'i spyan bdun dang ldan ma/ phyag g.yasamachog sbyin dang / g.yon pa'i 'theb srin gyis ut+pa la dkar po'i sdong bu'i rtsa ba thugasakar 'dzin zhing / rab tu rgyas pa'i snyan gyi thad gar kha phye ba bsnamasapa/ sgeg cing chags pa'i nyamasaldan nu 'bur zung gis mdzes pa/ mu tig dkar po gtso bor gyur pa/ rin po che sna tshogasakyi dbu rgyan/snyan rgyan/ mgul rgyan/ do shal/ se mo do/ dpung rgyan/ phyag gdub/ sked rgyan/ zhabasagadub/ g.yer kha'i phreng ba dang bcas pa dang / lha rdzas kyi me tog du mas mdzes pa/ dar dkar po'i stod g.yogasadang / sna tshogasadar gyi smad dkris gsol ba/ dbu skra yib (li ba 1ltag par bcings pa'i zung phud rnam par g.yo zhing / gzhon nu'i lusacan rdorje'i skyil krung gisa'agying tshul du bzhugs shing / ri bong 'dzin pa'i rgyab yol can du gyur/ gnyisapa ni/ dpral bar zla ba la oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par pad+ma la ādamar po/ thugasakar nyi ma la hūṃ sngon po/ hūṃ gi stod tsam du yad dkar dang zla ba la khriyig dkar po/sam pa ni/ rang gi snying ga nasa'od zer 'phros/ rang bzhin gyi gnasanasarje btsun ma 'phagasam sgrol ma dkar mo'i lha tshogasathamasacad badz+ra samā dzaḥ—20

sogs so so'i ming gi skabs/ mchod yon sogs so so'i phyag rgya 4'a ba phyagalen yin no/ /oṃ ār+ya tā re gu ru bud+dha bo dhi satwa sa pa ri wā ra maṇ+ḍal bh+yaḥ warnya pra tīts+tsha pu dza me gha sa mu dra s+pha ra ṇa sa ma ye hūṃ/ de bzhin du/ arnya gyi gnasasu/ pubye la yang sbyar bas/ zhabasabasil 'bul/ me tog la/ oṃ ār+ya tā res pa ri wa ra bh+yaḥ badz+ra puṣ+ṭi pra tīts+tsha na maḥzhesabarjod/ de bzhin du/ dhu pe/ bdug sposadang / ā lo ke mar me dang / garnye/ dri chab dang /ni waṃ te/ zhal zas/shap+ta rol mo rnamasa'abul lo/ /de nasabastod pa ni/ 'khor ba lasasgrolatā re ma/ /tustu ra yisa'ajigs brgyad sgrol/ /nyures na ba kun las skyob/sgrol ma la ni phyag 'tshal bstod/ /pad+ma dkar po'i dbus gnas pa/ /zla ba'i gzugs kyi gdan steng du/ /rdo rje skyil krung bcas mdzad ma/ /mchog sbyin sgrol ma la phyag 'tshal/ /ston ga'i zla ba'i gdangasa'adra zhing / /zla ba la ni rgyab brten ma/ /rgyan rnams thams cad yang dag rdzogs/ /āt+pal bsnams la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /bcu drug lo lon lus can ma/ /rdzogasasangs rgyas rnams khyod kyi sras/ /'dod sbyin sku ni 'chang ba'i yum/ /'phagasam sgrol ma phyag 'tshal bstod/ /'khor lo dkar po 'od zer 'bar/ /rtsibs brgyad la ni yi ge brgyad/ /yongs su bskor ba'i rnam pa can/ /yid bzhin 'khor lor phyag 'tshal bstod/ /gtor ma/ a n+t+ratasabasangs/ swa bhā wasasbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang lagagator snod yangs shing rgya che ba rin po che las grub pa'i nang du/ oṃ āḥgyi zhu ba las byung ba'i gtor ma 'dod dgu'i rgya mtsho chen po kha dog dri ro nus mthu phun sum tshogos par gyur/ oṃ āḥ/ lan gsum mam lan bdun gyisabyin gyi brlabaga.oṃtā re tustu re tu re i dam ba ling ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ lan bdun gyisarje ba' yis—25

nang gi 'jigasapa bar chad thams cad zhi ba dang / bsam pa'i don thams cad gegs med par 'grub cing / khyad par du tshe'i 'gal rkyen thamasacad zhi nas 'chi med tshe'i dngos grub thob par bya/ de'i phyir du rje btsun ma 'phags ma sgrol ma dkar mo yid bzhin 'khor lo'i rjesaganang zab mo zhu snyam pa'i byang chub kyi mchog tu sems bskyed pa dang / chos gsan pa'i kun tu spyod pa yang mdo rgyud rin po che nas ji skad bka' stsal ba ltar legs par gsal btab te gsan par mdzad pa zhu/ 'dir grub pa'i slob dpon ngag gi dbang phyug grags pa zhes bya ba rje btsun ma 'phags ma sgrol ma'i zhal rtag tu gzigasapa des/ rgyud sde mang po nas gsungs pa'i tshe bsgrub phyogasagacig tu bsgrigs pa'i 'chi bslu blu chen mo zhes bya ba sh+lau ka bzhi brgya lnga bcu pa zhig mdzad/ de'i nang na sgrol dkar yid bzhin 'khor lo'i sgrub thabs gsal bar bzhugs/ slob dpon de'i slob ma paṇ+ḍi ta thu bo zhes bya bas de logs su phyung ba'i sgrub thabs kyang mdzad/ de chos 'di'i gzhung gi rtsa ba yin zhing / de nyid kha ba can gyi phyogs 'dir snga 'gyur jo bo rje dpal ldan a ti sha'i lugasadang / bar 'gyur gnyan lugasadang / ba rilugs/ phyi 'gyur nags rin lugs kyi nye brgyud de lugs bzhi yod pa las/ 'di snga 'gyur yin/ de yang slob dpon ngag dbang gragasapa la gser gling pas gsan/ de la jo bo rjesagasan/ jo bos bod du mang du gnang na'ang / 'di 'brom ston las brgyud pa yin zhing / bar skabs su sgam po lugasadang / bka' gdamasalugasazhesabargyud pa tha dad du gyes pa yod na'ang / man ngag gi ngo bo la dbye ba med cing / 'dir de gnyisakar brgyud pa —29

dpon gyi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/ sangasargyasabyang sems thamasacad sgrol dkar yid bzhin 'khor lo'i rnam par spyan drangs/ khyed rang rnamasakyi lus la thim/ lho phyogs ri bo po ta la nas/ rje btsun ma 'phagasam sgrol ma dkar mo la/ bla ma yi dam sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpasabaskor ba spyan drangs/ khyed rang rnamasal thim/ slob dpon dang sgrol dkar yid bzhin 'bor lo'i thugasaka nas/ sgrol dkar yid bzhin 'khor lo'i sku che ba ri rab tsam/chung ba yungs 'bru tsam/ yang chung rdul phran tsam bsam gyis mi khyab pa kha ba bu yug 'tshub pa bzhin du khyed rang rnams kyi lusal gnyisasu med par sib sib thim par mos pa mdzod/ byasal/ dri sto po'i sposadud dang / rol mo 'jam rol rgyun ring bsabyin dbab/ slob dpon gyisardo rje gsor zhing dril bu 'khrol bzhin pas/ oṃ ār+ya tā re badz+rayi/be sha a a/ zhesalan nyer gcig nas brgya rtsa'i bar gang 'osapa brjod do/ /desasku'i rjes gnang grub pa lags/ yang dmigasapa 'di bzhin du mdzod/ khyed rang rnamasakyi snying gar pad zla la 'bor lo dkar po rtsibasabargyad pa'i lte bar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du 〉yig dkar po/ mtha' skor du oṃ ma ma ā yur puṣ+ṭhadz+nyā na puṣ+ṭi ku ru hā/ rtsib brgyad la/ tā re tustu re tu re swā/ zhes pa'i sngags kyi yiga'abru rnams kha dog dkar po mgo gyen bstan/ kha nang du phyogs pa 'od zer dkar po 'bar ba'i rnam pa can du bzhugs par mos/ slob dpon gyi thugasaka nas 'od zer 'phros/ mdun bskyed kyi thugs rgyud bskul/ thugasaka'i sngags 'phreng lasasngags 'phreng gnyisapa chad/ zhal nasathon/ khyed rang rnamasakyi kha sgo nasazhugs/ snying ga'i 'khor lo'i lte ba dang / rtsibasarnams la spar btab —31

pa bzhin du 'khor bar mos la/ 'di'i rjes bzlosamadzod/ yige ༄ pa lan gas dang / sngagasaspel tshig can lan gsum rjesazlosabyed gzhugadebrosasngags kyi bzlas lung thob/'on kyang bzlas brjod ma byas na/ lung phog pa tsam gyisadangos grub mi thob pas/ bzlasabarjod kyi don du dam bca' ba'i lung ni/ dus 'di nas bzung ste/ji srid byang chub ma thob bar du/ rje btsun ma 'phags ma sgrol dkar yid bzhin 'khor lo yi dam gyi lhar bzung nas/ de'i gzungs sngags nyin re la rang gi blo dang 'tshamasapa 'di tsam re ma chag par bzla snyam pas 'di'i rjesazlos mdzod/phyogs bcu na bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad cadang / slob dpon bdag la dgongs su gsol/ bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi ba dusa'adi nas bzung ste/ ji srid byang chub snying po la mchis kyi bar du/ sgrol dkar yid bzhin 'khor lo yi dam gyi lhar bzung nas/ de'i gzungs sngags nyin re la ci nus re bzla bar dam 'cha' lags so/ /lanagasum/ de ltar sngags bzlas pasakyang dngos grub tsam thob par 'gyur ba yin mod kyi/ lo dang zla ba mang por bsgrubs pas mthar gyi dngosagrub 'thob pa zhig kyang / bla ma dang lha'i byin rlabasakyi stobs kyis nyin zhag 'ga' zhig tsam gyis khyad 'grub pa'i phyir/ byin gyis brlabasapa'i lung bya dgosapas/ slob dpon la me tog 'thor bzhin du 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ bcom ldan bdag la stsal lags kyi/ /bdag la 'go bar mdzad du gsol/ /cesalan gsum/ de ltar phul bas me togade nyid sngags 'phreng du byin gyisabarlabasate/ khyed rang rnamasakyi spyi bo nasagator bas/ spyi gtsug gi sgo nas zhugasate/ snying gar sngagasa'aphrengatshal thim zhing /—32

byin gyisabarlabs par mosamadzod/ me tog spyi bor gtor te/ bcom ldan 'di la stsal lags kyi/ /'di la 'go bar mdzad du gsol/ /cesalan gsum snying gar gtor te/ sngags kyi dngos grub stsal du gsol/ /brtul zhugs brtan par mdzad du gsol/ /rdo rje slob ma 'di rnams kyi rgyud la rje btsun ma 'phags ma sgrol ma'i zab mo'i gsung rig sngagasakyi nus mthu thams cad thogs med du 'jug par gyur cigades gsung gi rjes gnang thob pa lags/ yang slob dpon gyi thugasaka nasa'od zer 'phros/ mdun bskyed kyi thugasargyud bskul/ thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/ sangs rgyas thams cad kyi thugs gnyis su med pa'i ye shes thams cad phyag mtshan ut+pal dkar po dri ma med pa'i 'od zer 'phro bas rnam par spyan drangs/ mdun bskyed kyi thugasakar thim/ mdun bskyed la mos gusadung ba byas/ de nyid rang gi spyi bor byon/ 'od kyi gong bur zhu ba spyi bo nas zhugs te snying gar thim/ de'i ngang der sems dus gsum gyi rnam par rtog pa'i spros pa thams cad spangasate/ cung zad mnyam par shog mdzod/ ces brjod la cung zad mi rtog pa sgom du gzhugades thugs kyi rjes gnang thob pa lags/ de dag gi gnas skabs su thob pa'i dam tshig dang sdom pa bsrung snyam pasa'adi'i rjesazlos mdzod/ gtso bosaji ltar bka' stsal pa/ /de dag thamasacad bdag gis bgyi/ lanagasum/ bka' drin gtang rag gi don du maṇ+ḍal phul mdzod rtsegabarjod la/ slob masakyang maṇ+ḍal 'bul/ rang gi lus dang longs spyod dus gsum gyi dgoba'i dngosapo thams cad lha dang bla ma la 'bul/ cha shas kyang longs spyod du gsol snyam pasa'adi'i rjes zlosamadzod/ deng nasabartsams te bdag bran du/—33

༄༅/ /'phags ma dbyangs can ma'i sgrub thabs ye shes 'char ba zhes bya ba bzhugs rber+sha/ /༈ skyesaswā sti/ 'phagasam dbyangasacan ma'i sgrub thabasaye shesa'achar ba zhesabya ba/ sangasargyasadang byang chub semasadapa' thamasacad la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dpal ldan 'jigarten mgon po yis/ /gdul bya'i blo mun bsal ba'i phyir/ /thabasamakhasalha mo'i skur sprul pa/ /dpal mo dbyangasacan ma la 'dud/ /sgrub thabasamachod pa'i cho gni/ /man ngagabacasapa mdor bsdusate/ /blo ldan gzhan la phan don du/ /cung zad yi ge'i lam du spel/ /'di la bsnyen pa'i man ngag dang / mchod pa'i cho ga dang /nyer mkho'i man ngagaste gsum las/ dang po ni/ skyabasa'agro semasabaskyed tshad med bzhi rnamasaspyo dang mthun/ bla ma yi dam sangabashargyas byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs thams cad mdun du bzhugs par gyur/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi/ sogasayan lagabadun pa tshar gsum bya/ oṃ swa bhā wa shud+dha sarba dharma swa bhā wa shud+dhi3haṃ/ stong pa'i ngang las bh+rūṃ las snod kyi 'jig rten lha dang drang srong dri za grub pa'i tshogs kyis bsten pa'i gnas/ ri bo nags tshal sman ljongs nyams dga' ba'i dbus/ 'o ma'i rgya mtsho dkar la dwangs pa'i nang du/ paṃ las pad+ma dkar po 'dab ma 'bum phrag rgyas pa'i sdong po/ de'i steng du a lasazla ba'i dkyil 'bor/ de'i steng du rang sems hrīḥdakar po yongs su gyur pa las/ rang nyid sgra dbyangasalha mo dbyangs can ma sku mdog dkar mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis/ skyil krung phyed pa tsog bu'i 'dug stangs can/ zhal ras zla ba nya gang ba lta bu/ āt+pal ltar bkra —36

ba'i spyan zung g.yo bas mdzes pa/ phyag g.yon pasabe+eḍūr+ya'i rgyud mang 'dzin zhing / g.yas pa'i phyag sor gyi 'du byed kyis bskul bsasgra dbyangs rgya mtsho mngon par sgrub pa/ bung ba ltar gnag pa'i skra tshogs phyed stag par bcings shing / phyed gsil bur grol bas sku stod khyab pa/ pad+ma dkar po'i phreng ba'i thod bcings dang / rin po che'i sna tshogs pas skra'i zar bu mdzes pa/ bcu drug lon pa'i lang tsho can/ nu 'bur mtho la rgyas pa/ sked skabasaphra zhing sgeg la 'dzum pa'i nyamasacan/ lha rdzas kyi stod g.yogs dkar po dang / smad g.yogasadabang po'i gzhu ltar bkra ba'i lhab lhub g.yo ba/ nor bu rin po che'i rgyan du masarnam par brgyan pa ni/ gtsug gi nor bu/ snyan rgyan/ mgul rgyan/ phyag gdub/ zhabs gdub/ song gdub/ ska rags/ do shal/ se mo do/ g.yer kha'i phreng la sogs pas brgyan pa'o/ /rang gi snying chu shing gi me rtag ltar kha thur du lta ba de nyid gyen du langs pas ut+pal dmar po kha 'bus pa'i rnam pa can du gyur pa'i nang du/ oṃ dkar po/ rlung cung zad phyir bsal/ oṃ gyi nā da las 'od zer dkar po 'phros/ sna bug g.yas nas thon/ lho phyogasargya mtsho'i 'gram rig 'dzin dga' ba'i tshal na lha mo dbyangasacan ma bzhugs pa'i shangasabug g.yon nas zhugs/ thugasaka nasango bo ye shes sems dpa'/ rnam pa dbyangs can gyi 'khor lo 'od zer 'bar ba spyan drangasate/ shangs bug g.yas nas thon/ skad cig gis byon te/ rang gi mdun gyi nam mkhar bzhugs pa la glo bur du byung ba'i mchod pa nam mkha' gang bsamachod par gyur/ oṃ pri ti de wī dī bya puskro hūṃ/ de bzhi du sbyar te/dhū pe/ garnye/ ni we te/ ā lo ke rma dziti de wī—37

par dang / /sna rdzas bdud rtsi'i4zhal zasani/ /bco ba'i bye brag 'bum dang sbyar/ /bzhes nas byin gyis brlab par mdzod/ /ni we te/ de las gzhan yang mgo pa'i tshogs/ /rol mo dbyangs snyan yid 'ong ldan/ /sems can sdug bsngal tshim byed pa'i/ /sprin rnams sosor gnas gyur cig /shap+ta/ de nasaspro na rgyal srid sna bdun/ 'dod yon lnga/ bkra shisartagasabargyad/ rdzasabargyad la sogasapa rnamasakyisamachod/bstod pa ni/ spyan ras gzigs dbang mche ba'i rtse mo las ni mdzo sprul zhing / /thogs med rnam 'phrul mtha' yas rol pasarjes su bzung ba'i phyir/ /sgos pa'i bu mokhyod sku rab tu gsal ba'i rnam khrur can/ /bis gzugs brnyan gtum po rab dga' bskyed pa'i tshul 'dzin ma/ /rjes su chags lag tsha sgyu mithog tsharāni/ rme mi thog tsho rme mi la mi lag tshobacas ral pa' la brgyad gnyas lan pa' nyams/ /chu gtar 'gram ngags sbu ba'i phreng bas rtse ba'i dga' ba can/ /dri za'i bu mos mgo bstod nyid kyi rnam thar phul byung rnams/ /gang gis yid la dran byed de la ngag gi dngos grub myur du stsol/ kho bos khyod dran ba spu shas sto g.yos pa'i lag pa yis/ /thal sbyar me tog gzhon nu kha 'bus lta bu spyi bo'i steng / /rab bzhag snying nas gus pa lhur byed khyod kyi yon to che/ /mtha' dag rtogs min 'dir ni sdeb sbyor legasapa'i phreng bsamardzo/ /de ltar khyod bstod lhur len gang yin de ni yon to gyis/ /dbusa'agyur sna tshogs rig pa'i gzhung las rab skyes chos kyi don/ /myur rtogasas gsum skye dgu'i gzhung sgron gti mug mun pa rnams/ /rab bsal skye bos rgyal ba'i dbang po 'od dpag med 'dra thob par shog/cesapa dang gas yang tshig don phun sum tshogasapa'i bstod pa ci shesakyisabastod do/ /—41—

tshogasakyis bskor ba oṃ badz+ra samā dzaḥ zhesapasaspyan drangs/ gong ltar mchod/ o.a nyiṣiñtsan+tu me sarba ta thā ga ta/ zhesagasol ba bto pas/ ji ltar bltamasapa tsam gyis ni/ /lha rnams kyis ni khrus gsol ltar/ /lha yi chu ni dag pa yis/ /de bshin bdag gis khrus bya'o/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shrī ye hūṃ/ zhes gsungasashing bum pa bdud rtsisagang bsadabang bskur/ sku gang / dri ma dag/chu lhag ma yar lud pa lasadon yod grub pas dbu brgyan/ dbang gi lha de rnams rje btsun ma sgrol ma'i skur gyur te rang la thim/ dzaḥ& baṃ hoḥ thal mo sbyar ba'i mdzub mo gnyis gung mo'i rgyab tu sbyar/ srin mdzub gnyis bkug ste/ mdzum mo mnan pa ut+pa la'i phyag gyodapral mgrin snying ga dpung pa rnams su reg cing yi ge bcu pa tshar rebarjod pas byin gyisabarlungs te sku snang la rang bzhin med pa la semasayun ring du gtad/ skyon (spro na thugs gar zla ba'i steng du tswayig gi mthar yi ge bcu pa kha dog dkar po mgo bo gyen du blta bas bskor bar bsamasal/ de la klog pa'i tshul du/ oṃ tā re tut+ta rotu re swāhā/ zhesapa'i yi go༅ pa sngo bor bzla/ spro na/ na mo rat+na tā yā ya/ na ma ār+sha a wa loki ti shwa rā ya/bodhisatā ya/ mahā satwa ya/ mahā ka ru ṇi kā ya/ tat+ya thā/ oṃ tā re tustu re tu re ma ma kri te sarba dus/ pra du// j-i bha ya/ s+t+waṃ bha ya/ mo hā ya/ ban+dha ya/ hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa/ sarba du/ sto bha ni tā re swāhā/ zhes gzungs ring yang ci nus bzla/mthar 'dod don zhus la/ bsngob dang smon lam bya zhing / spro na sa mtshamasasums brgya rtsa brgyad pa dang / gzungasaring ci nusakyi mthar phyaga'atshal nyer gcig gisabastod la/ gtor ma 'bul bar 'dod na/ dkar gtor mchod pa spyi mthun dang bcasapa bshams/ mchod pa byin rlabasakyang —51

bstod pa bya/ gtor ma gong ltar phul la/ mdun bskyed la dmigasapa'i bzlasapa cung zad bya/ slob ma rnamasakhrusabyasamaṇ+ḍal phul/ dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad dang / /sogasakyisagasol ba btab/ dkon mchoge gsum la bdag skyabs mchi/ /sogasakyis rgyun bltas bya/ de nas rjes gnang gi gzhi dgod pa'i slad du slob dpon la rje btsun ma dngos yin snyam pa'i mos pa byas pas de'i thugs ga'i 'od zer gyis mdun bskyed kyi thugs brgyud bskul/ thugs ka nas 'od zer ljang khu dpag tu med pa 'phrosate/ slob ma'i lusal phog pas sdig sgrib dang bar du gcod pa thamasacad sbyangs/ lus 'od kyi rang bzhin du gyur par bsam/ de'i skad cig la paṃ las pad ma dang a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/ snrolas ut+pal 〉gis mtshan pa de las 'od zer 'phrosadon gnyis byas/ tshur 'dusayongs su gyur pa las/ slob ma rnams sgrub thabasaltar rje btsun mar bskyed/ slar slob dpon la mos gus byas pas/ de'i thugasaka'i 'od zer gyisamadun bskyed dang phyogs bcu'i sangasargyas byang sems thams cad kyi thugs ka nasarje btsun ma'i sku bsam gyis mi khyab pa spyan drangs te/ slob ma la thim par bsamasal/sngagasabazlasashing dril sil bya ba ni gzhi 'god pa'o/ /dngosal gsum las/ dang po rjesasubazlasapa'i lung ni/ slob dpon gyisabadag la/rje btsun ma sgrol ma'i mtshan brgya rtsabargyad pa'i lung dang gsang sngags kyi rjes su gnang ba ma lusapa stsal du gsol/ zhesalan gsum gyisagasol ba btab/ de nasaslob dpon gyi thugs ga'i sngags 'phreng sa bon dang bcas pa lasade 'dra ba du ma byung nasazhal nasathon/ slob ma'i zhal du zhugs/ thugs gar zla ba la —53

gshegasapa thams cad kyisabadag la mngon par dbang bskur ba stsal du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ sangs rgyas rnams kyis oṃ badzi bhā wa a bhi ṣiñtsa hūṃ/ zhesagasung zhing bum pa'i chus spyi bo nas dbang bskur/ sku gang dri ma dgachu lhag ma yar lud pa las/ 'od dpag tu med pasadabu brgyan/ de'i dpral bar oṃ las 'khor lo oṃ gyisamatshan pa las rnam par snang mdzad dmar po byang chub mchog gi phyag rgya mdzad pa/ mgrin par āḥlasapad+ma āḥyis mtshan pa las 'od dpag med dmar po mnyam bzhag gi phyag rgya mdzad pa/thugs gar hūṃ lasardo rje hūṃ gis mtshan pa lasami bskyod pa dmar po g.yas sa gnon/ g.yon mnyam bzhag gi phyag rgya mdzad pa/ de gsum gyi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phrosapas/ phyogs bcu'i sangasargyas dang byang chub semasadapa' thams cad de bzhin gshegs pa rigasagasum gyi rnam par oṃ badz+ra samā dzaḥdzaḥsnyi baṃ hoḥ lha gsum la sosor thim zhing / de gsum 'od zer kha dog dmar po'i rnam par zhu nas rang gi lus ngag yid gsum dang dbyer med du gyur/pad+ma'i phreng ba phrin lag gi steng nas drangasate/ oṃ wā shaṃ ku ru ho oṃ ku su ma/mā li bhi hūṃ dzaḥ chabadz+ra ku sa dzi kai dzhaiḥ ṭha ṭha ṭha/ oṃ gro ge ma kri te/ 'gro ba mang po wā shaṃ ku ru hoḥ ka ka dha ya ka dha ya/ kha khā hi khā hi/ ga gardza ya gardza ya/gha gha ta ya gha ta ya/ tsa tsa la ya tsa la ya/ tsha tsha ta ya tsha ta ya/ dza j-i bha ya j-i bha ya/ dzha dzha ta ya dzha ta ya/ ṭa ṭa la ya ṭa la ya/ ṭha ṭha ka ya ṭha ka ya/ ḍa ḍa bha ya ḍa bha ya/ rte lha ka ya rte ka ya/ ṇa ṇa sha ya ṇa sha ya/ ta haṃ bha ya haṃ bha ya/ tha tho bha ya tho bha ya/ da da ra ya da ra ya/ dha dha ra ya dha ra ya/ na nā sha ya nā sha ya/ pa pa —64

slad du dmigasapa 'di bzhin mdzod/ slob dpon dang mdun bskyed kyi khro bo'i thugasaka nas 'od zer 'phros pa/ khyed rang gi lusal phog pas tshe thog ma med pa nas bsagasapa'i sdig sgrib bag chagasadang bcas pa thams cad sbyangs te/lus dri ma dang bral ba'i rang bzhin du gyur par mos pa mdzod/ de la dmigasate slob dpon gyis oṃ shā n+ya ta sogs/ mi bskyod pa'i dbu rgyan zhesapa'i bar/ de ltar khyed rang khro bo chen por gsal ba'i mdun du baiḍūr+ya'i brag ri'i khrod du nas/'od dpag med kyis dbu rgyan zhesapa'i bar brjod de/ tshogs bdag spyan 'dren skabasarol chen bya'o/ de sku'i rjes gnang yin/ gsung gi rjesaganang gi slad du dmigs pa 'di bzhin mdzod/ slob dpon gyi thugs ga'i hūṃ yig sngags 'phreng dang bcas pa las sngags kyi phreng ba byung / zhal nasathon/ khyed rang gi zhal du zhugs/thugasaka'i hūṃ yig gi mthar g.yasabaskor du 'khod par mos pa byas nas/ tshetog dang bcas pa'i thal mo sbyar te/ 'di'i rjes zlos lan gsum mdzod/ oṃ sum+bha sogasanas/ hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ tsesabarjod nas/ khyed rang gi mdun gyi dpal tshogasakyi bdag po'i thugs ga'i gaḥyig las sngags phreng byung ba khyed rang khro bo chen por gsal ba'i lte ba'i gnas su thim par mos nas/ sngags 'di rnams kyi rjes zlos lan gsum gsum mdzod/ :rdzo āḥg2PROB/ zhesasogasasngags tshan bzhi po lan gsumabazlosapas/ dang pos rgyud byin gyis brlabs/ gnyis pasadabyer med du byas/gsum pas brtan par byas par mos te/ slob dpon la drin lan gyi tshul du me tog gtor nasa'adi'i rjesazlosamadzod/ bcom ldan bdag la gsanas/ mdzad du gsol zhesagasol ba btab/ slob dpon gyis kyang me tog gi phreng ba sngags —73—

bcasarten gtor slob ma'i lag tu gtad de/ sngagasarnamasakyi mthar dpal tshogs kyi bdag pos rdo rje slob ma 'di rnams kyi lus dang grib ma bzhin du 'grogasanas/ dus da nas gzung ste byang chub ma thob kyi bar du/ 'gal rkyen bar chad mimathun pa'i phyogs thams cad zhi ba dang / bsrung ba dang bskyab pa dang / sba ba'i 'phrin las mdzod cigamathun rkyen tshe dang bsod nams dang dpal 'byor dang dbang phyug thams cad gong rinas gong du 'phel zhing rgyas pa'i 'phrin las mdzod cigalha 'dre mi gsum gyi 'gro ba mang po dbang du bsdus nas/ zas gos longs spyod thams cad kyis 'phongs pa med par yid bzhin du 'byor ba dang / de dag gisakyang sangs rgyasakyi bstan pa dang semasacan mang po la phan pa dang bde ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa 'byung ba dang / mthar thug rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob pa'i 'phrin las mdzod cigacesabaka' bsgos pas tshogasakyi bdag pos de ltar zhal gyis bzhesate khyed rang gi phyi bzhin du 'brangasapa'i mos pa mdzod/ de nas mdun bskyed kyi nam mkha' na bzhugs pa'i khro bo chen po'i thugs ka nas khro bo chen pa'i sku de 'dra ba zhig byon pa khyed rang gi spyi gtsug nas zhugs te/ snying gar pad+ma dang nyi ma'i gdan la bzhugasanas rgyud byin gyis brlabs pa yin snyam du mos pa mdzod/ de rnamasakyis khro bo chen po dang dpal tshogs kyi bdag po'i rjes su gnang ba grub pa yin/ de dag gi gnasaskabasasu thob pa'i dam tshig la bsrung sdom bgyi snyam pasa'adi'i rjes zlos kyis/ gtso bos maṇ+ḍal/ deng nas sogasaspyi dang 'dra/ lha gnyisal mchod de tshom bu'i lha gshegasasugasogabrisasku brtan bzhugasabya/ lhag ma gong dang 'dra'o/ /kun las khungasache rgyud lasagasal/ /lasatshogs77

phyir sangs rgyas 'grub par 3(ga/lan gsum/ oṃ swa bhā wa shud+dha sarba dharma swa bhā wa shuzlonyunya/ stong pa'i ngang lasarin po che'i khri phyogs bzhir bdud bzhi mtshamasabazhin seng ge bzhis bteg pa'i steng du/ pad+ma dang zla ba'i dkyil 'khor la hūṃ las rdo rje ser po hūṃ gis mtshan pa/ de yongs su gyur pa las bdag nyid thub pa rdo rje gdan sku mdog gser btso ma lta bu zhal gcig phyag gnyisapa g.yasas gnon/ g.yon ting nge 'dzin gyi phyag rgya can/ zhabs rdo rje'i skyil krung gis bzhugs shing / na bza' chos gos ngur smrig gsol ba/ dbu gtsug tor dang bcas pa/ tshangs par spyod pa'i cha lugasacan/ de'i g.yas su byamasapa ser po/ g.yas rin po che'i rnga yab/ g.yon klu shing gi yal ga me tog dang bcas pa bsnamasapa/ g.yon na spyan ras gzigs dkar po/ g.yas rin po che'i rnga tshoyab/ g.yon pad+ma bsnamasapa/ gnyis ga'ang rin po che'i rgyan dang / dar sna tshogs kyi sham thabasacan/ bcom ldan 'das kyi zhal la lta ba'o/ /de rnamasakyi dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugasakar hūṃ/ hūṃ las 'od zer 'phros pas/phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad/ thub pa rdo rje gdan gtso 'khor gyi rnam par oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ obadz+ra e ku sha dzaḥ o badz+ra pā sha hūṃ/ oṃ badz+ra slo ṭa baṃ/ chabadz+ra a pesha āḥ gnyisasu med par thim/ de dag gi phyagargya spyi 'gro ltar mdzad/ yang snying ga'i hūṃ lasa'od 'phros/ de bzhin gshegs pa rigasalnga 'khor dang bcas pa badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ khyed rnamasakyisabadag la mngon par dbang bskur ba stsal du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shrī ye hūṃ/ zhesagasungs shing dbang bskur —81—

'khor dang bcas pa'i sku che chung ma nges pa dpag tu med pa byon/ khyed rang rnams kyi spyi gtsug la sogs pa dang ba spu'i bu ga rnamasanasachar babasapa bzhin du sib sib thim par mos mdzod/ dzaḥ& baṃ hoḥganyisasu med par thim/de dag ni rjes gnang gi gzhi dgod pa'o/ /rjes gnang dngos la/ lung gsum las/ dang po rjes su bzlas pa'i lung blang ba'i phyir/ slob dpon gyi snying gar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hūṃ ser po/ de lasasngags kyi phreng ba byung slob dpon gyi kha nasathon/ khyed rang rnamasakyi zhal du zhugs/ thugs gar zla ba'i steng du hūṃ ser po gnas pa la thim/ de'i dusasu phyogs bcu'i sangasargyas byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi mkhyen brtse nus mthu thamasacad 'od zer gyi rnam par sngags 'phreng dang lhan cig zhal du zhugs/ snying ga'i hūṃ la thim pa'i mos pa mdzod la/ sngags 'di'i rjesazlosalan gsum gsungasashigam āḥbadz+ra hūṃ swāhā/ dang pos byin gyis brlabs/ gnyis pas dbyer med du 'dres/ gsum pas brtan par byasapa'i mosapa mdzod/ gnyis pa byin gyis brlab pa'i lung ni/ slob dpon la me tog 'thor bzhin du 'di'i rjesazlosamadzod cigabacom ldan bdag gisabazung lagasakyi/ /bdag la 'go bar mdzad du gsol/ /cesalan gsum/ de ltar phul ba'i me tog de nyid slar yang byin gyisabarlabasate/ khyed rang gi spyi bor phul bar mosapa mdzod cigaslob dpon gyisame togagasto ṣ+ka /bcosaldan 'di la stsal lagasakyi/ /'di la 'go bar mdzad du gsol/ /brtul zhugs brtan par mdzad du gsol/ /sngags kyi dngosagrub stsal du gsol//rig pa 'dzin pa 'di rnamasal bcom ldan 'dasathub pa rdo rje gdan 'khor —85

te āḥ&/ oṃ badz+ra shap+ta a:sgri dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabasamachi/ /sdig pa thams cad sosor bshags/ /'gro ba'i dge la rjes yi rang / /sangs rgyasabyang chub yid kyis bzung / /sangs rgyas chos dang tshogs mchog la/ /byang chub bar du skyabs su mchi/ /rang bzhin don ni rab sgrub phyir/ /byang chub sems ni bskyed par bgyis/ /byang chub mchog gi semasani bskyed bgyis nas/ /sems can thams cad bdag gis mgron du gnyer/ /byang chub spyod mchog yid 'ong spyad par bgyi/ /'gro la phan phyir sangs rgyasa'agrub par shog /lan gsum/ oṃ swa bhā wa shud+dha sarba dharma swa bhā wa shud+dhi3nya/ stong pa'i ngang las paṃ ljang khu lasasna tshogs pad+ma paṃ gyis mtshan pa dang / a las zla ba'i gdan la traṃ yig gser gyi mdog can/ de las 'od 'phrosa'adus yongasasu gyur pa las/rang nyid bcom ldan 'dasadam tshig gsum bkod rgyal po sku mdog gser ltar 'bar ba/ tshangs par spyod pa'i cha lugasacan/ mtshan dang dpe byad yongasasu rdzogs pa/ zhabasardo rje'i skyil krung can/ phyag gnyis thugs gar chos 'chad kyi phyag rgya mdzad pa/ na bza' chosagosarnam gsum gsol ba'o/ /sku'i g.yasasu rdo rje 'dzin ser po phyag gnyis thugasakar thal mo sbyar bas rdo rje ser po 'dzin pa/ g.yon du rdo rje 'dzin ma ser mo g.yasanor bu dang / g.yon rdo rje 'dzin pa/g.yon gyi mdun du bu momatha' yas ma ljang khu g.yas phyag 'tshal tshul dang /g.yon pad+ma 'dzin pa/ 'khor de gsum zhi ba/ dar dang rin po chesabargyan zhing bzhugasapa'o/ /g.yas kyi mdun du khye'u mtha' yasapa dmar po g.yasagri gug dang / g.yon thod pa me tog gisagang ba 'dzin pa/ khro bo'i cha byad rdzogs shing /—89
