stag lpagasadang / sprul gyisabargyan pa/ g.yon brkyang pa'i/ de rnams kyi dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugasakar hūṃ/ hūṃ lasa'od zer 'phrosapas/phyogs bcu'i sangasargyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thamasacad thubapa dam tshig gsum bkod gtso 'khor gyi rnam par oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ chabadz+ra aṅku sha dzaḥ.oṃ badz+ra pā sha hūṃ/ oṃ badz+ra spro ṭa baṃ/ oṃ badz+ra a be sha āḥ gnyis su med par thim/ yang snying ga'i hūṃ lasa'od 'phros/ de bzhin gshegs pa rigasalnga 'khor dang bcas pa badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ khyed rnamasakyisabadag la mngon par dbang bskur ba stsal du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sam ya shrī ye hūṃ/ zhesagasung zhing dbang bskur ba'i bcom ldan 'das la rnam snang / 'bor rnamasal gtso bosadabu brgyan/ na maḥste ya dhi kā māṃ/ ta thā ga ta kā nai/ sarba tra a pra ti ha ta bsti/ dharma tā bā lirna/ e a sam/ sa man+ta to/ a nan+ta bstoshā sa / ha ra ha ra/ sma ra sma ra ṇa/ bi ga tā rā gabarnya dharma te/sa ra sar/ sa ma bā la/ ha saha sa/ tra ya tra ya/ ga ga na mahā wa ra ṇa/ lak+ṣa ṇi/ dz+wa la dz+wa la/ na swā ga re swāhā/ zhesabazlasal/ mthar sku gsung thugasadang pon tan 'phrin las kyis/ bdag dang sems can thamasacad la byin gyisabarlab tu gsol/ dzaḥ& baṃ hoḥ 'khor bzhi po rang la thim/ oṃ a mṛ te hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ swa bhā wa shud+dha sarba dharma swa bhā wa shurnyo3nya/ stong pa'i ngang lasarin po che'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba rnams kyi nang du oṃ zhu ba las byung ba'i mchod yon/ zhabasabasil/me togabadug spos/ mar me/ dri/ zhalazas/ rol mo rnamasadwangasashing thogs pa med pa/ 'phags pa kun tu bzang po'i rnam par thar pa lasabyung ba'i mchod —90

de rjes gnang dngosagazhi la gsum las/ dang po'i sku'i rjes gnang ni/de nasaslob dpon yang rang gis bsgom pa dang 'dra ba'i thub pa dam tshig gsum bkod dngos yin snyam pa'i mosagus byas pas slob dpon gyi thugs ka nasa'od zer 'phros/ mdun bskyed kyi lha'i thugs brgyud bskul/ de'i thugasaka nas 'od zer 'phros/ phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyasabyang sems thams cad kyi thugs rgyud bskul bas/ slob dpon dang mdun bskyed kyi lha dang phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thamasacad kyi thugs ka nas thub pa dam tshig gsum bkod 'khor dang bcas pa'i sku che chung ma ngesapa dpag tu med pa byon/ khyod rang rnams kyi spyi gtsug la sogasapa dang ba spu'i bu ga rnams nas char babs pa bzhin du sib sib thim par mos pa mdzod/ dzaḥsnyi baṃ hoḥganyisasu med par thim/ dril bu dang ting shaga'akhrol/ rol mo bya/ mngon rtogs kyi dbang blta ba'i dmigasapa de phog la/ dbu rgyan gyi bar brjod do/ /gnyisapa gsung gi rjes gnang ni/ slob dpon gyi snying gar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hūṃ ser po/ de las sngags kyi phreng ba byung / slob dpon gyi kha nas thon/ khyed rang rnams kyi zhal du zhugs/ thugs gar zla ba'i steng du hūṃ ser po gnas pa la thim/ de'i dus su phyogasabacu'i sangasargyas dang byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi mkhyen brtse nusamathu thamasacad 'od zer gyi rnam par sngags phreng dang lhan cig zhal du zhugs/ snying ga'i hūṃ la thim paba'imobashapa mdzod la/ sngags 'di'i rjes zlos lan gsum gsungasashig na maḥste sogasabarjod/ dang posabyin gyisabarlabs/ gnyis pasadabyer med du 'dres/ gsum —93

shākya seṅge yis/ /sangasargyasabastan pa gang gi phyag tu bzhag/gsung rab rin wo sgom gyi kha 'byed pa/ /chos skyong dgra bcom r+pā po bzhugasasu 'tshal/ /dam chos spel ba'i slad du spyan 'dren gyi/ /'gro ba'i don du mchod —phyir gshegasasu gsol/ /spangasadang ye shes phun tshogasasangasargyas te/ /gdul bya'i dbang gis nyan thos tshul 'dzin zhing / khyad par can gyi 'phrin las chos skyong ba'i/ /gnas brtan bcu drug 'dir byon gdan la bzhugs/ /zhes brjod pasarang bzhin gyi gnas nas/ thub pa gnas brtan chen po bcu drug gi 'khor dang bcas pa phyi bzhin 'brang ba dge bsnyen dharmā pā la/ rgyal po chen po sde bzhi'i tshogs dang bcas pa rang rang gi gdan la bzhugasapar gyur/ dbus su bcom ldan 'dasade bzhin gshegs pa dpal rgyal ba shākya thub pa sku gser mdog g.yas sa gnon dang / g.yon mnyam bzhag gi phyag rgya mdzad pa/ zhabs rdo rje'i skyil krung gisabazhugs pa/ phyi bskor gyi pad+ma rnamasal shar nasarim pa bzhin du g.yas skor gyis/ yan lag 'byung sposaphor dang rnga yab/ ma pham pa mnyam bzhag/nagasan gnas sdigs mdzub dang rnga yab/ dus ldan gser gyi rna bskor/ rdo rje mo'i bu sdigs mdzub dang rnga yab/ bzang po chosa'achad mnyam bzhagagaser be'u rin po che'i zhagasapa/ bha ra dh+wa dza gser can mnyam bzhagab ku la ne'u le/ sgra gcan 'dzin rin po che'i dbrog zhu/ lam phran brtan mnyam bzhagabha ra dh+wa dza bsod snyoms len glegs bam lhung bzed/ lam brtan chosa'achad glegs bam/ klu'i sde bum pa mkhar bsil/ sbed byed glegasabam/ mi phyed pa byang chub mchod rten 'dzin pa rnams dgra bcom gnas brtan dbang po —96

rab tu byung ba'i cha lugs can/ phyag g.yasamachog sbyin gyi mthil na a ru ra rgyas pa 'dzin pa/ g.yon mnyam bzhag gi steng na be+eḍūr+ya'i lhung bzed bdud rtsis gang ba bsnams pa/ dar dmar pos chos gos rnam gsum gsol ba/ pad zla la rdo rje'i skyil krung gisabazhugs pa/ mtshan dpe yongs su rdzogs pa'i skur gyur/ thugs gar zla ba oṃ sngon po/ de las 'od zer lcags kyu dang zhags pa lta bu spros/ ye shes pa badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ dzaḥ& baṃ hoḥ g.yas su a las byang semasazla ba ltar snang byed dkar po/ g.yon du me lasanyi ma ltar snang byed dmar ser/ gnyis ga'ang thal mo sbyar ba rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa'o//rang gi spyi bor oṃ/ mgrin pa āḥ thugs gar hūṃ/ na mo bha ga wa te/ bhe ṣa bh+yo gu ru be+eḍūr+ya/ pra bha rā dza ya/ ta thā ga tā ya/ arta te samyakle bud+dha ya/ tabya thā/ oṃ ste ṣa rdzu bhe ṣa rdzu/ mahā ste ṣa rdzu/ sa mud ga te swāhā/ zhesapa dang / oṃ man chad khon bzla ba'i lugasakyang yod de/ 'bum bzlasapas bsnyen pa'o/ /'jug tu ye shesapa mdun du bzhugasapar mosal/ bzang spyod nasa'abyung ba'i yan lag bdun pa bya/ 'dod don gsol btab dge ba bsngo/ yig brgya gshegasagasol rnamasaspyi dang mthun par bya/'di'i rjesaganang bya thabasani/ maṇ+ḍal gcig la tshom bu bdun gral rim du bkod/ mchod pa rgya —cher bshams/ byin rlabasamado chog bzhin byasakyang rung mod kyi/ spyi dang mthun par bya/ bdagabaskyed gong bzhin sngon du btang nas/ maṇ+ḍal bh+rūṃ las byung ba'i gzhal yas khang gi dbus n+da/tshom bu rnams pad zla'i gdan re rer gyur/ rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros/bde bar gshegasapa bdun 'khor dang bcas pa badz+ra samā dzaḥ ma lusasemasacan ma tshar r+sāgabarjod/ pad+ma ka ma la ya s+t+waṃ lan bdun/ dbusasu bcom ldan 'das—100

sman gyi bla zhesapa nas/ brgyan pa'o/ /g.yas kyi gdan gsum la rim pas de bzhin gshegs pa mngon mkhyen rgyal po sku mdog dmar po g.yasamachog sbyin dang / g.yon mnyam bzhag/chos sgrags rgya mtsho'i dbyangs sku mdog dmar po g.yas mchog sbyin dang g.yon mnyam bzhagamya ngan med mchog dpal sku mdog dmar skya phyag gnyis mnyam bzhagagayon gyi gdan gsum la rim pas/ gser bzang dri med sku mdog dkar ser g.yas chos 'chad/ g.yon mnyam bzhagarin chen zla ba sku mdog dmar ser g.yas chos 'chad/ g.yon mnyam bzhagamatshan legs sku mdog ser po/ g.yas chos 'chad/ g.yon mnyam bzhag mdzad pa'o/ /arnya nasashap+ta'i bar gyisamachod/ rgyal srid sna bdun/ 'dod yon sna lnga/ bkra shisartagasabargyad/ rdzasabargyad sogasakyisamachod pa'ang spro na bya/ bzang spyod kyi yan lag bdun pa tshar gsum/ de nasabazlasapa ci 'grub bya'o/ /gal te mdo chog yongasardzogasal brten nasabasgrubasan/bdag bskyed sngon du btang nas/ rjesachog ma gtogasacho ga tshar ba na bzlasapa gang 'grub bya'o/ /slob ma'i bya ba ni khrus byasamaṇ+ḍal phul zhing / bla ma rdo rje 'dzin pa la sogasapa phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyasadang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad bdag la dgongs su gsol/bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi ba/ dus 'di nas gzung ste/ snying po byang chub la mchosakyi bar du/ bcom ldan 'das sman gyi bla be+eḍūrla 'od kyi rgyal po yi darmi du 'tshal gyi/ slob dpon gyis bdag la lung stsal du gsol/ lan gsum/ bzang spyod kyi yan lag bdun pa lan gsum/ skyabasasemasargyasapar 'bogasapa'am/ sangasargyas chosadangam lan gsum/ de nasa'adi skad ces/ khyed rang rnams tha mal bar gnasapa'i spyibor bcom ldan 'das sman gyi bla zhesapa nas/ brgyan pa'o/ /dbu gtsug tu bla ma'i ngo —101 ci

gzhal yas khang / de'i nang du pad zla'i gdan la skad cig gis rdo rje semasadapa' dkar po dkar nag dmar pa'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi dang po gnyis kyis rang snang gi yum la 'byud pa/ lhag ma g.yas gnyis kyis rdo rje dang / ral gri/ g.yon gnyis kyis pad+ma dang 'khor lo 'dzin pa'o/ /'di ni shin tu bsdusapa la dga' ba'i dbang du byasakyi/ shesashing spro na lugasa'adi'i mngon byang lnga bskyed nyid bsgomasan ngesapar legasapa yin no/ /yab yum rjes su chags pa snyoms par zhugs pas/ nam mkha'i yi ge lnga po yab kyi zhal du zhugs/ sku'i dbyibs brgyud/ yum gyi mkhar babs/yi ge lnga'i 'od zer gyis yab yum byang chub kyi sems kyi ngo bor zhu/ thig le las lha mo bzhi spros/ sems can khams na gnas kyi dbang phyug khyod ni rdo rje'i thugs/ /dga' ba yid 'ong don chen 'dod pas bdag la bskyab tu gsol/ /mgon po gal te de ring bdag ni gson par mchi zhe na/ /sems can yab chen gnyen mchog bdag la dgyes par mdzad du gsol/ /rdo rje'i sku khyod bka'i 'khor lo sems can kun la phan/ /sangs rgyas don du byang chub don dam rjes su phan 'dod pa/ /mgon po gal te de ring bdag ni gson par mchi zhe na/ /'dod chags dam tshig chags pasabadag la dgyes par mdzad du ga〈le/khyod ni rdo rje'i gsung ste kun la phan zhing thugs brtse ba/ /'jig rten dag gi dgos pa'i don mdzad pa la rtag tu brtson/ /mgon po rab dga'i spyod pa kun tu bzang pos bdag la khyod ni rdo rje 'dod pa dam tshig mchog gi phan don che/ /yang dag rdzogs sangs rgyas kyi gdung mchog mnyam pa nyid gzigs pa/ /mgon po yon tan rin chen mang po'i gter gyur bdag la dgyesapar —107

mdzod/ /ces bskul nasathim pa las/ thig le de nyid me las ral gri me gyis mtshan par gyur/ de las dkyil 'khor spros/ sems can gyi don byas/ /sangs rgyas thams cad tshur 'dus/ thim pa yongs su gyur pa las/ rang nyid 'jam pa'i rdo rje zhal gsum phyag drug pa/ rtsa zhal dang sku lus gur gum gzhon nu ltar dmar ser/ g.yas sngo/ g.yon dkar ba'i zhal/ phyag dang po gnyis rang snang gi yum la 'khyud pa/ lhag ma g.yasaganyis ral gri dang mda'/ g.yon gnyis ut+pal sngon po'i sdong bu dang / gzhu 'dzin pa/ pad zla'i gdan la rdo rje skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa/ ral pa'i zur phud lnga dang ldan zhing / nyi ma'i 'od zer 'phro ba/ dar dang rin po ches spras pa'o/ /yum yang yab dang mtshungs pa las/lha mo'i cha byad rdzogs shing / pad+ma'i skyil krung gis 'byud pa/ zla 'od 'phro ba'o/ /oṃ dharma dhā tu swa bhā wa āt+pa ko3nya/ mig tu k+ṣa las sa snying / rna bar dzi lasaphyag rdor/ snar khaṃ las nam snying / lcer rga las spyan ras gzigs/dpral bar ske las sgrib sel/ lte bar saṃ las kun bzang / dpral bar skyesgo las sku rdo rje/ mgrin par āḥlas gsung rdo rje/ snying gar hūṃ las thugasardo rje/de rnams las 'od 'phros/ sangs rgyas thams cad sku gsung thugs rdo rje'i rnam par spyan drangs/ gnas gsum gyi rdo rje gsum la thim/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta kā ya badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+pa ko3lha/ oṃ waka skyed tsit+ta haṃ/ rang gi snying gar rang dang 'dra ba'i ye shes sems dpa'/ de'i thugs gar ral gri'i yu bar me gyisamatshan pa ni ting nge 'dzin sems dpa'o/ /de'i 'od zer gyis dbang gi lha spyan drangs/ byang chub rdo rje sangasargyas la/ /gosakyis gsol ba bto/ dbang bskur rdo—108

mthong nasagasal bar bris/ /'di 'phagasaskor dang mthun shasache yang / sgeg pa'i rdo rje'i lugasayin par shesapar bya'o/ /gsang ba 'dusapa lhan cig skyesapa'i sgrub thabasakyi le tshan no// //da༅༅/ /chaswā sti/ dpal ldan bde chen mgon po la/ /rtag tu gusapa'i yid kyisa'adud//sgyu 'phrul chen po'i rim las 'ongs/ /dran pa gcig pa bshad par bya/ /grub pa'i slob dpon bya da lisamadzad pa'i mahā mā ya'i sgrub thabasadran pa gcig pa sgom par 'dod na/ rang gi snying ga'i hrīḥ'i 'od kyis/ bla ma dang dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo mdun gyi nam mkhar phe/ zhesaspyan drangs/ yid kyi sprul pa'i phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod pasamachod par gyur/ dkon mchoge gsum la bdag skyabs mchi/ /chogasayan lag bdun pa tshar gsum bya/shā n+ya ta'i sngagasadonabasagahūṃ yig las rang gi mdun du snod kyi 'jig rten rnam par dag pa pad+ma dang / zla ba dmar skya'i gdan la/ hrīḥlasadapal sgyu 'phrul chen mo sku mdog sngon mo zhal bzhi sngo ser dmar ljang ba/ phyag dang po gnyis kyis thod pa dang / kha ṭ+wāṃ ga 'dzin pasayum la 'khyud pa/ 'og ma gnyis kyis mda' gzhu 'phyar ba/ zhabs g.yon brkyang ba'i skyil krung phyed pa'i gar stabs kyisabazhugs pa/ milpagasakyi stod g.yogasa'aphyar ba/ yum sangasargyasamakha' 'gro ma dmar mo rang mtshungasadang mnyam par sbyor ba/ thod skam kyi dbu rgyan/ mgo phreng phyag rgya lnga'i rgyan dang bcas pa/ de la yid kyis mchod pa phul/ de nyid rang gi snying nang du thim pas/ rang nyid he ru ga'i sku snga ma bzhin du gyur pa la/ spro na go cha'i yi smosadagod de/ mgrin par āḥ rna ba gnyis la a/ mig la oṃ rnamasadamar po/ sna la kha dkar po/ dpral bar dziser po/ snying gar ra dmar po'o/ /dpral bar —112

oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs gar hūṃ/ oṃ āḥhrīḥ&/ oṃ āḥ.e hūṃ/ zhesabazlasapa ci nusabya'o/ /rdzogasapa'i rim pa yang ci nusasu bsgom ste bde chen myur sgrub tu bshad zin to/ /gtor ma 'bru gsum gyisabyin gyisabarlabasanas/ ye shes pa skad cig gis mdun du byon pa la/ tso( a gu h+ya ā bha k+ṣa bhak+ṣe hūṃ/ zhesalan bdun gyis phul/ de rang la bstim/byin rlabasani/ chosa'abyung dmar po/ gru gsum gyi dbusasu/ thig le dkar po yod pa zhigabri/ mchod pa dang gtor ma bshams/ mngon rtogasabasgomasanasagator ma gong bzhin 'bul/ mchod pa'ang 'bru gsum gyisabyin gyisabarlabasanas/ yid kyisa'abul/ slob mas maṇ+ḍal byasanas/ mche ba gtsibata/shing 'jigs pa che/ /sngags kyi me tog phreng bas brgyan/ /sha chang rab tu gsol mdzad pa'i/ /he ru ka dpal phyag 'tshal bstod/ /bdag la byin gyis brlakha tu garbedul/ zhes lan gsum gsol ba btab/ sgrub thabs kyi dmigasapa phog nas/ sngagasabaslar ༅ga /bum dbang ngo / zhesabarda sprad/ snying gar nyi zla kha sbyor rgya sran tsamapa'i dbus su/ thig le yungs 'bru tsam la sems gtod du gzhug /brjod bral gyi nyams myong ngo sprad la gsang dbang ngo / /zhesabarjod/ lte ba'i a yig 'bar ba'i/spyi bo'i haṃ zhu bar dmigs la rlung bzung du bcug thur sel bsdams pas bde stong gi nyams skyes par bsam/ shes dbang ngo / /chos 'byung ni dbyings spros bral/ thig le ni rig pa bde ba chen po'i brda'o zhes dbang bzhi pa'o/ /'di la rjesachog mi dgos/ rab zab mahā mā ya'i gzhung / /kun gyi zab don dga' bsazhus/ yang snying len tshul 'di 'dra ba/ /gzhan la yod med gsal por spros/ /mahā mā ya gtso rkyang gi sgrub thabs kyi le tshan no// //—113—

༄༅/ /na mobadz+ra dha rā ya/ gang zhigatshul 'dir 'jug byed pa/ /de la lhan skyesabade chen po/ /ci yang 'bar bar 'gyur bsate/ /de phyir lhan skyesasgrub thabasaso/ /'dir bde mchog lhanaskyesasgom par 'dod pas/ skyabasasemasatshad med sngon du 'gro bar bya/shā n+ya tasastong par sbyangs/stong pa'i ngang las pad nyi'i steng du rang sems hūṃ las rdo rje hūṃ gis mtshan pa las/ rang nyid 'khor lo bde mchog sku mdog sngon po zhal gcig phyag gnyis spyan gsum rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pasayum la 'gyud pa/ zhabs g.yon bskums pas 'jigs byed dang / g.yas brkyang bas dus mtshan ma mnan pa/ral pa'i thor tshugs dang / yid bzhin gyi nor bu dang / zla ba phyed pa dang / sna tshogs rdo rjes brgyan pa/ phyag rgya drug dang / mgo 'greng dang / stag lpags kyi sham thabs can/ gar gyi nyams dgu dang ldan pa/ yum rdo rje phag mo dmar mo/gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pa/ skra grol zhing phyag rgya lnga dang / thod pa skam po'i 'phreng ba can/ zhabs g.yon brkyang ba'i stabs can gyi yab la 'khyud pa/gnyis ga'ang ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa/ yab la mi bskyod pa dang / yum la rnam par snang mdzad kyi dbu rgyan can/ dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs gar hūṃ/ hūṃ gi 'od kyis sangs rgyas thams cad bde mchog yab yum gyi rnam par h+pha/ zhesaspyan drangs/ dzaḥ& baṃ hoḥ oyo ga shud+dha sarba dharma yog 〈tusa3lha/ bzlasapasadamigasapa gsal btab la/ skye( hrīḥha ha hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ cesabazla'o/ /gal te shin tu bsdusapa nyamasasu len par 'dod na/ skad cig gisabaskyed cing gnasagasum byin rlabasaman chad midagos la/ bzlasapa'i mthar rjesagazhig gi rim pasa'od gsal du bsdu'o//thun mtshamasasu dge ba'i rtsa ba byang chub du bsngo/ gtor ma sum bha bsangs/ swa bhā wasasbyangs/—114

ma mchis pa 'khor lo bde mchog nas/ dbu rgyan gyis bar bdag bskyed bzhin gsal 'debs su 'jug /sangasargyas kun gyi rang bzhin sku/ /slob dpon bdag la dgodas su gsol/ /lus kyi dri ma sbyang ba dang / /de nyid bde chen bdag la stsole/ /zhesarjesazlos lan gsum gyisagasol ba btab/ de nasaslob dpon gyi gnasagasum dang / slob ma'i gnasagasum du yi ge 'byu gsum sgom du bcug la/ bla ma'i dpral ba'i skye'olasasangs rgyas thamasacad kyi sku'i ngo bo oṃ dkar po dpag tu med par byung /slob ma'i dpral ba'i oṃ la thim pas/ bum dbang thob/ lusakyi dri ma dag par mos shig cesabarjod la/ bum pa spyi bor bzhag bum chu kushasastol bar gtor ro/ /oṃ lasabyung ba'i bdud rtsi'i rgyun gyi mgrin pa yan chad gang bar mos/ sangs rgyas kun gyi rang bzhin gsung zhesadang / ngag gi dri ma sbyangasab dang zhesa'adon pa sposal gsol ba bto/ slob dpon gyi mgrin pa'i āḥlas/ āḥspros te/ slob ma'i mgrin pa'i āḥl bstim/ gsang dbang thob/ ngag gi dri ma dag /bum chu mgrin par gtor/ snying kha yan chad gang bar mos/ de bzhi du/ rang bzhin thugasadang yid kyisadri ma zhesa'adod pa spos/ slob dpon gyi thugasaka'i hūṃ lasanyu sprosate/ slob ma'i snying ga'i hūṃ la bstim/ sher dbang / yid kyi dri ma dag bumachu snying gar gtor/ lte ba yan chad gang bar mos/ sangasargyasakun gyi sku gsung thugasazhesadang / sgo gsum dri ma zhesa'adod pa sposal gsol bto/ slob dpon gyi yi ge 'bru gsum las/ 'bru gsum char byung / slob ma'i gnasagasum du thim/ dbang bzhipa thob/ sgo gsum gyi dri ma bag chagasadang bcas pa dag /bum chu gnasagasum char du gtor la 'thung du gzhug rkang mthil yan chad gang bar mos/—116

'dzin pasayum sgeg mo dmar mo mda' gzhu 'dzin pa la 'byud pa/ gnyisapa gnyis kyis mi lpags stod g.yogasasu 'phyar ba/ tha ma rgenyisaḍa ma ru dang thod khrag 'dzin zhing / mchan khung na kha ṭ+wāṃ ga /rus dum gyi do shal dang / tshetog dang rin po chesakyang brgyan pa/ zhabasagayon bskums pas dbang phyug dang /g.yas brkyang bas dkar mo mnan pa/ dbu skra dmar ser 'khyil ba la u dum ba ra'i me tog can/ he ru ga'i cha byad rdzogasapa'o/ /rtsibs drug la mdun nas geyon bskor gyis/ phaṭa hūṃ ha ha 3nya las he ru ka ma sngon mo/ 'jigasam ser mo/ drag mo dmar mo/ dbang byed ma ljang khu/ rnam ltas ma dud kha/ rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma dkar mo/ thams cad zhal gcig phyag bzhi ḍa ma ru dang dril bu mi lpags bsnams pa/ nyi ma dang ro gdan la bzhugasashing / rnam pa gtso bo dang mtshungs pa'o/ /ye shesapa bsres/ lo me paṃ haṃ khaṃ khams lnga yum lngar gyur/ oṃ e hrīḥho hūṃ phung po lnga rigs lngar gyur/ bh+rūṃ hūṃ e khaṃ haṃ haṃ/ skye mched drug la gnas pa sems dpa' drug gribadag nyid du gyur/ yab kyi gnasarnams su/oṃ ha/ na ma hi/ swāhā hūṃ/ bo ṣa ṭa he/ hūṃ hūṃ ho/ phaṭa haṃ/ yum gyi gnas rnamasasu/ oṃ baṃ/ haṃ oṃ/ hri oṃ/ hri hri/ hūṃ hūṃ/ phaṭa phaṭa/ gnasagasum du/ oṃ āḥgyidabang gi lha rnams kyis/ oṃ badzi bha wa a bhi ṣiñtsa hūṃ zhes dbang bskur/ gtso 'khor thamasacad la rdo rje semasadapasadabu brgyan/ ma hrīḥha ha hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ cesaci nusasu bzla'o/ /a gyi mthar/ dkyil 'khor rang la bsdus/ rang nyid kyang nam mkha' la 'ja' yal ba bzhin du gyur/ dbyingasadang mnyam par bzhag /gtor chog ni/ gtor ma bsangasasbyangs/ 'bru gsum gyisabyin gyisabarlabasanas/ ye shes—126

'jig rten dbang phyugayi ge bdun par gragasapa'i sgrub thabasakyi le tshan no/ /dar rgyasa'aphel// //༄tsho/ /na mo badz+ra dha rā ya/ dpal ldan rdo rje snying rje'i stobs/ /gdul dadzin 'dul mdzad la btud de/ /shin tu gusashing brtson ldan la/ /sgrub thabasamador bsdusabashad par bya/ dgyesapa'i rdo rje lhan skyesasgom par 'dod pas/ skyabs 'gro sems bskyed sngon du btang ste/ tshad med bzhi spyi dang mthun par bsgom/shu n+ya nasastong bar sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang lasare lasanyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/ hūṃ las sna tshogs rdo rje lte ba la hūṃ gisamatshan pa las 'od 'phros/ bsrung ba'i 'khor lor gyur/ oṃ rak+ṣa rak+ṣa hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa swāhā/ rang gi snying nang du nyi ma'i steng du zla ba/ de gnyisakyi bar du sna tshogs rdo rje hūṃ gis mtshan pa/ de las 'od 'phros lus thamasacad gang / sdig sgrib thamasacad dgarang nyid he ru ga'i skur gyur pa ni/ sku mdog mthing nag zhal gcig phyag gnyis spyan gsum dmar ba mi bskyod pas spyi bo mtshan pa/ hūṃ gis sgrasa'ajigs pa'ang 'jigasapar mdzad pa/ skra ser gyen du brjesapa/ phyag g.yas rdo rje rtse dgu pa 'phyar ba/ g.yon thod khrag thugs ga'i thad du 'dzin pa/ mchan khung du kha ṭ+wāṃ ga dkar po/ thod skam lnga'i dbu rgyan dang / rlon pa lnga bcu'i do shal can/ phyag rgya lnga dang thal pas brgyan pa/ g.yon brkyang ba'i skyil krung phyed pa'i gar stabasasam/ g.yas brkyang gi stabasakyisapad nyi dbugabasnabral dang bcas pa'i gdan la bzhugasapa/ yum rdo rje bdag med ma sngon mo gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pa dang mnyam par sbyor ba/ gnyisaka'ang ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i klong na bzhugasapa'o/ /gal te yab rkyang du byed na stag lhagasakyi sham thabasacan dubyago/—128

༄tsho/ /bla ma dang lhag pa'i lha la phyag 'tshal lo/ /na mashrī kā la tsagrwa ya/ gang 'dir gnyisamed ye shesakyi/ /rigasabargya rnam dag dam pa'i dngos/ /rgyal ba drug 'dusardo rje sems/ /dusakyi 'khor lo la 'dud do/ /'dir dus 'khor lhan skyesasgom par 'dod pas/ skyabs semasatshad med bzhi sngon du 'gro bar bya/shā n+ya tar+sāstong par sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las rang skad cig gis dur 'khor lhan skyes su gyur pa ni/ rlung me chu dang sa yi dkyil 'khor lhun po pad+ma dang / /zla nyi dus me'i steng du dbang phyug dang ni bdud kyi mgor/ /zhabs ni srid pa'i yum gyi zhabs dang lhan cig bkod gyur pa/ /lha'i dbang pos btud pa'i gtso la spyi bos phyag 'tshal lo/ /sku mdog sngon po zhal gcig phyag gnyis rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pas yum la 'khyud pa/ zhabs g.yon pa dkar po bskums pasadabang phyug dkar po dang / g.yas pa dmar po brkyang ba'i 'dod lha dmar po'i snying gar mnan pa/ ral pa'i thor tshugs dang / yid bzhin gyi nor bu dang / zla ba phyed pas dbu la brgyan pa/ /rdo rje'i rgyan dang stag gi pags pa'i sham thabs can/ mthe bong ser po/ mdzub mo dkar po/ gung mo dmar po/ srin lag nag po/ mthe chung ljang khu/ phyag sor rnams kyi tshigs kyi phreng ba dang po nag po/ gnyis pa dmar po/ gsum pa dkar po'o/ /rdo rje sems dpas dbu brgyan zhing / me ri kha dog sna lnga pa'i dbus na bzhugs pa'o/ /de la 'khyud pa'i sna tshogs yum sku mdog ser mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis spyan gsum ma/ gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pas yab la 'khyud pa/zhabs g.yas bskum g.yon brkyang bas yab dang sbyor ba/ gcer bu phyag rgya lngas brgyan zhing / dbu skra byed grol ba'o/ /gnyisaka'i dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin —131—

'khor lo'i dkyil 'khor yongasardzogs kyi bsrung 'khor gyi skabasabazhin bsgom pa yin mod kyi/ 'dir glama'i man ngag gisamado tsam du bya ba ni/ skyabasasemasasngon du 'gro bas/ stong pa'i ngang las rdo rje rwa ba'i dbus na/ oṃ paṃ bi shwa badz+ra pad+me ku ru ku ru swāhā/ de'i lte bar nyi ma'i gdan/ oṃ ra badz+ra srur+ya badz+ra sur+ya a sa nai ku ru ku ru swāhā/ de'i steng du hūṃ las rdo rje nag po rtse lnga pa yongs su gyur pa las/ bdag nyid khro bo'i dbang po rdo rje shugs sku mdog dus mtha'i sprin dang mtshungs pa zhal bzhi pa/ phrag pa drug pa/dpung pa bcuganyisapa/ phyag nyi shu rtsa drug pa/ g.yas dang g.yon dang dbus kyi mgrin pa dmar po dang dkar po dang nag po'i mdog can/ mdun zhal nag po/g.yas zhal dmar po/ g.yon zhal dkar po/ rgyab zhal ser po/ zhal re re zhing spyan dmar po gsum gsum dang ldan zhing / dbu skra dmar ser gyen du brdzes pa/ g.yas dang g.yon gyi phrag pa dang po nag po/ gnyis pa dmar po/gsum pa dkar po/ dpung pa gnyis nag po/ gnyisadamar po/ gnyis dkar po/ phyag ngar bzhi nag po/ bzhi dmar po/ bzhi dkar po/ de rnams re re la yang mthe bong ser po/ mdzub mo dkar po/ gung mo dmar po/ srin lag nag po/ mthe'u chung ljang khu'o/ /de rnams re re la yang tshigs kyi phreng ba dang po nag po/ gnyisapa dmar po/ gsum pa dkar po/ de lta bu'i g.yas kyi phyag bcu gnyis rnams na/ khro bo'i rdo rje/ ral gri/ rtsegasum/ gri khug /mda'/ rdo rje lcags kyu/ ḍa ma ma tho ba/ 'khor lo/ mdung / dbyug pa dgra s+t+waṃ rnams 'dzin pa/ g.yon gyi phyag bcu gnyis rnams na/ rdo rje'i dril bu/ phub/ kha sagakhrag gis gang ba'i thod pa/ gzhu/ zhags pa/ rin po che/ pad+ma/ dung / tshelong /133

zur drug pa bshams/ sgrub pa po'i mdun du nang mchod/rdor dril cang te'u sogasatshang bar byasal/ nang mchod skye( ā:nyu rtetoḥ zhesabyin gyisabarlabs/ mchod pa rnamasatso( āḥlha hra phaṭa kyisabasangagasubhā wasasbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las shel gyi snod sor bcu gnyis pa rnams kyi nang du/ mas2PROB hoḥrnams las byung ba'i chu dang mchod yon dang / dri dang me tog la sogs pa'i mchod rdzas rnamasadang / in+d+ra ni la la sogs pa'i rnam pa mang po'i rin po che dang / nang gi dam tshig dang / dam tshig rnam pa bzhi'i rdzas la sogs pa kun tu bzang po'i rnam par thar pa las byung ba mchod pa'i sprin rab 'byams kyi ngo bor gyur/ oṃ badz+ra ga: pra tīts+tsha na maḥ o badz+ra pu/ pra tits+tsha na maḥ de bzhi du/ dha paṃ/ dī paṃ/ ni waṃ traṃ/ ak+ṣa h+ye/ lā sum̐/ ha sum̐/ 'ju/ nirkye/ giju/ oṃ badz+ra kā rme pra tīts+tsha na maḥ rol mo byin 'bebs spyi dang mthun pas byin dbab/ mdun bskyed bsangasasbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las nas/ mchod bstod kyi bar bdag bskyed nyid 'don pa sposapasachog pa las/ gtso bo bskyed zin pa'i mtshams/ ha hā/ yi yī/ dṛ ram̐ /lha lha slo l+lī rnams las byung ba'i khro bo bcu dang / nga dwa /nyi nyi/ ྅: mu mū/ dz+nya lha rnams las byung ba'i zad par bcu dang / gha ghā/ rnyisgyi/hṝ hṝ/ bhu bhū/ dzā8 rnams lasabyung ba'i phyogasaskyong bcu dang ga gā/ dzi dz+rī/ rjes / bu byu/ dzāḥ rnams las byung ba'i gza' bcu dang / kha khā/ tshirji/ sprisdi / phu phu/ gli lha rnams lasabyung ba'i klu bcu dang / ka kā/ tsis/ byu zhu / pu pā/ rnyilha rnams las byung ba'i 'byung po —136

byang chub bar du bdag ni skyabasasu mchi/ dag pa gsum gyis bdag gi dngos 'bul chos kyi 'khor lo bskor zhing mya ngan mi 'da' bzhugs su gsol/rdzogs sangs rgyas su bdag gyur cig ces 'dir ni smon lam sems can don gyi slad du bdag bgyid do/ /zhesalan gsum gyis rgyun bshags bya/ 'dod pa'i rdo rje lani rdo rje dril bu phyag rgya bla ma dag kyang spyi bos bzung bar bgyi/ /rin chen la ni sbyin pa sbyin gyi 'khor lo 'di la rgyal ba mchog gi dam tshig bskyang bar bgyi/ral gri la ni mchod pa bgyi stogasal bar chu skyes rigs la sdom pa dag ni bskyang bar bgyi/ /sems can rnams ni thar pa'i slad du rgyal ba bskyed mdzad rigs la byang chub bdag gis bskyed par bgyi/ /zhesalan gsum gyisarigs drug gi sdom pa bzung / 'bru gsum gyisaslob ma la bdud rtsi sbyin/ gnasadrug byin gyisabarlabs/ slob dpon dang mdun bskyed rdo rje shugs gtso rkyang de/ sde drug srung ma drug cu'i tshogs dang bcas par mos su bcug slob dpon gyi thugs ga'i 'od kyis tā/ba ma'i lus sbyangs/ sgrub thabasabazhin slob ma gtso bor bskyed de/ ye shesapa spyan drangs/gnasabazhi byin rlabs/ dbang bskur bsdusapa rnamasakyang sgrub thabasabazhin bya/ tākho da21na dang mdun bskyed dbyer ma mchis pa'i dpral ba nas/ klu bcu dang / 'byung po bcu dpag tu med pa spros nas slob ma'i dpral bar thim/ rol mo'i sgra bya/ sku'i rjesaganang ngo / /mgrin pa nas phyogs skyong dang gza' bcu spros te/ slob ma'i mgrin par thim/ gsung gi rjes gnang ngo / /thugs ka nas zad par bcu dang khro bo bcu sprosate snying gar bstim/ thugasakyi rjes gnang ngo / /lte ba nas/ khro bo rdo rje shugs nyid dpag tu med pa spros te/ lte bar thim/ ye shesakyi rjes —139

snyengs/ stong pa'i ngang lasaskad cig gis bsrung 'khor gzhal yasakhang dang bcas pa'i dbus su/ paṃ las pad+ma'i lte bar nyi ma/ de'i steng du hūṃ las dbyug pa hūṃ gisamatshan pa/ de las 'od 'phros 'dus yongs su gyur pa las/ bdag nyid bcom ldan 'das gshin rje gshed dmar po nyi ma bye ba'i gzi can/ mtsheb rnon po gtsigs zhing bzhad pa phyag g.yas pasardo rje dbyug pa dkar po mi mgo rlon pasamatshan pa 'phyar bsa'ajig rten gsum 'dul ba/ g.yon bdud bzhi'i khrag gis gang ba'i thod pa 'dzin pas yum la 'khyud pa/ zhabs g.yas bskum g.yon brkyang bas ma he'i steng du las kyi gshin rje bskyel nas brdzis pa/stag lpags kyi sham thabs/ thod skam gyi dbu rgyan/ mgo rlon gyi do shal/ klu brgyad kyi rgyan dang bcas pa/ spyan gsum skra ser gyen du 'bar ba/ rang mtshungs kyi yum rdo rje ro langs ma/ thod skam gyi 'phreng ba can gyis 'byung ba/bdud dang gshin rje mtha' dag rlag par mdzad cing / sku la 'bar ba'i phreng ba'i 'byugs pa'o/ /snying gar pad nyi la hūṃ lasadabyug pa dkar po hūṃ gis mtshan pa/ hūṃ las yab kyi rdo rje/ a las yum gyi pad+ma/ yab yum snyomasapar zhugs/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a nu rā ga ṇa badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+pa thokhyehaṃ/ lha mo'i lte ba'i 'og tu pad+ma dmar po'i lte bar hrīḥdamar po/ spyi bor haṃ las byung ba'i re ga dmar po 'bab bzhi par gyur/ rang gi snying ga'i 'od kyis gshin rje gshed rigasalnga badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ o a bhi ṣiñtsa hu me sarba ta thā ga ta/ zhesagasol ba btab pas/ oṃ badzibha wa a bhi ṣiñtsa hūṃ/ zhes dbang bskur te rdo rje semasadapa'i dbu brgyan/ dzaḥsnyi baṃ hoḥ zhes rang la gnyis su med par thim/ arnya —141—

'bul mi dgos/ slob ma rnams la chosabashad/ maṇ+ḍal/ kun mkhyen ye shes sogasagasol bto rgyun gags rigasalnga'i sdom bzung bya/ slob dpon gyi thugasaka nas 'od 'phros/slob ma rnams zhal du bcug yum gyi mkha' nang du slob ma gshed mar yab yum du bskyed/ sangs rgyas rnams spyan drangs nas dbang bskur/ mkha' nang nas phyir spros pa la sku'i rjes gnang bzhin ye shes pa bstim rol mo bya/ bcom ldan de bachin gshegs pa kun/ /sogs gsol ba bto/ sangs rgyas rnams ni sogasakyisabum pasadabang bskur/ mi bskyod pas dbu brgyan te bum dbang ngo / /nang mchotswasko rlabasabasdusapa cig bya/ gshin rdzegashed yab yum de'i steng du gsal btab/ byang sems su zhu nas bdud rtsi dang 'dres/ hrīḥhi 'bru gsum dang casabazlasakyin slob ma la sbyin te/gsang dbang ngo / /yang slob ma lha skugasal dwangs bdud rtsi'i ro myong ba brjod bral la cung zad mnyam par bzhag shesarab ye shes so/ /spros med ltar sems 'dzin med du bzhag tu bcug skye med du ngo sprad/ dbang bzhi pa'o/ /bzlas lung dam bca' ba'i lung / bcom ldan bdag la stsal lags kyi/ /sogasabyin gyisabarlabasapa'i lung bya/ sangasargyas kun gyi ral gri che/ /sogs ral gri'i rjes da.e ma ho bsod pa 'di ni bzang / sngosakyisagyi gug dang thod pa sbyin/ mngon spyod kyi rjesaganang ngo / /slob ma gshed dmar du bsgom pa'i lag tu dbyug pa dang tho ba gto/ gshin rje gshed po'i phyag rgya 'di/ /phyi dang nang du yang dag gnas/ /rdo rje dbyug pa ka pā la/ /dpa' bos yang dag bzung bar bgyi/ /zhesapasagato/ mdun bskyed slob ma la thim par mos/ su pra tiṣ+ṭha sogasarol chen bya/ mchod pa dang bkra shisaci 'grub bya/ maṇ+ḍayas/rjesachog spyi dang 'dra'o/ /gshed skor kun lasazab pa'i phul/ /lhan skyesasgrub thabasachesadaga' ba/ /—143

skyabasa'agro ni bla ma bsgom par 'dus/ semasabaskyed tshad med du 'dus/ yig brgya mtha' gcigatu dgos pa'i yan lag rang ma yin pasaso/ /de nasabadud rtsi myangasal/ skyed āḥ zhesabarjod/ tshad med ni/ sems can thams cad 'khor ba sdug bsngal gyi rgya mtsho las bsgral nasabla na med pa'i byang chub la 'god par bya/ de'i ched du rdo rje rnal 'byor ma bsgom par bgyi'o/ /lan gsum bya/ de nasabla ma sgom pa ni/ rang gi mdun gyi nam mkhar rin po che'i khri'i steng du/ rtsa ba'i bla ma rdo rje chos kyi rnam pa can sku mdog dmar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis spyan gsum pa/ ḍā ma ru dang kha ṭ+wāṃ ga dang thod pa bsnams pa/ rus pa'i rgyun drug gis brgyan pa/ rdo rje skyil mo krung du bzhugs pa/ bla ma sangs rgyas bla ma chos/ /de bzhin bla ma dge 'dun te/ /bla ma dpal ldan rdorje 'chang / /kun gyi byed po bla ma yin/ /dus gsum sangs rgyasathams cad kyi ngo bo bla ma dang rdo rje rnal 'byor ma gnyis su med pa la phyag 'tshal zhing skyabs su mchi'o/ /byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ bla ma 'od du zhu nas rang la thim/ de nasabadaganyid lhar bskyed pa ni/ rang gi snying gar e e yongasasubyurapa las chos 'byung gru gsum nyisabartsegasakyi dbus su/ zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du baṃ yig dmar po/ de'i mthar g.yon bskor du/ oṃ oṃ oṃ sarba bud+dha ḍa ska ni ye/ badz+ra warnga ni ye/ badz+ra be+e ro tsa ni ye/ sgyi haṃ haṃ/ phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa su//zhesa' pas bskor /'a larā 'od 'phros pas/ ring gi r+shar+sha/masacad gang ba/ts+tsha'akhor ba thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i sdig sgrib thams cad bsregs sbyangs/ lusa'od kyi gong bur gyur pa'i skad cig las/ rang nyid rdo rje rnal 'byor ma sna tshogasapad+ma dang nyi ma'i gdan la zhabs g.yasabarkyang pasadusaci 149

mtshan ma dmar mo dang / g.yon bskum pas 'jigs byed nag po mnan pa/ sku mdog dmar mo zhal gcig phyag gnyisaspyan gsum ma/ phyag g.yas pasardo rjes mtshan pa'i gri gug gam rdo rje la ḍā ma ru dpyangasapa thur du sdigs pa/g.yon pas thod pa khrag gisagang ba steng gi phyogs su bzung nas gdong gyen du phyogs pas gsol ba/ mchan khung ngam phrag pa g.yon par rdo rjes mtshan pa'i kha ṭ+wāṃ ga la dril bu g.yer ka dang / 'phan lce gsum pa rnamasa'aphyang bzhin du bsnams pa/ khro chagasa'adresapa/ bde ba rgyas pa'i nyamasacan/ bzhad cing mche ba gtsigs pa/ sgeg cing mdzes la nu 'bur rgyasashing / sked skabs phra ba/klu shing gi me tog sna lngas brgyan pa'i dbu skra/ nag po sil bur grol ba/ thod pa skam po lnga'i dbu rgyan dang / rlon pa lnga bcu'i do shal can/ gcer bu rus pa'i rgyan lngas brgyan pa/ ye shesakyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa'i gnas rnamasasu/ zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du lte bar ā+oṃ baṃ dmar mo rdo rje phag mo/ /snying gar haṃ oṃ sngon mo gshin rje ma/ khar hri mo dkar mo rmongs byed ma/ dpral bar tri hri ser mo bskyod byed ma/ spyi gtsug tu hūṃ hūṃ ljang khu skrag byed ma/ yan lag thams cad la phaṭa phaṭa dud kha tsaṇ+ḍi kā'i rang bzhin no/ /de nasadapa' bo dpa' mosabyin gyisabarlabasapa ni/ 'bar ba'i phyagargyas bskor la/ h+pha/ rang gi snying ga'i baṃ las 'od 'phrosapas/ 'og min nasardo rje rnal 'byor ma la sangasargyasabyang chub sems dpa'/ dpa' bornal 'byor ma'i tshogs bsam gyisami khyab pas bskor ba oṃ badz+ra samā dzaḥ dza2PROBPROB hoḥ gnyisasu med pa thim/ oṃ yo ga shud+dha sarba dharma yo ga shurnyo3lha/ de nasa'agrob dag pa nisnying ga'i sabon sngags —150

'phreng dang bcas pa lasa'od 'phros/ ba spu'i bu ga nasabyung / sems can thams cad kyi sdig sgrib sbyangs/ rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i skur gyur/ yang 'od 'phros de rnams dang sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' dpa' bo rnal 'byor ma thamasacad rdo rje rnal 'byor mar gyur pa mnyes par byas/ 'od zer tshur 'dusarang la thim par bsam de nasadang por ngag bzlasadang / phyi nasayid bzlasabya ste/ snying ga'i sngagasa'akhor ram gsang ba'am lte bar bsgoms nasabazlasapa bya'o/ /mthar bsam mi khyab ni/ snying ga'i sngags 'phreng las 'od 'phros/ khams gsum 'od kyi rnam par gyur/ tshur 'dus gzugs med khams pa thams cad rang lus stod kyi cha la thim/gzugs khams pa thams cad bar gyi cha la thim/ 'dod khams pa thams cad smad kyi cha la thim/ rang yang snying ga'i zla ba la/ de sngags 'phreng la/ de yang baṃ la/ de yang thig le la/ de yang nā dar gyur/ nā da yang mi dmigs par gyur/ de la blo bzhag slar yang rang nyid rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i skur gyur/ zhesabarjod/ spro na mchod bstod ca zad byasal/ mthar rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor mas bdag mkha' spyod dgapa'i gnas su 'khrid pa dang / mthar thug zung 'jug rdo rje 'chang chen po'i go 'phang thob par byin gyisabarlab tu gsol/ zhesagasol ba bto te bdag bskyed do/ /de nasamadun bskyed sum bhasabasangs/ swa bhā wasasbyangs/ mdun bskyed kyi dkri'i/'khor mi dmigs te stong pa'i ngang las chos 'byung nyisabartsegasakyi dbus su/kai las thod pa dkar po dum bu gsum pa dpral ba rang la bstan pa yangs shing rgya che ba nang bdud rtsilngasayongs su gang ba'i spris ma sna tshogasardo rje'i tshul du gnas pa'i lte ba'i hūṃ las 'od zer phyogs bcur 'phrosapas/ rdorje'i sa gzhi —151—

rwa ba/ drwa bgur/ bla bre ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i bsrung ba'i 'khor lo yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du/ dur khrod wo po brgyad kyisayongs su bskor ba'i dbus su/ e e yongs su gyur pa las chos 'byung gru gsum gnyis brtsegs phyi dkar la nang dmar ba/ yangs shing rgya che ba'i mdun rgyab spangs pa'i grwa bzhir dga' ba 'khyil ba bzhi g.yon du 'khor ba/ de'i dbus su zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du boyig dmar po/ de'i mthar g.yon bskor du oṃ oṃ oṃ nas/ swāhā/ zhes pas bskor ba lasas gsum khyab pa'i 'od zer 'phros/ 'phags pa mchod/sems can gyi don byas/ tshur 'dusayongs su gyur pa las/ rdo rje rnal 'byor ma zhesapa nas/ tsaṇ+ḍikwa'i ngo bo/ dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs gar hūṃpho nasayo ga shud+dha3'i bar sngar bzhi byed/ thugs spu'i baṃ yig zla ba sngags 'phrengadangabacas pa las sa gsum khyab pa'i 'od zer 'phros/ 'phags pa mchod/ sems can thams cad kyi sdig sgrib sbyangs/ rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i go 'phang la bkod/slar 'dus snying ga'i chos kyi yi ge la thim/ de nasabazlas pa byed/ rten dang brten par bcas pa'i dkyil 'khor pa thamasacad gshegasagasol gyi cho ga ma byas kyi bar du brtan par bzhugasasu gsol/ brtan par bzhugasanas kyang bdag dang semasacan thamasacad la mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub ma lus pa stsal du gsol/ ces gsol ba btab /rang gi snying ga'i sabon lasa'od zera'aphros pas/ sangs rgyasabyang chub sems dpa' dpa' bodang rnal 'byor ma'i tshogasabasam gyisami khyab pa oṃ badz+ra samā dzaḥ zhesamagron spyan drangs/ sum bha nisabasangs/ swa bhā wasasbyangs/lhonge—152

pā ri wā ra wī ni badzi ni pū dzi te 02PROB/ de bzhi du/ bang se mṛ taṅge mu ra dze ga ha phye lā phye grirti ཿ nirti puṣ+ṭi dhu pe ā lo keḥ gan+ta rū pa ra sa sparnye nang mchod ni/ spro na bla ma rnamasakyi mtshan gyi mthar 'bru gsum btagasal 'bul/ snying po'i oṃ gsum gyi mthar 'byu gsum btagasal phul nas/ skyed sarba ta thā ga ta a mṛ ta swā da na badz+raswabhāwa āt+pa ko3nya/ bdud rtsi myapas/ mnyesamachod ni/ oṃ oṃ oṃ sarba bzhi ḍa ki ṇi ye/ badz+rawar+ṇa ni ye/ badz+ra bai ro tsa na ye/ hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa swāhā/ kān lnga rām byed/ oṃsarba ta thā ga ta a nu rāg na badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+pa bo3haṃ/ zhesa'akhyud rgya bya/ denasabastodapa ni/ dpalaldan rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma/ /mkha' 'gro ma yi'akhor lo bsgyur/ /ye shesalnga dang sku gsum nyid/ /'gro ba skyob la phyag 'tshal lo/ /ji snyed rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma/ /kun tu rtog pa'i 'ching gcod cing / /'jig rten bya ba rab 'jug ma/ /de snyed rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /oṃ na mo bha ga wa te badz+ra wā rā tī waṃ hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ na yo.ār+ya a pa ra dzi te tre+e lo kya ma te ma) bibya shwa riyi hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ na mosarba bhu ta bha ya wa he mahā badzi hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ na mobadz+ra ā sa ne+e a dzi te a pa ra dzi ta wa shi ka ri ni tra bh+ra ma ni hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ na ma sho ṣa ni ro ṣa ni kro dha ka ra li ne hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ na maḥsta sa ni swar ni pra be de ni a pa rā dza ye hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ na mo bi dza ye dzam+bha ni stam+bha ni mo hā ni hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ na mobadz+ra wā rā hi mahā yo gi ni kā me shwa ri kha ge hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/de nasagator ma ni/ sum+bhasabasangs/ swa bhā wasasbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang lasagator ma rnams kyi 'og tu yaṃ las rlung gi dkyil 'khor dang / raṃ las me'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/ a las thod pa dkar po dum bu gsum pa/ dpral ba nang la —154

bstan pa/ phyi dkar la nang dmar ba yangasashing rgya che ba'i nang du/ na go ha da ku lasasha lnga/ mu bi ma ra shu las bdud rtsilnga rnams hūṃ sum̐ khaṃ badzi e ye shes lnga'i ngo bos mtshan pa/ rlung g.yos me sbar zhu zhing khol/ rang gi snying ga'i 'od kyis ye shes kyi bdun rtsi spyan drangs te bstim pas/ gtor ma zag pa med pa ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur/ oṃ āḥ( ha ho hrīḥ o gsum ma'i mthar/ a kā ro mu khaṃ sarba dharmā ṇi ar+ya nut+pasno twa ta/ o.āḥ& phaṭa swāhā/ lan lngasadabul/ badz+ra yo gi ni arnya nasashap+ta'i bar gyisamachod/ oṃ gsum ma tshar ga:ga brjod nagardorje rnal 'byor ma'i zhal du mchod par 'bul lo/ /oṃ āḥshu dpal ldan rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma/ /zhesapa nas/ de snyed rnamasal phyag 'tshal lo/ /lha mo tshad ma dmatshig tshad ma dang / /des gsungasatshig kyang tshad ma'i mchog yin te/ /bden pa 'di yis lha mo de dag gis/ /bdag la rjes su 'dzin pa'i rgyur gyur cig /'jig rten 'dasapa'i gtor chog go /oṃ ā:nyu ha ho hrīḥpho/ oṃ badz+ra a ral+li ho zhegashagayid la 'dod pa kun 'grub shog gi bar mkha' 'gro spyi gtor bya ste/ 'jig rten pa'i gtor chog go /bum pa'i mchod pa gong ltar byin gyisabarlabs/ bum pa n+da/ma bhasabasangs/ swa bhā wasasbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang lasapo las pad+ma dang / a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/ bh+rūṃ las bum pa yangs shing rgya tsheb/ lha rdzas kyi gos kyi mgul chings dang / dpag bsam gyi shing gis kha brgyan pa/ nang chu dang bcud thams cad kyis yongasasu gang ba'i dbusasu/ e.e yongasasu gyur pa las zhesapa nas/yo ga shud+dha sarba dharmā yo ga 〈tusa3nya/ zhesapa'i bar mdun bskyed bzhi byed/ oṃ sarba ta lhag—155

dpal ldan rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma nas/ 'gro ba skyobs la phyag 'tshal lo sangs rgyas kun gyi rang bzhin sku/ /slob dpon la ni bdag skyabs mchi/ /dpal ldan rdo rje rnal 'byor mas/ /bdag la byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ /lan gsum gyisagasol ba bto/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi nas/ 'gro la phan phyirasangs rgyas 'grub par 3|ga /cesargyun bshagasalan gsum brjod/ sras bcas sangasargyas thams cad dang / /zhesapa nas/ sems can mya ngan 'das la 'god/ /cesalan gsum gyisasdom pa bzung / sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun la/ /rtag tu bdag ni skyabs su mchi/ /rnal 'byor gsang sngagasamakha' 'gro ma/ /'khor lo gsum gyi bdag nyid can/ /kun la bdag ni skyabs su mchi/ /dpa' bo dpa' mo dbang lha mo/ /byang chub semasadapa' bdag nyid che/ khyad par du yang slob dpon la/ /rtag par bdag ni skyebs su mchi/ /dpal ldan khrag 'thung sogs dpa' bo/ /rnal 'byor ma dang snang mdzad sogs/ /byang chub sems dpa' dpag med pa/ /thams cad bdag la dgodas su gsol/ /bdag ni dus 'di nas bzung ste/ /ji srid gnyis med la gnas par/ /de yi tshangasaspyod gnyis med pa/ /nyi shu rtsa gnyis legs par bsrung / /zhesalan gsum gyisas mong ma yin pa'i sdom pa bzung /oṃ tsak+ṣu ban dha wa rā ma na ye hūṃ/ zhesamig dar bto / a khaṃ waṃ ra hūṃ gisame togagata/bum chusaslob ma la gtor la sum bha nisabasangs/ oṃ āḥ&/ bdud rtsi sbyin/ bu khyod suyin ci la dga'/ /zhoga'adri/ skal bzang bdag bde ba chen po la'o/ /zhesarjesazlosabya/de yis bu la ci zhig bya/ /zhoga'adri/ sangasargyas mchog gi dam tshig go /zhesarjesazlosabya/ slob ma'i snying gar zla ba la rdo rje dkar po bsgom du bcug nas/ oṃ sarba —157

de bzhin gshegasapa thamasacad kyi sku gsung thugasayon tan 'phrin las dang bcas pa'i dngos grub dang / 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'dasapa'i dngosagrub ma lus pa stsal zhing brtan par mdzad du gsol/ lan gsum/ de nasato loslobama'i khar sbyin la/ mdun bskyed bcom ldam 'das ma'i thugs ga'i baṃ yig las robo rdo rje rnal 'byor ma rnam pa mun sel gyi ting lo 'od gsal ba byung / khyed rang gi kha sgo nas zhugs/ dbu ma'i lam nas brgyud/ lte ba'i baṃ yig dang ro gcig tu 'dres pa las/ nang gi rnal 'byor ma tshon gang bar gyur/ desabade ba chen po'i gar mdzad/ chos 'byung gi grwa bzhir yang dga' ba 'khyil ba bzhi g.yon du 'khor/ smin mtshamasadang gsang sgor yang dga' ba 'khyil ba g.yon du 'khor/phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' thamasacad rdorje rnal 'byor ma'i rnam par byon nas khyed rang la thim pasarang gi lus ngag yid gsum rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i sku gsung thugs kyi ngo bo dam par byin gyisabarlabs/ rol chenabya/oṃ gsum ma brjod/ oṃ badz+ra a be sha a/ ye shes dbab pa'i rgyun de spyi bor rdo rje gyogram du bzhag pas brtan par mos mdzod/ tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra zhaganyis/ mdun bskyed rdorje rnal 'byor ma'i sku la me tog phul bar mos la/ me tog 'thor bzhin du 'di'i rjes zlos kyisabyas la/ opra tīts+tsha badz+ra hoḥ slar yang me tog de nyid rang gi spyi bor bcings par mos shig byas la/ oṃ pra ti grihā s+t+waṃ i me satwa mahā ba la/ rnal 'byor ma dpal deng khyod kyi/ /mig 'byed par ni brtson par mdzad/ /phye ba'i thamasacad mthong ba yang / rdo rje mig ni bla na med/ /oṃ badz+ra ni tra a pa ha ra pa ṭa yaṃ hri traṃ/ rten dang brten par bcas pa'i dkyil 'khor ba —159

thams cad mngon sum bzhin du gsal bar gyur/ dbang gi dngos gzhi zhu ba'i yon du maṇ+ḍal dbul/ rnal 'byor ma dpal dbang bskur ba/ /'gro ba skyob pa'i gzi brjid can/ /ji ltar yon tan 'byung gnasagatso/ /de bzhin bdag la deng stsol cig /cesalan gsum rjesazlos kyisagasol ba bto/ rin po che'i khri yangasashingargyache ba'i dbus su/ khyed rang rnams rdo rje rnal 'byor mar gsal ba'i steng du/gdugs dkar po mtha' skor du mchod pa'i sprin gyis phung po sa dang bar snang thams cad gang bar gyur/ mdun bskyed bcom ldan 'das ma'i thugs ka nasadabang gi lha sprul te dbang bskur ba'i las mdzad par mosashig byasal/ bum pa bzung / me sto 'thor zhing / he ru ka dpal 'bar ba'i sku mnga' ba/ /ha ha'i gad lbosas gsum g.yo bar mdzad/ /hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa kyis bdud kyi klad pa 'gems/ /bde mchog 'bor los bkra shisadeng 'dir stsol/ /e waṃ mnyam par sbyar ba bde ba'i sku/ /ā likā li rol pa'i gsung mnga' zhing / /e gi ngo bor son pa'i thugs mnga' ba/ /shes rab phag mo'i bkra shisadeng 'dir stsol/ /zhesashisapa brjod/ dbang lha la gartsol ba 'debasapa 'di'i rjes zlosamadzod byas la/ de bzhin gshegasapa khyed rnams kyis bdag la mngon par dbang bskur ba stsal du gsol/ de nasadabang gi lha rnamasakyis/ ji ltar bltamasapa tsam gyis nas/ de bzhin bdag gisasku khrusagasol/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga a bho ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shrī ye hūṃ/ oṃ tsakra rdzir s+t+waṃ a bhi ṣiñtsa hūṃ/ zhesachu dbang bskur/ oṃ sarba bzhi ḍa ki ni ye/badz+ra warje nī ye/ mahā mu ku ṭa hoḥ obadzi bha wa a bhi ṣiñtsa hūṃ/ zhes r+shasung zhing bum pa'i chus spyi bo nasadabang bskur/ sku gang dri ma dag chu'i lhag ma yar —160

lud pa las/ rang gi spyi bo'i gtsug tu rnam par snang mdza/ dpral bar mi bskyod pa/ rna ba g.yasapar rin chen 'byung ldan/ ltag par 'od dpag med/ rna ba g.yon par don yon grub pa rnamasakyis dbu brgyan/ de nas brtan bzhugasasu gsol ba'i mos pa gyis byas la/ rol chen dang bcasaslob ma la me tog gtor la/ oṃ supra tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra ye swāhā/ zhesabarjod de nasabazlas lung ni/ mdun bskyed bcom ldan 'dasama'i thugs rka'i baṃ yig las sngags rnams kyi 'phreng ba byung / khyed rang gi kha sgo nas zhugs/ snying ga'i gzungs sngags la thim pas sngagaba'inus pa mthu dang ldan par byin gyis brlab par mos la/ 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod byas la/ oṃ gsum ma lan gsum brjod/ dam bca' ba'i lung 'di'i rjesazlos mdzod byas la/ bla ma dngardo rje rnal 'byor ma gnyis su ma mchis pa bdag la dgongs su gsol/ bdag ming 'di zhesabagyi ba dus 'di nas bzung ste/ ji srid byang chub snying po la mchis kyi bar du/ rdo rje rnal 'byor ma yi dam gyi lhar bzung nas/ de'i gzungs sngags nyin re la ci nusare bzla bar dam bca' lagasaso/ /slob dpon la tshetog gtor la/ 'di'i rjesazlosamadzod/ bcom ldan bdag gis bzungs lagasakyi/ /bdag la 'go bar mdzad du gsol/ /me tog de nyid slar yang khyed rang rnam pa'i spyi bor gtor bsasngagasa'aphreng gi rnam pas snying gar thim ste/ rgyud byin gyisabarlab par mos pa mdzod byas la/ me tog slob ma'i spyi bo dang snying gar gtor te/ sngags kyi dngos grub stsal du gsol/ /brtul zhugs brtan par mdzad du gsol/ /rig pa 'dzin pa khyed kyi rgyud la rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i gsung rigasasngagasakyi byin rlabasadang nusamathu ma lus pa yongasasu —161—

'jug par gyur cig cesabarjod do/ /desabum dbang thob pas bskyed rim bsgom pa la dbang bar byas so/ /mdun bskyed kyi thugasaka nasa'od zer 'phros/ sangs rgyas thams cad spyan drangs/ zhal du zhugs/ byang chub kyi sems su zhu/ gsang ba nas thon/ ka pā la bdud rtsi dang 'dres/ de nyid lce thog tu bzhag par mos shig cesa.oṃ gsum ma'i mthar 'bru gsum brjod cing / dkyil 'khor gyi nang mchod nas blang la slob ma la sbyin des gsang dbang thob pas/lam rang lus la brten nasartsa dbu ma kha dbye ba'i thabs sgom pa la dbang ngo / /de nas sin dhu ra'i dkyil 'khor las/ sid+dha ra slob dpon gyi mtheb srin g.yon pas blangs la/ slob ma'i dpral ba/ mgrin pa/ snying ga lte ba rnams su byug 'brugasum brjod/ de ltar gnas bzhi byin gyis brlabs pa'i rkyen gyis lte ba'i gtur mo 'bar/ spyi bo'i haṃ yig zhu ba'i dga' ba bzhi'i ye shes bskyed par mos la/ sngags dang phyag rgya 'di'i rjesazlos kyis/ zhesabarjod la/ oṃ sabota thā ga ta a nu rā ga na badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+pa bosto3nya/ zhesapa dang / 'khyud rgya byar bstodes shes rab ye shes kyi dbang bskur ba thob pas/ pho nya'i lam sgom pa la dbang ba yin no/ /de lta bu'i zhu bde de nyid dper byas te/ don rang sems bde ba chen po lhan cig skyes pa'i don sgom pa ni bzhi pa'i ye shes te/ dngos po med pa'i chos nyid chos/ /nam mkha' lta bur dri ma med/ /stong nyid ye shesardo rje yi/ /stong pa nyid ni rnam par sgom/ /zhesapa yin pasaspros bral bde stong la cung zad mnyam par shog mdzod/ de ni dbang bzhi pa ste/ lam de kho na nyid dngos su sgom par byed pa la dbang ba yin no/ /de nasarjesani/ slob mas/ gtsobos—162

ji ltar bka' stsal pa/ /de dag thams cad bdag gis bgyi/ /zhesalan gsum dgabaka' drin gtang rag gi don du/ oṃ badz+ra bhu mi 12PROB nas/ bla ma dang dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo gnyis su ma mchis pa la dbang bzhi byin rlabs kyi tshul du thob pa'i bka' drin gtang rag gi yon du dbul bar bgyi'o/ /thugs rjes 'gro ba'i don du bzhes su gsol/ /bzhes nas byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ /zhesamaṇ+ḍal 'bul/ deng nas brtsams te bdag bran du/ khyed la bdag ni 'bul lags kyi/ khyed kyis slob mar bzung ba dang / /cha shas kyis kyang spyad du gsol/ /zhesayon 'bul lo/ /tshogasa'akhor gyi bya ba ni/ bdag 'jug gi snga phyi gnyisadang / skabasa'adi gsum gang la byasakyang rung ba las/ dang po gnyisaltar gtso che na'ang / deng sang phyi ma ltar mdzad de/ lhag gtor dang 'jig rten pa'i gtor ma dusagacig la gtong / de nasarjesachog ni/ mchod pa rnamasakha gsosal/ oṃ sum+bha nisabasangs/ swa bhā wasasbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las a las ye shes kyi ka pā la yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du/ zhesapa nas/ de nyid rnamasal phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhesapa'isgo bum bskyed ltar mchod bstod rnamasabyed/ bcom ldan 'das ma'i bdag gi sdig pa dang sgrib pa dam tshig nyams chags thams cad rtsa ba nas byang zhing dag par mdzad du gsol/ tshe dang bsod nams dang 'byor ba dang / dbang phyug phun sum tshogs par byin gyisabarlab tu gsol/ 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i chadangos grub ma lus pa tshe 'di nyid la stsal du gsol/ gal te tshe 'dir 'grub pa'i skal ba med na/ 'chi tshe mkha' spyod kyi gnas su 'khrid pa dang / mthar thug zung 'jug rdo rje 'amang wo po'i go 'phang thob par byin gyis rlobs/ zhes—163

'dod don zhu/ oṃ shrī badz+ra he ru ka zhesasogasahe ru ga'i yi gebargya pa lan gsum brjod la/ma'abyor pa dang nyams pa dang / /gang yang bdag rmongs blo yisani/ /bgyis pa dang ni bgyid stsal pa/ /de kun mgon posabazod par gsol/ /bdag cag las dang po pa'i rten gyi gang zag tu gyur pas/ semasasgrib pa dang ldan pa dang /yo byad ma tshang ba dang / ting nge 'dzin mi gsal ba dang / sngags ma dag pa dang /cho ga lhag pa dang chad pa thams cad lhag chad kha bskang zhing / bdag cag gi lam dang dngos grub kyi bar chad du mi 'gyur bar byin gyis brlab tu gsol/zhesabazod par gsol/ phyogs bcu na bzhugasapa'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub semasadapa' thams cad bdag la dgodas su gsol/ ji srid nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad mi gnas pa'i mya ngan las 'das pa'i sa la ma bzhag gi bar du rgyal ba rnams mya ngan las mi 'da' bar brtan par zhugasasu gsol/cho bye brag tu rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i rten sku 'di rnams la bskyed cing spyan drangs pa'i lha tshogs thams cad 'byung ba bzhi'i gnod pa ma byung gi bar du brtan par bzhugasasu ga〈le/ brtan par bzhugs nas kyang bdag dang sems can thams cad kyi mgon dang skyabs dang dpung gnyer dam pa mdzad du gsol/ oṃ su pra tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra ye swāhā/ zhesabartan bzhugasabya/ khyod kyis semasacan don kun gosasirgyu ra'i ye shes pa gshegs/ rang nyid rdo rje rnal 'byor mar gsal ba'i gnas rnams su zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/ oṃ baṃ/ haṃ oṃ/hri oṃ/ hri hri/ hūṃ hūṃ/ phaṭa phaṭa/ sum bha ni/ lan gnyisakyi tshamarngam sngagasakyis bsrung ba byedado/ /de nasaspyod lam gyi rnal 'byor ni/ bdag dang snang ba'i dngos po thamasacad rdo rje —164—

rnal 'byor ma'i sku'i rang bzhin/ oṃ gsum ma tshar snyag brjod nas/ brjod pa dang grags pa'i sgra thamasacad rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i gsung gi rang bzhin/ dran rig rnam rtog thams cad rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i thugs ye shes chen po'i cho 'phrul du rnam par dag pa yin no/ /de nasasmon lam ni/ bdag gis dus gsum dge ba tsispyad pas/ /nam mkha'i mtha' klas gyur pa'i sems can rnams/ /bla med rdo rje theg pa'i snod gyur te/ /kun kyang rdorje 'dzin pa nyid gyur cig /skyezhing skye ba dag ni thams cad du/ /blo ldan rigs bzang nga rgyal med pa dang / /snying rje che zhing bla ma la gus brtan/ /rdo rje phag mo'i dam tshig la gnas shog /rdo rje dril bu la sogs rtag tu 'chang / /zab cing rgya che chos don rtogs pa dang / /go ku shu kra la sogs rtags bzang zhing / /mthar thug bde chen sgrub pa'i skal ldan 3(ga /bde gshegasaspyan sngar gnas gsum mkha' 'gro yi/ /dam bca' bsrung zhing dngos grub mchog stsol bar/ /thugs dam bcas shing rtag bsrung dngos grub ni/ /rnam gsum tshe 'di nyid la thob par shog /de nasabakra shisani/oṃ phun sum chogasapa mnga' ba/ gosakyi mthar/ spro na/ bkra shis gang zhing chosakyi dbyingasalasalegs byung ba'i/ /he ru ka dpal 'jigasabyed rgyal po 'bar ba'i sku/ /shesarab phag mo'i pad+mor rdo rje rol par mdzad/ /bden pa des kyang bde mchog la gnas bkra shisashog /bkra shis gang zhig chosakyi 'byung gnas nyams dga' bar/ /sna tshogis chu skyes nyin byed gdan la bde bar bzhugs/ /rgyal ba ma lusabaskyed pa'i yum mchog rnal 'byor ma/ /bden pa des kyang tsha bkra shis gang zhig gsang chen zab mo'i don ston pa'i/ /mkha' —163

bor rtsa ba'i bla ma he ru ka dang gnyis su med pa 'grum bag dang bcas shing rus pa'i rgyan gyis spras pa/ skyabs gnas thams cad kyi ngo bor bzhugs/ gang gi drin gyi bde chen nyid/ /skad cig nyid la 'char ba gang / /bla ma rin chen lta bu'i sku/ /rdo rje can zhabs pad la 'dud/ /bla ma sangs rgyas bla ma chos/ /de bzhin bla ma dge 'dun te/ /bla ma dpal ldan rdo rje 'chang / /gsol ba 'debs so byin gyis rlobs/ /zhesalan gsum/ bla ma yi dam sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' mkha' 'gro'i tshogs dang bcas pa rnams kyang steng gi nam mkha' la bzhugs par gyur/ chabadz+ra arnya pra tīts+tsha swāhā/ oṃ badz+ra pubye pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+ṭi āḥ&/ dhu pe/ ā lo ke/ garnye/ ni we te/ chabadz+ra shap+ta āḥsnyi/ thalamo snying gar sbyor bzhin pas/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi/ /sdig pa thams cad so sor bshags/ /'gro ba'i dge la rjesayi rang / /sangs rgyas byang chub yid kyis bzung / /theg chen bdud rtsi rab bshad par/ /'khor lo bskor bar gsol ba 'debs/ /ji srid 'khor ba gnas kyi bar/ /mya ngan mi 'da' gsol bar 'tshal/ /sangs rgyas chos dang tshogs rnamasal/ /byang chub bar du bdag skyabs mchi/ /rang gzhan don ni rab sgrub phyir/ /byang chub sems ni bskyed par bgyi/ /byang chub mchog tu sems ni bskyed bgyid nas/ /sems can thamasacad bdag gis mgron du gnyer/ /byang chub spyod mchog yid 'ong spyad par bgyi/ /'gro la phan phyir sangs rgyas 'grub par shog /lan gsum/bla ma yi dam sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' mkha' 'gro'i tshogs dang bcas pa 'od du zhu nas bdag nyid la thim/ rang gi gnasarnams su zla ba'i dkyil —167

stong pa'i ngang las rang lus gzhal yas khang gru bzhi sgo bzhi rta babs dang bcas pa/ rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa/ mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa/ phyi rol du dur khrod wo po brgyad bsrung ba'i 'bor lo dang bcas pas yongs su bskor ba'i dbus su/ chos 'byung gru gsum phyi dkar la nang dmar ba rtsa ba phra zhing gdengs ka rgyas pa'i steng rus sbal gyi rgyab ltar mtho ba/de'i nang du ngag sngags kyi yig 'bru dang / sems lha sku'i rnam par gyur pa ni/paṃ las sna tshogs pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad pa'i lte bar mi ro ser po mgo g.yon du bstan pa'i snying gar oṃ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor/ de'i steng du baṃ dmar po las 'od 'phros/ sa gsum gyi dri ma sbyangs/ phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba thams cad bsdus shing thim pa las/ bdag nyid rdo rje rnal 'byor ma sku mdog pad+ma rā ga ltar dmar zhing yid tsam smug pa nyi ma bye ba'i 'od dang mtshungs pa'i gzi brjid can/ rtsal zhal lha mo'i rnam pa 'dzum khro chags pa'i nyams can mche ba gtsigs shing bzhad pa/ g.yas zhal phag gdong khro zhing gyen du phyogs pas gzigs pa/ phyag g.yas rdo rje'i gri gug 'phyar zhing / g.yon thod khrag thugs gar 'dzin pa/ mchan khung g.yon du rdo rje'i kha ṭ+wāṃ ga dkar po gyen du bsgreng pa/dbu skra nag po cung zad lib sil bur grol zhing thur du 'phyang ba/ dmar zhing bkra la zlum por g.yo ba'i spyan gsum dang ldan pa/ rdo rje nag po'i 'phreng ba la brgyus pa'i thod skam lnga'i 'phreng ba can/ sgyu ma'i sbrel ba'i khrag 'dzag mi mgo lnga bcu'i do shal 'phyang ba/ 'khor lo dang / rna cha dang / mgul rgyan dang / gdu bu ste mi rus kyi phyag rgya lngas brgyan pa/ gcer bu lo bcu drug lon pa ltar lang —169

tsho la bab cing / nu ma rgyas pa/ zhabasagayon brkyang pa'i skyil krung phyed pa'i gar stabs kyis bzhugabasapa malus pa'i sprul pa 'chang ba'i sku can/ bskal pa'i me lta bu'i ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na sgeg cing rol ba'o/ /lte bar nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du baṃ dmar po de lasa'od 'phros/ rang bzhin gyi gnas nas rdo rje rnal 'byor ma la dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma'i tshogs thams cad kyis bskor bar spyan drangs/ 'bar ba'i phyag rgya dpral bar bskor bzhin pas/ h+pha zhesabarjod/ dzaḥsnyi baṃ hoḥ gnas rnams su zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi stengadu/ lte bar oṃ baṃ dmar mo rdo rje phag mo/ snying gar haṃ oṃ sngon mo gshin rje ma/khar hri oṃ dkar mo rmongasabyed ma/ dpral bar hri hri ser mo bskyod byed ma/ sgyigatsug tu hūṃ hūṃ ljang khu skrag byed ma/ tshigs chen thams cad la phaṭa phaṭa dud kha tsaṇ+ḍikā'i ngo bo rnams su gyur/ slar yang baṃ las 'od zer 'phros/ dbang gi lha dpal he ru ga'i dkyil 'khor mdun gyi nam mkhar h+pha/ bdud rtsis gang ba'i snod thogs te/ mdun gyi nam mkhar bzhug pa la/ bdag la dbang bskur du gsol/ ces gsol ba btab pas/ rang sngags gsung bzhin pas dbang bskur/ sku gang dri ma dag chu'i lhag ma yar lud pa las/ mi bskyod pa'i ngo bo rdo rje sngon po rtse lnga pas dbu brgyan/ dbang gi lha rnams kyang rang la thim/ de nasadag pa dran pa ni/ ngag tu ma brjod kyang rung mod kyi/ de ni 'di ltar dran dgos so/ /pad+ma'i gdan ni nyen mongs pa'i ma gosapa'o/ /mi ro'i gdan ni rtogs pa thams cad dang bral ba'i stong nyid do/ /nyi ma ni bde ba chen po'i snang ba rgyas pa'o/ /sku mdog dmar mo ni thugs rjesasemasacan la chags pa'o/ /zhabs gnyisani bden gnyis —170

zung du 'jug pa'o/ /gri gug ni dug gsum gcod pa'o/ /thod pa ni bde ba skyong pa'o/ /thod skam lnga ni rigasalnga'o/ /mgo rlon gyi 'phreng ba ni yi ge lnga bcu dag pa'o/ /phyag rgya lnga ni pha rol tu phyin pa lnga'o/ /zhabs g.yas bskums shing g.yon brkyang ba ni mi gnas pa'i mya ngan las 'das pa'o/ /skra grol ba ni mtshan mas ma bcings pa'o/ kha sag ni thabs dang ma bral ba'o/ /sku gcig pu ni shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'o/ /gcer bu ni sgrib pa thams cad dang bral ba'o/ /me dpung 'bar ba ni ye shes kyi snang ba spro ba'o/ /zhesaso/ /nye ba'i baṃ yig las sgo mtshams ma brgyad sku mdog ljang sngon cang te'u dang thod pa bdud rtsis gang ba thogs pa/ mchod rdzas sna tshogs 'dzin pa'i mkha' 'gro ma'i tshogs kyis bskor ba spros te/ mchod pa dang bstod pa'i las mdzad par gyur/arnya nasashap+ta'i bar gyisamachod/ oṃ āḥ( gis nang mchod 'bul/ dpal ldan rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma/ /mkha' 'gro ma yi 'khor lo sgyur/ /ye shes lnga dang sku gsum nyid/ /'gro ba skyob la phyag 'tshal lo/ /ji snyed rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma/ /kun tu rtog pa'i 'ching gcod cing / /'jig rten bya bar rab 'jug ma/ /de snyed rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /he ru ka dpal dpa' bo che/ /rnam dag rdo rje'i dbang phyug dang / /rjes chags chagasapa che rnams kyi/ /rdo rje phag mo la 'dud do/ /rnam par rtog med yang dag rtog /yid ni rab tu mi gnas shing / /yid la med cing dran pa med/ /dmigs med khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /stong nyid snying rje'i bdag nyid can/ khams gsum pa yi ngo bo nyid/ /bskal pa'i me ltar gzi brjid 'bar/ /rdo rje phag mo la 'dud do/ /zhesapasasam rkang pa brgyad pasabastod/ lha mo rnamasalteba'i —171— —

badz+ra muḥ zhesagashegasasu gsol/ smon lam dang bkra shisaci rigasapar bya ste/ phal cher nā ro mkha' spyod dang mthun par shesapar bya'o/ / 'di'i byin rlabasabya bar 'dod na/ yar ngo dang mar ngo'i tshesabacu gang rung la bya ste/ stegasabu'i steng du maṇ+ḍal pad+ma dmar po 'dab brgyad lte bar chosa'abyung dmar po gru bcad ljang khu/ phyi dur khrod dang rdo ra me risabaskor bar bya/ dur khrod ma brisakyang 'gal ba med/ shin tu bsdu na rdo ra dang me ri'ang bor ro/ /de'i steng du mañdzi la sogasapa'i khar thod pa bdud rtsis bkang ba bzhag de'i steng du me long la chang gisabarlan cing sis ra snyomasapar bkram/ gser gyi snyu gu lag pa g.yon pa mtheb srin gyisabazung la/chosa'abyung gru gsum nang du rtsa sngags 'phreng gsum mam bdun ma dang phyogasabazhir dga' 'khyil re dang bcasapa bri/ steng nasadar dmar po'i gur khang phub ste/ sis ra'i dkyil 'khor mi mthong bar bya/ chu gnyisasngon du 'gro ba'i mchod pa dang / gtor ma lnga bshams/ nang mchod/ cang tegardorje dril bu/bsrung skud/ mig dar/ me tog sogasa'og tu dgos pa'i yo byad rnamasadang / khyad par bum pa mtshan nyid dang ldan pa spyi dang mthun par bshams/ sngon 'gro gtor ma mkha' 'gro spyo gtor bzhin btang /mchod pa byin dbab kyang bla med spyi dang mthun/ skyabasa'agro nasabazlasapa'i bar bdag bskyed rdzogasapar byas/ mdun bskyed kyi dkyil 'khor/ n+da/ma bhas bsangs/ dag pa gsum gyi sngagasabarjod/ —1nga pa'i ngang las pad+ma'i lte bar sna'i/'byung dmar po'i dbusasu/ gzhal yas khang gru bzhi sgo bzhi nas/ bskor ba'i dbusasu/ mimago'i sgyed pu gsum gyi steng /a las byung ba'i thod pa'i nang du/ oṃ āḥ/ baṃ rnamasaganas pa'i 'od kyis/sangs rgyas thams cad byang chub kyi semasakyi rnam par spyan drangs la/ bdud rtsi la thim pas ye shes rnam pa lnga'i ngo bor gyur/ oṃ āḥ〉 de'i nang du chos 'byung gru gsum phyi dkar la zhesapa nas/ rtse lnga pasadabu brgyan gyi bar bdag bskyed dang 'bras—174

maṇ+ḍal phul/ sangs rgyasakun gyi rang bzhin sku/ /bla ma'i sku la skyabs su mchi/ /gsung dang thugs la'ang desa'agre/ sangs rgyas grong khyer nyams dga' bar/ /rnal 'byor ma mchog 'khor lo yi/ /snying po'i dkyil 'bor 'di ru ni/ /mgon posabadag ni 'jug par mdzod/ /lan g.yu/ ji ltar dus gsum mgon po rnams/ /nas/ mya ngan 'das la 'god kyi bar lan gsum gyi rigasalnga'i sdom pa bzung /sangs rgyasachosadang dge 'dun la nas/ nyi shu rtsa gnyisalegasapar bsrung gi bar bde mchog gi sa mong ma yin pa'i sdom bzung bya/ oṃ tsak+ṣu ban+ta wa rā ma na ye hūṃ gisamigadar/ a khaṃ wī ra hūṃ gisame rtag bzung / slob ma'i gnasagasum du 'bru gsum bkod la/ rdo rje dang bcasapa'i nang mchod kyisathig le bya/ zla ba rdo rje'i dmigasapa phog la/ oṃ sarba yo ga tsit+ta ut+pa da ya mi/ brjod du bcug snying gar rdo rje kugasate/ su ra ta sa ma ya s+t+waṃ ho sirnyi badz+ra ya tha su khaṃ zhesabarjod/ dzaḥ& baṃ hoḥ zhesadakyil 'khor du bcugapar mosal/ yol ba bas/ spyi bor rdo rje bzhag la/ deng khyod de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad dang /rdorje rnal 'byor mas byin gyis brlabs kyi/ de bas na ngas khyod la rdorje ye shes bskyed par bya ste/ ye shes gang gis khyod dpal he ru ka dang / rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i dngos grub kyang thob par gyur na/ dngosagrub gzhan lta smos kyang ci dgos/ khyod kyis 'di dkyil 'khor chen po ma mthong ba rnams kyis mdun du smra bar ma byed cig smras na dam tshig nyams pa gyur ta re/ zhes brjod/ snying gar gsasate/ rnal 'byor ma dpal deng khyod kyi/ /snying la yang dag zhugs par gyur/ /gal te tshul 'di smras na ni/ /de ma thag tu dral te gshegs/ yang spyi bor bzhag la/ deng phyin chad bu khyod kyi rdo rje rnal 'byor ma nasa'agyur ta re/—177

'bru gsum brjod cing bdud rtsi blud la/ 'di ni khyod kyisanas u da ka ṭha ṭha hūṃ/ye shes dbab pa ni/ slob ma skyil krung bosashing rlung bzung du brgyag slob ma rnams kyi spyiborabla ma he ru ga'i rnam pa can/ ltebar chos 'byung gi nang du rdo rje phag momar me ltar 'bar ba mtshon gang ba gar bsgyur ba zhig bzhugasapar gyur/ slob dpon gyi lte ba'i baṃ lasa'od 'phros/ slob ma'i lte bar gnas pa'i rdo rje phag mo'i sku la phog pas/ ye shes kyi me lce'i tshogasadapag tu med pa 'phros shing 'bar te/lus kyi phyi nang thams cad gang bas/ sdig sgrib thams cad bsreg par mos mdzod/ cesabarjod la rol mo'i sgra bya zhing / rdul gyi rasadang / byi la nag po'i brun dang / gu gul sbyar ba'i dud pas bdug cing / oṃ badz+ra wā rā tī dz+nyā na a be sha ya a hrī hrī swāhā/ gnyisagathogapa'i cho ga ni/ slob ma rnams langs te rkang pa gnyis gshibs brang ba la brjid bskur/ lag pa thal mosbyar brkyang / sna rtse nas sor brgyad gzhal pa'i bar snang la/ g.yung drung ris dkar po me stag 'bar ba gcig bsams la/ rlung phyir song bsagayung drung ris la phog /g.yon bskor du drag tu 'khor ba la shes pa gtad la/ rlung phyir thub tshad zungs shig slob dpon gyi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/ sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' dpa' bo mkha' 'gro yab yum dpag tu med pa spyan drangs/ slob ma'i spyi bor byon/ sbyor mtshams nas byang chub kyi sems kyi rgyun chu rgyun ltar babs pas/ spyi bo nas zhugs/lus thams cad gang / bde mer re re 'dug pa la sems gtod cig /rtsa sngags kyi mthar phe phe hri hri zhesabatagasate/ lan brgya rtsa la sogs pasadabab par bya'o/ /gal te ye shesaphebasan/ de'i nyamasamyong skyong du bcugal/ 'og nasa'abyung ba ltar/ ltos shig rang gi sems —178

la ltos sogasakyis ngo sprod pa yin la/ ma phebasan de brjod mi dgosaso/ /de nasatiṣ+ṭha badz+ra gyisabartan par byin gyisabarlabs/ yang dag pa yi dkyil 'khor 'dir/ /bdag gis sleb ma gzhug par bgyis/ /lha'i rigs kyi rim pa dang / /bsod nams rim pa'ang de bzhin shog /ces slob dpon gyis lha la gsol ba btab la/ oṃ pra tīts+tsha badz+ra hoḥ zhesaslob ma me tog 'bul du bcug pra tī grohā s+t+waṃ i mo satwa mahā bā la/ zhesapasame sto slob ma'i mgo bor bcings/ mig 'bras gnyis oṃ 'od du 'bar bar gyur/rnal 'byor ma dpal deng khyod kyi nas/ bla na med/ he badz+ra pa sh+ya/ khopasamig dar phye/ dkyil 'khor bzang po 'di la ltos/ /da ni dad pa rab tu skyes/ khyod ni rnal 'byor ma rig skyes/ /sngags dang phyag rgyas byin gyis brlabs/ /'gro ba phun sum dngos grub kun/ khyod la myur du mngon du gyur/ /dam tshig thams cad bskyang ba dang / /gsang sngags sgrub la brtson par gyis/ /zhesabaltabar bskul/dkyil 'khor gyi rnam pa bstan la/ rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor gyi chos 'byung ni dus gsum gyi chos nyid/ bdud rtsi'i nang gi chos 'byung ni khams gsum gyi de bzhin nyid/ me long gi chosa'abyung ni sku gsum gyi ye shes mtshon no/ /g.yung drung ris ni chos nyid mi 'gyur ba/ bzhi ni dga' ba bzhi/ yig 'bru rnams su sku gsung thugs gcig tu 'dus pa/ zur gsum ni rnam thar gsum/ nang stong pa nyid spros bral/ dmar ba ni snying rje/ rtsa ba phra ba ni nyon mongs spangs pa/gdengs mche ba ni ye shes dang / yon tan rgyas pa mtshon no/ /zhesapa tsam mamagyogapar spro na'ang rgyasapar brjod/ slob dpon rdo rje phag mor bsgoms la mos gus dungab byos shig cesadang / mdun bskyed kyi lha'i rnam pa mdzo rtogasaltar gad la/ phag zhal don —179

pa ltar/ dbang bskur ba ni bdag la ༄65/ zhesagasol gsum gdab/ sirgyu ra'i yig 'bru'am/ dga' 'khyil lasaslob dpon gyi srin lag gisablangasanas/ slob ma'i lte bar byugs pas sid+dha ra'i dkyil 'khor gyi ye shes pa las ye shes pa gnyis pa zhig rgyang gis chad de/ slob ma'i lte ba'i baṃ la thim pas de nyid rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i skur khrong gis gyur par bsam/ da phyin chad phyi dang nang gi bdag nyid can gyi yi dam lha rdo rje rnal 'byor ma sgom pa dang ma 'bral bar gyis shig cesabarjod la spyi r+ya byugasashing / spyi bor rdo rje slob dpon bsgom pa dang ma bral bar gyis shig cesadang / dpral mgrin snying ga gsum du reg la/ lusangag yid gsum bde stong zung 'jug tu sgoms shig cesabarjod/ de ni shes rab ye shes kyi dbang ro/ /yig rnying phal che ba na 'og nasa'abyung ba'i rjesaganang drug gi dbang bzhi pa'i dod thub par bzhed kyang /'ga' zhig lasabazhi pa logasasu byed pa nyid legasapas/ yang marta(5 phul te/ cesad zhababashapadre'i bka' drin gyis/ /gtso bo'i dbang bskur rnam gsum thob/ /de ring rin chen bzhi pa yang / /bdag la bka' drin skyob tu gsol/ /zhesagasol gsum gdab/de nasaslob dpon gyis 'di skad cesabarjod de/ ltosashig rang gi sems la ltos/ /semasanyid cir yang grub pa med/ /grub pa med pa'i semasanyid la/ /sna tshogasasnang ba ngo mtshar che/ /snang tsam nyid kyang semasasu 'dug /snang ba semasakyi de nyid ni/ /bde ba chen po'i ye shes yin/ /rnam par mi rtog bsam mi khyab/ /gsal ba de yi ngo bor snang / /mosapa du ma'i semasacan la/ /thabasarnams sna tshogasakun tu ston/ /sna tshogasasgyu ma'i sbyor ba yis/ /dpa' bo seng ge bzhin du spyod/ /bsam gyisami khyab go 'phang thob/ /'di ni rje btsun byin —181—

pas/ mibya ba ni ci yang med/ /de nyid shes nas de nas ni/ /dpa' bo 'dod pa lnga spyod do/ /deng khyod kyi las dang po pa'i spyod pa dang / brtan pa thob pa'i spyod pa dang / brtan pa cher thob pa'i rig pa brtul zhugs kyi spyod pa rnams soso'i dus dang 'tshams par ma 'khrul pa'i spyod pa gyis shig lnga pa chosagad palasogs pa gzhan don gyi rjesaganang ni/ rten cing 'brel bar 'byung bcas shing / /semasacan sgyu ma'i rang bzhin no/ khams gsum de ltar shes nas ni/ /'gro ba'i don ni mnyam med byos/ /deng phyin chad rang gi nus pa dang 'tshams par skal bar ldan pa gzhan dag la 'gro ba'i don ci nusapar sgrubs shig drug pa bsrung ba'i rjesaganang ni/ gong bzhin slob ma'i lusal go cha bkod nas/ rdo rjesareg par bya/ go cha'i sngagasabarjod/ spyi bor rdo rje rgya gram du bzhag la/ skye( gsum ma dang / sum+bha/ tshar gcig brjod/ man ngag lasa'abyung ba bzhin bsrung ba'i 'khor lo yod na gdagasashing med na bsrung skud dmar po g.yon par spyi dang mthun par bcings/ bsrung ba'i sngags bzla zhing / bsrung bar bya'o/ /'di'i gzhan don rjesaganang gi skabasasu 'khor lo dung po ti rnamasagatad cing / chosabashad kyi rjesaganang spyi dang mthun pa ltar byed pa'i lugasakyang yod pasaspro na de ltar bya'o/ /de nas/ gtso bos ji ltar bka' stsal pa/ /sogs dang / maṇ+ḍal dang / deng nasabartsamasate bdag bran du/ /sogasabya ste/ spyi dang mthun no/ /gong du tshogasamachod ma btang na/ skabasa'adir btang ngo / /rjesakyi bya ba ni/ mchod pa kha gsos/ byin gyisarlabs/ mchod bstod gsol btab yig brgya bzod gsol gshegasagasol/ bdag bsrung tshamarngam smon lam bkra shis rnamasabya ste/ rje btsun ma'i chosaskor spyi dang mas pa yin no/ /de'i mchod 'phreng la sogasapa rgyas pa spro na dpal 'khor lo sdom pa'i cho gabazhin bya'o/ /—183

de ltar na zhal gnyisama'i sgrub thabasabyin rlabasadang bcasapa legasapar bshad zin to/ /dbu bcad ma dang don grub kyi byin rlabs kyi cho ga la/ 'di na mi 'dra ba'i khyad par ni/ dbu bcad mal/ rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor la sna tshogs pad+ma bri/ me long la lha mo gsum gyi sngags brtsegs nas 'bri ba dang / lhag ma lha sngags sa bon sogasakyi skabs so so'i mngon rtogs bzhin 'don pa bsgyur ba'i chog lha'i de nyid bstan pa'i skabs/ dbye bcad ma'i rtsa gsum bcad de dug gsum bcad pa mtshoni/ lha gsum ni sku gsum mdzadzan pa yin no/ /zhesabarjod/don grub ma la rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor la sna tshogs pad+ma 'dab bzhi bri/ me long lachos 'byung gi dbus su sngags gcig pu dang dga' 'khyil gyi tshab la sna tshogs rdo rje bri/ mdun bskyed dang / byin rlabs kyi skabs 'don pa spo/ khyad par dkyila'akhor gyi de nyid bstan pa'i skabs/ rdo rje rgya gram bzhi ni 'phrin las rnam par bzhis sems can gyi don mdzad pa mtshon zhes pa dang / lha'i de nyid kyi skabs/ phag zhal ni/ rtog med de bzhin nyid du chos thams cad rogacig pa dang / phyag bzhi las bzhi sgrubacing / sku bzhi 'grub par mtshon zhes 'don pa spo/ bla ma dpyal pa rnams kyi phyag len la/ zhal gnyis ma'i byin rlabs ma thob pa la dbu bcad ma dang / don grubama'i byin rlabs mi mdzad mod/ bla med kyi dbang bzhirdzogs par thob phyin chad/ zhal gnyis ma'i byin mas sngon du ma song kyang / de dag byin du rung ba kho na'o/ /rje tshon rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i chos skor la/ grub thob kyigazhungagi khungs dang / bla ma dam pa'i mnangag dngamakhas pa paṇ+ḍita'i legs bshad dang / byin rlabs kyi bka' ma nyams pa dang/ rdzogs rim dang / las tshogs su 'dzoms pa sogs sgo thams cad nas/ gzhal na 'di nyid kho na bzang ba yin no/ /dbu bcad ma dang / don —184

lusate dbang po lnga/ /ngag dang rkang lag bshang gci las dbang lnga/ /rang bzhin dag kyang de ltar ma gtogs pa'i/ /ma lus 'gro drug sems can tshogs/las dang nyon mongs sdug bsngal gyi/ /'khor lo bskor ba 'di dag ni/ /nges par byang chub la gzhug bya/ /snying ga'i baṃ las 'od zer 'phros/ khams gsum snod bcud 'od du zhu/ /rang lus la thim/ rang gi rkang pa gnyis ni brla gnyisal/ de lto ba la/ de sked pa la/ de yang snying ga la/ lag pa gnyis ni dpung pa la thim/ de yang snying ga la/ de mgrin pa la/ de mgo bo la thim/ de yang sems la thim/ sems nyid kyang nam mkha' la thim/ nam mkha' yang rang bzhin gyi 'od gsal ba la thim/ stong pa'i ngang las skad cig gis/ bskyed pa'am/chosa'abyung nam mkha'i khams kyi nang du pad nyi la gnas pa'i baṃ yig las/rang nyid bcom ldan 'dasam rdo rje phag mo rig pa 'dzin pa rtsen ma'i skur gyur pa ni/ dza ba'i me tog ltar rab tu dmar ba'i mdangs can/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis mche ba gtsigasashing / khro gnyer dang bcas pa'i gdong steng du phyogs pa/ dmar la zlum pa'i spyan gsum steng du gzigs pa/ dbu skra nag po sil bur grol zhing thur du 'phyar ba/ phyag g.yon pas thod pa bdud rtsis gang ba bzung nasazhabasagayon pa'i sgyid khung nas 'byud de steng du btegs nas/bdud rtsi'i rgyun zhal du 'bab pa/ phyag g.yasardo rje rtse lnga pa 'dzin pas/zhabs g.yas kyi rting pa'i phyogasasu bsnun pa/ zhabs g.yasa'aphur stangasasu cung zad brkyang ba/ klu shing gi me tog gi 'phreng ba phyag g.yon pa na bsnams pa/gcer bu rgyan spangasashing ye shesakyi me dpung 'bar ba'i dbusan bzhugs —186

pa'o/ /gnas rnams su zla ba'i gdan la/ ltebar oṃ baṃ dmar mordo rje phag monas/ tsaṇ+ḍikā'i ngo bo'i bar gyisago cha bcings/ rang bzhin gyi gnas nas rdo rje phagamo'i lha tshogs thams cad h+pha/ dzaḥ& baṃ lho snying ga'i baṃ las 'od zer 'phros/dbang gi lha rigs lnga mdun gyi nam mkhar spyan drangs/ oṃ a bhi ṣiñtsa hu me sarba ta thā ga ta/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ dbang gi lha rnams kyis/ ji ltar bltam pa nas/ 〈ye hūṃ/ zhes gsungs shing bum pa'i chus dbang bskur/ sku gang dri ma dag chu'i lhag ma yar lud pa las mibaskyod pas dbu brgyan/ arnya nasashap+ta'i bar gyisamachod/ dpal ldan rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma/ /gosaglo ka gnyis kyisabastod/bsdu na dkyusakyi nyamasalen la lagapa byin rlabasamed kyang chog dbu rgyan rang chasasu sgom/ mchod bstod kyang bor bsachog go /rdzogasarim ni/ lte bar chos 'byung zur drug pa'i nang du zla ba la baṃ yig sngags 'phreng grwa bcing dga' ba 'khyil ba bzhi dang bcas pa gsal btab la/g.yon bskor du drag tu 'khor bar dmigasapa dang / smin mtshams su dga' 'khyil rkyang pa dang / gsang gnas su chos 'byung kho na 'khor ba la dmigs kyang rung / hro kha sbyor du bzung bas rim pa bzhi du drod dang / mirtog pa dang / bde ba skyeb la bsngags so/ /de nas spyod yul du rgyu ba ni/ mkha' 'gro du ma'i spro bsdu dang bcas mkha' la 'phur zhing byon nas/ ma na r+ghaṃ ga dang /dpal gyi ri'i rtse mor man+ta ra wa ra dang / mya ngan kho pa dang yongs 'du'i shing gisabargyan pa'i sdum ra dang / rin po che'i rang bzhin gyi khang pa brtsegs pa rtsemo brgyad pa phan tshun du rgyu zhing 'jug par gyur/ zhabs g.yas g.yon gyi —187—

'jug pa'o/ /bzhi pa ni mirtog pa ste/ sna sgor dga' ba 'khyil ba drag tu 'khorabalasems gtod du gzhug lngapa ni bde ba ste/ gsang gnas su dga' 'khyil drag tu'akhor ba la sems gtod pa'o/ /de rnamasare re'i mthar slob dpon gyisartsa sngagasadrag tu bzlasashing / rol mo'i sgra rdzas kyi dud pa dang bcas pasabyin dbab pa'o/ /de rnams shes rab ye shes bzhi par bcas pa'i dod yin no/ /de las ye shes phebs pa'i rtagasagang yang rung ba byung ba dang / tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra gyisabartan par bya'o/ /rjesal gsum las/ dang po spyod pa'i rjes gnang ni/ dmigasapa gsum las/ dang po ni/ bdag nyid khang bzang dang sdum ra rtse mo brgyad pa'i dbusan gnasapa las/ de'i mdun na rin po che'i brag ri shin tu mtho ba/ rtse mo mig gisakyang bltar mi bzod pa gsum yod par bsam/ rang nyid je mtho je mthor 'phur bas/ ri'i steng gi nam mkhar sleb nas/ ri gsum gyi rtse mo la rkang pa reg tsam reg tsam 'dug pa la semasagatod du bzhug gnyis pa ni yang de bas kyang mtho bar phyin te/rang gi lusalasarigasalnga dang / rnal 'byor ma dpag tu med pa spros/ sems can gyi don byas/ 'khor 'das snod bcud kyi dwangasam rnamasadangul chu ltar bsdusate rang la thim pas rgyud bde bsagang / yang sprosayang thim pa lan mang du bya/mthar de nasakyang je mtho je mthor 'phrur te/ mkha' dbyingasasu thim pa snyam byed/ yang lha skur shar ba snyam byed pa la semasagatong du bcug deganyisalar rol mo'i sgra bya/ gsum pa ni/ slob ma lha mo'i 'dugastangasabyar bcug lag g.yas su hūṃ zhesaye shesalnga'i rang bzhin gyi rdo rje rtse lnga gtad/ g.yon du dkyil 'khor gyi ka pā la gtad la/ nang mchod cung zad las du bcug la/ mgo rtogasasubashad pa'i 'khor —193

'dir phag mo zhal gnyisam in+d+ra mkha' spyod du grags pa'i sgrub thabasanyams su len par 'dod pas/skyabasasemasasngon du bto / nang mchod bdud rtsir byin gyisarlabasapar mos ste/ oṃ 02PROB/ der chosa'abyung 'bri tso byed cing / dbus kyi baṃ las 'od 'phros/ dpa' bo dpa' mo rnams kyis bdud rtsi'i char phab pas thod pa gang / gnasagasum du thig le bya zhig oṃ 42PROB lag pa g.yon pa'i mthil dang / mthe'u chung nasabartsamasapa'i sor mo rnamasal bdud rtsisagator zhing / oṃ baṃ/ haṃ oṃ/ hri oṃ/ hri hri/ hūṃ hūṃ/ phaṭa phaṭa/ cesalag pa byin gyis brlabs/ oṃswa bhā wa shud+dha sarba dharma swa bhā wa shuzlo3nya/ oṃ badz+ra shud+dha sarba dharma badz+ra shuzlo3nya/ oṃ yo ga shud+dha sarba dharma yo ga shud+dhi3lha/ stong pa'i ngang las rang lus dang khams gsum rnam par dag pa gzhal yas khang gi ngo bo chos 'byung / de'i dbus su zla ba'i steng du e yig yongs su gyur pa las baṃ/ rang sems dang lte ba'i gtum mo 'bar ba'i ngo bo/ de nyid yongs su gyur pa las/ rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma/bskyed pa na dpyal lugasazhal gnyisama'i sgrub thabasasu bshad pa ltar bsgom/ sku mdog dmar ser ram dmar ba kho na las/ se'abru'i me tog ltar dmar smugatu mi bzhed de nasago cha dgod pa dang / ye shesapa bstim pa dang / mchod bstod rnamasakyang de dang 'dra ba las/ bstod pa'i skabs/ dpal ldan rdo rje mkha' 'aX| ma/ /sogasablo ka gnyisakho na mdzad/ yig rnying rnamasalasa'abyung ba ltar rdzogasarim kyang cung zad bsgom/ skyed gsum ma'i bzlasapa'ang ci 'grub bya/ mtharanā ro mkha' spyod kyi sgrub thabasasubashad pa ltar gyi gsol btab/ dag pa gsum dran pa smon lam rnamasabya/ gtor chog ni gtor ma gnyisanā ro mkha' spyod ltar byin gyisabarlabasanas/ h+pha/ rang bzhin gyi gnas nas rdo rje rnal 'byor ma la sangasargyas dang byang chub sems dpa' dpa' bo rnal 'byor ma'i tshogs thams cad kyis bskor ba oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ a ral+li ho/ dzaḥ( baṃ hoḥ—195

yis tshig pa la/ /myu gu sngon po skye mi srid/ khyod rnams rnam rtog thams cad spongs la lha dang bla ma la mos gus drag po bskyed cig cesabarjod la/ bum chu dgasum bhasabasangs/ yang tshe baṃ gyi phyag rgya dang / sum̐ bhasabasrung ba bya/ gu gul sogasakyisadapasa'adug cing / rkang mthil gyi rlung gis sum mdo'i me sbar/ phung khams skye mched thams cad bsregs te stong par sbyangs bar mos la/ dag pa gsum gyi sngagasabarjod/skad cig gis slob ma rje btsun mar bskyed/ ltebar sngags 'khor gsal btab/ de las 'od zer 'phros g.yas ro ma nas song / spyi bo nasathon/phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas byang sems thams cad spyan drangs spyi bor thim/ haṃ yig zhu ba'i rgyun dbu ma nas byung / lte bar babs pa la sems gtod du bcug la/ oṃ gsum ma 'don chi rol mo'i sgra bya/ yang lte ba nas 'od 'phros/ ro ma'i lam rgyud/ phagagadong gi smin mtshams thon/ g.yung drung g.yon skor du drag tu 'khor ba la sems gtod du bcug la/ rol chen dang sngags bzla/ yang lte ba'i sngags 'khor de nyid gsang gnas su phab la/ g.yon bskor du 'khor ba la sems gtod du bcug la/ rol chen dang sngagasabazlas/ de nasaye shesaphab pa brtan byed dang / me rtag 'bul ba/ mig dar 'grol ba/ lha ngo bstan pa rnams kyang nā ro mkha' spyod bzhin/ de nasadangosagazhi'i don du maṇ+ḍal 'bul ba nas/ rigasabadag gisargyasa'adebasapa'i bar nā ro mkha' spyod dang 'dra ba las/byang chub rdo rje sangs rgyas la/ /sogasakyisagasol ba 'debs/ oṃ phun sum tshogasapa mnga' ba sogasakyisabakra shisabarjod/ mi bskyod pa kho nas dbu rgyan/ de ni bum dngazhi la/ gsang dbang yang nā ro mkha' spyod dang 'dra ba las/ dmigs pa'i gsal kha med/ shesarab ye shesakyi dbang la/ sngagasa'aphreng nasasis ra blangasate lte bar byugs/ skye( gsum ma bzlas/ sngags rnamab/—197
