par byasal/ dam tshig gisabakang ba'i ka pā la/ sdo/ma bha'am/khaṇ+ḍas31 ha'i sngagasakyisabasangs/swa bhā wasasbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang lasaye las rlung / raṃ lasame/ a las thod pa dkar po dum bu gsum pa'i nang du/ (lha e dzi khaṃ las sha lnga/ paṃ baṃ lo me haṃ las bdud rtsi lnga/ de rnams 'od du zhu/ mdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur pa'i dbus su/ chos 'byung gi lte bar hrīḥzur gsum la g.yon bskor gyi/ oṃ hūṃ ha/de'i 'od kyis snod bcud thams cad dang khyad par rgyal ba sras bcas thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs kyi bdud rtsi byang chub sems su spyan drangs nasathim/oṃ āḥ& ha ho hrīḥ bdud rtsi bdag dang gnasal gtor te/ oṃ hrīḥgha gha ghā ta ya ghā ta ya/sarba duṣ+ṭi hūṃ phaṭa swāhā/ khro mo rnams kyis bgegs rnams tshar bcad/ bsrung ba'i 'khor lor grub par gyur/ rang gi gnas rnams su/ oṃ baṃ gsago cha drug dgod/ oṃ swa bhā wa shud+dha sarba dharma swa bhā wa shud+dhi3haṃ/ oṃ badz+ra shud+dha sarba dharma badz+ra shurnyo3nya/ oṃ yo ga shud+dha sarba dharma yo ga shud+dhi3nya/ stong pa'i ngang lasachos 'byung gi dbusasu/ pad+ma dmar po 'dab ma bzhi pa'i lte bar 'od stong bdag po'i dkyil 'khor la gnas pa'i dbugasabral gyi snying gar rang sems hrīḥyig dmar po bskal pa'i me ltar snang ba/ de yongs su gyur pa lasabadag nyid rdo rje phag mo likhri'i mdangasaltar dmar ba'i mdog can pad+ma dang nyi ma yidwagasakyi gdan la g.yas brkyang ba'i gyad kyi dor stabs kyis sagasum gnon pa/ zhal gcig pa spyan gsum pa khro gnyer bsdus pa/ drag mochen mo/ 'jigasasu rung ba'i zhal phag gi gdong can shin tu khros pa rdo rje'i me 'od 'bar zhing ljagasabaskyod pa/ dbu skra kham pa gyen du 'khyil ba/ ba spu dang / gsang ba'i spu gyen du —199

thabs kyi rang bzhin gyi kha ṭ+wāṃ ga dkar po/ g.yon du rdo rje rabs bsngags ma ljang khu zhabs g.yon brkyang / g.yas gri gug dang g.yon thod pa 'dzin pa/g.yas su rnam snang ma ser mo zhabs g.yaba'ibarkyang / phyag g.yas gri gug g.yon thod pa 'dzin pa/ gsum ga'ang thod skam lnga'i dbu brgyan dang / rlon pa lnga bcu'i 'phreng ba 'phyang ba/ phyag rgya lnga dang ldan pa/ gcer mo spyan gsum dbu skra nag po sil bur grol ba/ mizad pa'i zhal khro zhing 'dzum pa/ 'jigs pa'ang 'jigs par mdzad cing me dpung 'bar ba'i dbus na gnas pa rnams kyi gsang gnas su chos 'byung re re/ dbus kyi nang du/ chasarba bud+dha ḍa kyini hūṃ phaṭa swāhā/ g.yon gyi la/ oṃ badz+ra war+ṇa ni ye hūṃ phaṭa/ g.yasakyi la/ rtsi badz+ra piro tsa ni ye hūṃ phaṭa/ yi ge rnams yongs su brtsegasapa gtso mo'i phyag g.yasakyi gri gug gis nyid kyi dbu bcad nas/ thod pa 'dzin pa'i phyag gis dbu skra'i phyed bzung spyan gsum thur du gzigs/ rtsa gsum bcad mtshams nas dbus nas byang sems dkar dmar 'dres pa'i rgyun byung ba rang nyid kyi zhal du 'bab par gyur/ g.yon brkyang ma nasami bskyod pa dang 'dres pa'i kun da'i rgyun g.yon gyi zhal du babs/ g.yas ro ma nas khrag phal ba dang 'dres pa'i rdul g.yas kyi zhal du babs/ yun ci rigasapar gsal la drag par bsgom/ de nas thur sel gyen du drangs pas/ gsang gnas kyi sngagasalasa'od zer steng du 'phros/ lam gsum nas byung / g.yas g.yon gyi lha mo gnyis 'od zer gyis drangs/ ro rkyang gi lam brgyud/ lha moganyis chos 'byung dang bcas pa bdag nyid chos 'byung dang bcas pa dang dbyer med du gyur/ sngags gnyis chos 'byung —202

shing mche ba gtsigs pa/ shin tu gtum pa'i tshul can/ gcer bu skra grol ba/phyag g.yasardo rjesamatshan pa'i gri gug gam/ rdo rje sdigs pas lha min gyi gdon thams cad skrag par mdzad pa/ g.yon zhabs g.yon pa la yongasasu 'khril zhing / ka pā la bdud rtsisagang ba steng gi phyogs su bzung ba la zhal gyen du phyogs pas bdud rtsigasol ba/ nam mkha' la de bzhin gshegs pa'i tshogasarnams yab yum rjes su chagasapa snyomasapa zhugasapa'i bdud rtsi dkar dmar thod par 'bebasashing bum pa'i dbang bskur ba/ phrag pa la rdo rje mtshan pa'i kha ṭ+wāṃ ga bkal ba/ zhabs g.yasapa sa 'og bdun gyi 'jig rten du brkyang bsa'ajigasabyed dang dusamatshan ma mnan pa/ g.yon steng phyogasatshangasapa'i 'jig rten du brkyang bsatshangs pa dang brgya byin steng phyogasakyi 'jig rten la mnan pa/rgyan spangs pa/ zhalanasabadud rtsi 'bab pa/ sku lasarang mtshungs kyi rdo rje rnal 'byor ma dang / sangs rgyasabyang chub semasadapa' dang / khro bo khro mo dpag tu med pa 'gyed pa/ tshedapung rab tu 'bar ba'i dbusan bzhugs shing / dur khrod ོ po brgyad kyisayongs su bskor ba/ phyi rol bsrung ba'i 'bor lo dang bcas pa'o/ /rang gi lte ba nas hūṃ gcig spros pas mdun du sprul pa'i pho nya phyag na rdo rje he ru ga'i cha byad can/ g.yasardo rje dang g.yon phur bu thogs pa/yang sprul lcags kyu dang zhags pa thogasapa dpag tu med pa spros/ khyab 'jug chen po mi yi seng ge la sogs pa bgegasathamasacad bkug / lasabyung ba'i rdo rje'i khron par bcug phur bus bto cing rdo rje'i rdul tsam du brlag par byas/ 8 losnrogha gha ghā ta ya ghā ta ya hūṃ phaṭa/ zhesanyeraganigatsamadrag tu bzla/ ltebaraskyes—205

rab ye shesabazhi pa bcasapa thob ste/ lha sku snang stong zung 'jug phyag rgya chen po'i ngang du gyur/ lag pa g.yasagayon gyi mthil du a lasazla ba la hrīḥ de la bdud rtsi'i chu blug pasahrīḥyig bkrus te 'o ma'i rgyun du gyur nas/ yi dwags rnams kyis 'thungs pasatshim zhing / chos sku'i bde ba dang ldan pasarang gi gnas su dengs par gyur/ hrīḥbazla zhing lag pa bkru/ de nasaskyabasasemasatshad med bzhi rnamasaspyi dang 'dra bar bya/ oṃ swa bhā wa bi shud+dha sarba dharma swa bhā wa bi shud+dhi3nya/ ༄ngapa'i ngang las snying ga'i thad tsam gyi nam mkhar gyidakar po zhu ba las dbus su thig le dkar po chen po/ g.yas g.yon du thig le dkar po chung ngu rere dang bcas par gyur/ de rnamasayongasasu gyur pa las/ gtso 'khor gsum du gyur pa ni/dbus su 'phags pa spyan ras gzigasadabang phyug sku mdog dkar po gangs ri la nyi ma shar ba lta bu ston zla 'bum gyi gzi brjid can/ zhal gcig phyag bzhi'i dang po gnyis thugs gar thal mo sbug por sbyar ba/ g.yas 'og mas mu tig gi 'phreng ba dang / g.yon 'og masapad+ma dkar po 'dab ma brgyad pa yu ba dang bcas pa snyan gyi thad gar kha bye ba 'dzin pa/ zhal gyi dkyil 'khor rab tu zhi zhing 'dzum pa/ spyan gnyisasemasadapa'i lta stangs kyis sal 'dom gang tsam du gzigasapa/ dbu skra ral pa'i thor tshugs spyi bor bcings pa'i phyed dpung pa gnyis kyi steng du 'khyil zhing / rtse mo rlung gis bskyod pa ri dwagasakyi pagasapas nu ma g.yon pa bkab pa/ dar sna tshogs pa'i stod g.yogasadang /dmar po'i smad dkrisagasol ba/ rin po che'i rgyan thams cad kyisabargyan pa/zhabs rdo rje'i skyil krung gisabazhugasashing / 'bor los bsgyur ba'i cha lugs —226

can/ mtshan dpe yongs su rdzogs shing / 'od dpag med kyis dbu brgyan pa/'od dang 'od zer dpag tu med pa 'phro zhing pad zla rgyas pa'i gdan la rol pa'o/ /de'i g.yasasu nor bu 'dzin pa sku mdog ser po phyag dang po gnyis thal mo sbyar ba/ g.yas gnyis pa'i mtheb mdzub sbyar bas rin po che dbang gi rgyal po yu ba dang bcas pa 'dzin zhing / g.yon gnyis pas rin po che'i lcug phran gyi yal ga 'bras bu'i snye ma lhung bar 'gyur ba'i ngang tshul can bsnamasapa/g.yon du yi ge drug ma gtso bo dang mtshungs pa las lha mo'i cha byad 'josgeg gi rnam 'gyur dang ldan pa/ 'khor gnyis gar gtso bo'i zhal ras la lta zhing /pusamo phyogs gcig sa la btsugs pa'o/ /yang na pad+ma dkar po'i tshab tu.āt+paladakar po 'dzin pa dang / gtso'akhor gsum char gdan can nam/ gsum skar gdan med byasakyang rung ngo / /rang gi snying gar a las zla ba nya gang ba'i steng du/ hrīḥdakar po de las 'od zer 'phros/ ye shes sems dpa' 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs gtso 'khor gsum badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ arnya nasashap+ta'i bar gyisamachod pa lan gsum bya/ thugasarje chen pos bdag la sems can thams cad kyi don du phyag rgya chen po mchog gi dngos grub myur du thob par mdzad du gsol/ lanagasum/ lha gsum po dam tshigapa so so'i spyi bo nas gnyis su med par thim/ dz+rarnyisneb lho snying gar zla ba la hrīḥyig sngags 'phreng dang bcas par gyur/ oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūṃ/ zhesaci nusabazla zhigasku snang stong / ngag grag stong / sems stong nyid snying rje'i rang bzhin sngags kyi sgras sems can rnams kyi nyen mongs pa dag pa'i 'phrin las rnams yid la bya'o/ /sa 'jog khar/ rang gi snying ga'i hrīḥyig gi 'od zer gyis/ snod kyi 'jig—227

rten 'od du zhu/ bcud kyi sems can la thim/ de rnamasagatso 'khor gsum la thim/ 'khor gnyis kyang bdag nyid la thim/ rang yang snying ga'i hrīḥl thim/hrīḥthig le yungs 'bru tsam du gyur/ de mtha' nas yal te stong nyid du gyur/ cung zad mnyam par bzhagastong pa'i ngang lasathig le las hrīḥde lasagatso 'khor gsum/ de las bcud lha dang / snod gzhal yas khang du gyur gnyis po rang nyid la thim/ dgeb byang chub tu bsngo/ thun mtshamasasubyamasasnying rje dang ma bral bar bya zhing / brulagator ci nus gtor/ gtor chogani dkar gtor cha gnyisadang / mchod pa gtsang sbra can du bsham/ a mṛ tasab4sa/ swa bhā wasasbyangs/ rin po che'i snod du gtor ma 'dod yon gyi rgya mtsho oṃ āḥsnyi gis mtshan pa/ hūṃ gis skyon sbyangs/ āḥs bdud rtsir byas/ oṃ gyis mang por spel bar gyur/ oṃ āḥsnyi lan gsum rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros/ po ṭa la nasa'aphags pa spyan ras gzigs 'khor dang bcas pa badz+ra samā dzaḥ na ma sarba ta thā ga ta a wa med ki te oṃ sam+bha ra sam+bha ra hūṃ lan bdun dgayi ge 'brugasum nyi shu rtsa ga:gabarjod de 'bul/ asgonasashap+ta'i bar gyis mchod/ sangs rgyas kun gyi rab tu bsngags/ /yon tan dam pa kun gyi gzhi/ /spyan rasagazigs zhes mtshan gsol ba/ /rtag par brtse la phyag 'tshal lo/ /skyon gyi ma gosasogasadang / mtshan dpe cha shas yongs su rdzogs pa'i skur/ /ston da'i zla ba 'bum khrag 'khrigasapa'i gzi/ /rin chen bye ba'i rgyan gyis rnam par brgyan/ thugasarje chen po khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gtor ma gnyisapa'ang sngar bzhi gyisabyin gyisabarlabs/ klusman dang / 'bru chanabato/ rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros/ phyi'i rgya mtsho chen po nas/ klu rgyal wa ru ṇa badz+ra samā dzaḥ ljagasasne lasabyung ba'i rdo rje'i sbu gus —228

'di'i rjesaganang byed par 'dod pas/ maṇ+ḍal pad+ma 'dab brgyad/ dbusadang phyogs bzhir zla gdan la dbusasu tshom bu dmar po/ shar sngo/ rnya ser/ nub dkar/ byang ljang khu rnamasabakod/ mtshamasakyi 'dab ma bzhi la tshom bu ser po re bya/ gtor ma 'dasagator gcig bya/ cha gsum gtor ma dang / klu gtor la sogasagang 'osabashams/ mchod pa yang ci bder bsgrigs/ bdag bskyed sngon du 'gro bsamachod pa byin rlabasaspyi dang mthun/ mdun bskyed bsangasasbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las rang gi snying kha'i hrīḥlas: chad de/ mdun bskyed kyi gnas su babs pa/ gzhalamed khang gru bzhi sgo bzhi rta babs bzhi dang ldan pa/ mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogasapa'i dbus dang pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad pa'i phyogs bzhir zla ba'i gdan re re/ dbus su 3yig dkar po yongs su gyur pa las/ 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs ston ga'i zla ba ltar dkar ba zhesapa nas/ 'phro ba'i sku can zhogapa'ibaragobazhi/ de'i dbu gtsug tu sangs rgyas thod dpag med dmar po mnyam bzhag giphyag rgya mdzad pa/ shar du hūṃ lasami bskyod pa sngon po sa gnon gyi phyag rgyacan/lhor traṃ las rin chen 'byung ldan ser po mchog sbyin gyi phyag rgya can/ nub tu oṃ las rnam snang dkar po byang chub mchog gi phyag rgya can/ byang du a las don yod grub pa ljang khu skyabs sbyin gyi phyag rgya can/ gshegasapa gzhan gsum g.yon mnyam bzhag mdzad pa/ thamasacad kyang rdo rje skyil krung gis bzhugs shing sangs rgyas rab tu byung ba'i cha lugasacan no/ /mtshams kyi 'dab ma bzhin bum pa bzhi grub par gyur/ lha de thams cad kyi dpral bar oṃ zhesapa nagashrī ye hūṃ dbang bskur bar gyur/ zhesabarjod kyi rigasabadag gi rgyasa'adebs mi dgosago /denasamachod pa 'bul ba ni/ spro na/ rab 'byamasargya mtsho sogs tshigs 4da brjod cing / bas/—234

rnamasakyi steng lho dang nub tu raṃ las nyi ma/ gzhan rnams su a las zla ba/ nam mkha'i hrīḥyig dbus kyi gdan gyi steng du babs pa las/ pad+ma dkar po hrīḥs mtshan pa/ de las 'od 'phros 'dus yongs su gyur pa las/ rang nyid 'phagasapa spyan ras gzigs sku mdog ston ga'i zla ba ltar dkar ba/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis g.yasamachog sbyin dang / g.yon pad+ma dkar po 'dzin pa/ zhabs g.yas brkyang ba'i rol pa'i stabs kyisabazhugasashing / ri dwags kyi pags pas smad dkris pa/ ral pa'i thor tshugs can/ phyugasabadag gis cha lugs/ sangasargyas 'od dpag med kyis dbu la brgyan pa/ gapon gyi lha mo la gzigs pa'o/thugs gar zla ba'i steng du pad+ma dkar po 3yig gis mtshan par gyur/ shar du ha las zhags pa hasamatshan pa las don yod zhags pa dmar po phyag g.yasaganyis na zhags pa dang rdo rje/ g.yon gnyis na lcags kyu dang bgrang 'phreng 'dzin pa/ rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa/ mnyam par bzhedas pa'o/ /lhor hūṃ las dbyug pa hūṃ gis mtshan pa las rta mgrin dbu'i steng du rta mgo ljang khu can/phyag g.yas gnyis na dbyug pa dang sdigs mdzub/ g.yon gnyisan 'khor lo ser po dang / pad+ma dmar po'i sdong bu 'dzin pa g.yon brkyang gi stabs can no/ /nub tu pha las ral gri phas mtshan pa las/ ral gcig ma sngon mo phyag g.yas pa bzhisaral gri zhags pa pad+ma mda'/ g.yon pa bzhisa'akhor lo dbyug pa rtsegasum gzhu rnams 'dzin pa/ g.yasabarkyang gi stabasacan/ de gnyisaka yang stag lpagasadang / sprul dang rin po ches brgyan pa/ shin tu khrosapa'o/ /byang du ṭa las dbyug to ṭasamatshan pa las khro gnyer can ma dkar sham/—237

lasa'od zer 'phros/ po ṭa la nasadon zhags lha lnga'i dkyil 'khor badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ mgon po hrīḥyig lasabyung zhing / /thugasani bde ba ches brlan pa/ /don yod zhags pa zhesabya ba'i/ /'jig rten mgon la bdag phyag 'tshal/ /oṃ a mo gha pā sha lo ke shwa rā ya/ arnya pra tīts+tsha hūṃ swāhā/ pas/ añtsa ma rna/ puṣ+ṭi nasashap+ta'i bar gyis mchod/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabasamachi/ /sogs bya/ tshad med bzhi spyi dang mthun par bsgom/ skyed swa gawasasngagasakyi sgyu ma ltabur sbyangs/ snying ga'i hrīḥyig gi 'od kyis rjesagazhig gis stong par bsdus la/ shā n+ya ta'i sngagasabarjod/stong pa'i ngang las paṃ las sna tshogs pad+ma/ a las zla ba/ de'i steng du hrīḥyig 'od kyis 'phro 'du las lha lnga'i rnam par gyur pa ni/ rang nyid dbus su don yod zhags pa dkar po zhal gnyig phyag brgyad pa/ g.yas pa rnamasarim pas/skyabs sbyin/ mchog sbyin/ zhags pa/ bgrang 'phreng / g.yon rnams rim pas dbyug gu rtse gsum/ glegasabam/ pad+ma/ spyiblugasa'adzin pa/ dar dkar po'i na bza' dang / stag gi lpags pa'i smad dkris can/ dka' thub kyi cha byad dang ldan pa/ de'i g.yasasu nor bzang gzhon nu ser po mchan khung g.yon par po ti bcug nas thal mo sbyar ba/ de'i g.yasazur du sgrol ma ljang khu/ g.yon pas ut+pal bsnamasashing g.yas pas kha 'byed pa/ de gnyis dar dang rin po che sna tshogasapas brgyan pa/ gtso bo'i g.yon ngos su rta mgrin dmar po mi'u thung gi rnam pa can/ spyan gsum mche gtsigasaskra ser gyen du brdzes pa sogasakhro bo'i mtshan nyid yongasasu rdzogs pa/ stag lpagasadang sbrul gyis brgyan pa/ g.yasaphyag 'tshal ba'i tshul dang / g.yon dbyug pa dkar po la brten pa/ de nyid kyi ci 242

gyur pa ni/ zla ba dri ma med pa'i mdog can/ rgyal ba 'od dpag tu med pas dbu la brgyan pa/ phyag g.yas mchog sbyin mdzad pa/ de las bdud rtsi'i rgyun 'bab pa srid pa can mtha' dag tshim par mdzad pa/ snyan gyi thad gar kha 'bus pa'i pad+ma dkar po'i sdong bu'i rtsa ba phyag g.yon pa'i mtheb srin gyi thugs gar 'dzin pa/ zhabs g.yas brkyang ba'i skyil krung phyed pa'i rol bas bzhugs pa/'dzum bag dang bcas shing / ral pa'i cod pan can/ pad+ma'i 'dab ma ltar rab tu yangs ba'i spyan zung rnam par bkra ba la sogs pa/ mtshan dang dpe byad yongs su rdzogs pa/ ri dwags kyi pags pasanu ma g.yon pa bkab cing / dar dkar gyis smad dkris pa/ rgyan thams cad kyis spras shing 'od dang 'od zer rab tu 'bar ba'i sku can/ shing rta'i 'phang lo tsam gyi pad+ma dkar po'i lte bar/ri dwags kyis rnyog pa dang bral ba'i bsil zer can gyi gdan la bzhugs pa'o/ /g.yas su sgrol ma ljang khu mchog sbyin dang ut+pal 'dzin pa/ lang tsho la bab cing / nu ma rgyas pa/ daradang rin po che'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa/ de'i g.yas su nor bzang gzhon nu gser gyi mdog can thal mo sbyar ba/ mchan khung g.yon du po ti bcug pa/ byis pa'i rgyan dang cha lugs kyisaspras pa/ gtsobo'i g.yon du khro gnyer can ma gser mdog rgyan spangs pa ral ba'i cod pan can/ phyag bzhizhi g.yas gnyis phyag 'tshal ba'i tshul dang / bgrang 'phreng / g.yon gnyisadabyug gu rtse gsum dang / spyi byugs bsnams pa/ zhi ba'i spyan gsum dang ldan zhing / na bza' dmar po gsol ba'o/ /de'i g.yon du rta mgrin dmar po bskal pa'i me ltar 'bar ba/ lho ba 'phyang zhing / spyan gsum pa/ mche ba —247

/ 'phagasapa spyan rasagazigasadabang ni/ /yid bzhin nor bu lha lnga yi/ /tshogasabacasagusapasabatud bcasate/ /a ti sha yi gzhung bzhin bri/ /skyabasasemasasngon du 'gro bas/ spro na gzhung nasa'abyung ba ltar/ tshogasazhing spyan drangasate/ bdun rnam dag bya/shā n+ya tasastongasapar sbyangs/ yaṃ raṃ baṃ lo/ sum̐ las 'byung bzhi ri rab dang bcas pa'i rtse mor paṃ las pad+ma 'dab brgyad kyi lte bar a las zla ba der hrīḥyig 'od kyi 'phro 'du las/ 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs sku mdog dmar po/ phyag dang po gnyis pad+ma dmar po'i sdong bu 'dzin zhid kha 'byed pa/ gnyis pa gnyisakyis bgrang 'phreng dang / ghun+dhe 'dzin pa/ rdo rje skyil krung gis bzhugs pa/ ri dwags kyi pags pa dang / rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa/ 'od dpag med kyis dbu brgyan/ thugs gar zla ba la rdo rje'i lte bar pad+ma lhasamatshan pa/ de lasalha mobazhi spros te phyogasakyi 'dab mar 'khod pa ni/ shar du ha las rdo rje zhags pa ma zhags pa dang nor bu 'dzin pa/ lho ru traṃ las rdo rje rin chen ma nor bu dang dril bu 'dzin pa/ nub tu hrīḥlas ral gcig ma pad+ma dang bgrang 'phreng 'dzin pa/ byang du ṭa las khroganyer ma sna tshogasardo rje dang/ ghun+dhe bsnamasapa/ sku mdog cha lugs gtso bo dang mtshungs pa'o/ /ye shes dgug gzhug spyi dang 'dra/ dbang bskur yang spyidang 'dra ba las/ yum bzhi'i dbang bskur/ rigs bdag rgyasagadab mi dgos/ gnas gsum byin rlabs dran par byas nasabazlas pa bya ste/ snying gar 'bor lo rtsibasadrug pa'i lte ba dang rtsibasal nye snying bkod/ mu khyud la rtsa ba'i sngags bsgom ste/ na mo rat+na tra yā ya/ na mo ār+ya a ba lo ke te shwa rā ya/ bo dhi satwa ya/ ma hā sa tā ya/ mahā ka dra ṇi ka ya/ tabya thā/ oṃ tsakra warti tsin+ta ma ṇi mahā —251—

༄༅/ /chaswā sti/ 'khor losabasgyur rgyal stong rtsa dang / /4r+sārgyas stong gosprul pa'i gzhi/ /nam mkha'i rgyal por rab gragasapa/ /spyan rasagazigasal phyag 'tshal lo/ /bzang spyod nasa'abyung ba'i yan lag bdun pa tshar gsum bya/ skyabasa'agro semasabaskyed spyi dang mthun/ stong nyid bsam zhing swa bhā wa brjod cing / snying rje dung ba bsgom/ pad zla la hrīḥlasarang nyid 'phagasapa spyan ras gzigasanam mkha'i rgyal po sku mdog dkar la dmar ba'i mdangs chagasapa/ rtsa zhal gsum dkar la zhi ba/ de steng gsum ser la bzhad pa/de'i steng gnyis mthing nag khros pa/ de'i steng gnyis dmar smug mche ba gtsigs pa/ de rnams spyan gsum gsum dang ldan zhing / kun gyi steng na 'od dpag med kyi zhal lo/ /chos sku'i rtsa phyag bcu las dang po gnyis thal mo sbyar ba/ lhag ma g.yas pa'i mu tig gi 'phreng ba/ 'khor lo/ mchog sbyin/ sangs rgyas kyi sku gzugs/ g.yon pas pad+ma spyiblugs/ rin po che/ mda' gzhu sbrags pa'o/ /yan lag gi phyag sum cu rtsa brgyad las/ g.yasarnams rin chen zhags pa lhung bzed ral gri rdo rje rgya gram chu shel me shel gzhu ser po/ /lcug ma rnga yab phub dang bum pa dgra sta 'phreng ba pad sngon ghun+dhe'i nyi ma dkar po'o/ /g.yon rnams sprin dkar ral pa pad ser ral gri dung dang thod dbyug 'phreng ba dril bu rdo rje dang / /lcags kyu bsil yab sprul sku khang bzang glegs bam 'khor lo sbrul gzugs dgun 'bru pad dmar nor bu'o/ /nying lag gi phyag stong rtsa gnyisamachog sbyin mdzad pa/ phyag thams cad kyi mthil na spyan mnga' ba/ zhabs gnyis/mnyam par bzhengs pa/ ridwags kyi pags pa/ phrag pa la gzar ba/ dar dang rin po che dang sbrul gyis brgyan pa/ mtshan dpe yongs—255

skyob dkar po/ g.yas skyabs sbyin dang rin po che/ g.yon pad+ma dang 'khor lo/de bzhin du 'og ma rnams la yang / phyag dang po gnyisaskyabarme sbyin dang pad+ma khonar shes pa/ nub tu seṅge 'jigs skyob ser po nor bu dang po ti/ byang du glang po'i 'jigs skyob dmar ser ut+pal dang me shel/ shar lhor chad pa'i 'jigasaskyob dmar po lcags kyu dang zhags pa/ lho nub tu klu'i 'jigs skyob ljang khu rgyal mtshan dang ghun+dhe can chu srin la gnas pa/ nub byang du mkha' 'gro'i 'jigs skyob nag po rtse gsum dang ba dan can/ byang shar du mi rgod 'jigs skyob dmar po rdo rje dang dril bu/ de thams cad kyang khro bo'i nyams can/ khro bo'i rgyan dang cha lugasayongs su rdzogs pa/ g.yon brkyang gostabs can no/ /mngon rtogasakyi lhag ma dang / gzungs sngags kyi dpal mo lugasaji lta ba bzhin du bya/ 'di la gtor chog mi dgos/ rjes gnang yang mi dgosate lung tsam gyisa'agrub bo/ /slob dpon tsan+d+ra go ma'i bzhed par gragasapa/ dpal ldan a ti sha'i lugasakyi man ngag go /'jigasapa kun las skyob pa yi/ /sgrub thabasamachog tu nyamasadaga'i gnas/ /yig snying rgyasapa'i tshigasachen gyis/ /snying po bsdusapa 'di tsam lags/ /bcu gcig zhal 'jigasapa brgyad skyob kyi sgrub thabasakyi le tshan no// //dar rgyasa'aphel/ maṅga lo//ra༅༅/ /tsortsoswā sti/ gang zhig bsgoms shing bzlos pa yis/ /dkor dang sbagasapa'i nyesapa sogs/ /kun 'jomasaspyan rasagazigasakyi ni/ /sgrub thabasadam pa bshad par bya/ /thun gyi mgor sdig bshags gang 'grub dang / skyabasa'agro sems bskyed byasal/ rang skad cig gis lnga( bo spyan ras gzigasasku mdog dkar la zhal dbus ma lnga brtsegs shin tu khrosapa sngon po/ g.yas gsum brtsegs dkar ba dang / g.yon gsum brtsegs dmar ba zhi —259

bsags bcu gsum sogasabyed pa 'di la thun mong ma yin pa zer ba'i brda chad mdzad kyin 'dug cing /rjesaganang yang sosor ma byasan mi rung ba ltar byed mod/ lha sngags dang cho ga'i dngosagazhi la mi 'dra ba cang med pas/ 'dir gcig tu bsdom ste bshad par bya'o/ /skyabasa'agro semasabaskyed sngon du 'gro bas/rang gi snying gar zla ba'i steng du hrīḥde'i 'od kyis lus gang / lus 'od kyi gong bur gyur/ sdig sgrib sbyangs/ phyir 'phros te rang bzhin gyi gnas nas/ bla ma dang / rje btsun seng ge sgra 'khor bcas badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ na mo gu ru bh+yaḥ na mobhaṣ+ṭa ra ka sidha na de bh+yaḥ na maḥsarba bud+dha bo dhi sate bh+yaḥ o sidha na da sa pa ri wā ra arnya nas/ shap+ta pra tī ts+tsha swā hwa'i bar gyisamachod/ dkon mchog gsum la bdagaskyabs sogs lan gsum/ tshad med bzhi spyi dang mthun/shu n+ya tasastong par sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las pad+ma dmar po'i steng du/ ming las seng ge dkar po nyal stabs mgo g.yas su phyogs shing / gdong pa gyen du phyogs pa ral pa dmar ser thur du 'phyang zhing rin po che'i dra bas g.yogs pa'i steng du/ a las zla ba la hrīḥdakar po re las 'od 'phros/ 'phags pa mchod/ sems can gyi sdig sgrib sbyangs/'phags pa spyan ras gzigs kyi go 'phang la bkod/ tshur 'dus hrīḥthim pa yongs su gyur pa las rang nyid rje btsun seng ge sgra sku mdog dkar po zhal gcig phyag gnyisaphyag g.yas mchog sbyin gyi phyag rgya pus mogayas kyi steng du brkyang zhing / g.yon rgyab kyi char gdan la brten pa/ spyan gsum dang ldan zhing /ral pa'i thor tshugs can/ zhabs g.yon brkyang pa'i rgyal po rol pa'i stabs kyis zhugs pa/ rgyan spangs pa dka' thub kyi cha lugs can/ tshangasapa'i skushe pa dang ldan pa/ dar dmar po'i sham thabs dang / ri dwags nag po'i pags pas —261—

la bsam pa'i don kun stsol/ /sgrol ma de la phyag 'tshal bdud/ /bka' gdamasalha bzhi'i nang tshan du gyur pa/ sgrol ma'i sgrub thabasani/ skyabasa'agro semaspobaskyed sngon du bto / stong pa'i ngang las rang gi snying gar a las zla ba'i steng du tī ljang khu/ de'i 'od kyis lus gang /rnam smin brdos bcas dang sdig sgrib lhan cig tu sbyangs/ rang nyid sgrol ma'i skur gyur pa ni/ sku mdog ljang khu zhal gcig phyag gnyis g.yas mchog sbyin dang g.yon ut+pal sngon po'i rtsa ba bzung ba snyan gyi thad skar kha phye ba/ zhabs g.yas brkyang g.yon bskum pa'i skyil krung phyed pa'i rol pa'i bzhugs pa/ dar dang rin po che'i rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa/ pad zla'i gdan la bzhugs par gyur/ thugs gar zla ba la gnas pa'i tī/ de las 'od zer 'phros rje btsun ma 'phags ma sgrol ma ye shes sems dpa'i lha tshogos badz+ra sa mā dzaḥphyag dang mchod pa yid la bya zhing ngag nasami brjod/ 42PROB baṃ hoḥ gnyis su med par thim/spyi bor oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par āḥdamar po/ thugs skar hūṃ sngon po/ lha sku la semasartse gcig tu gtad la mnyam par bzhagabazlasapa ni/ tī gi mthar skor du yi ge bcu pas bskor bar bsgom la/ oṃ tā re tustu re tu re swāhā/ zhesapa dang / gzungasasngagasakyisabaskor ba gsal bto la/ na mo rat+na tra yā ya/ na mo ār+ya a wa lo ki te shwa rāya/bho dhi satwa ya/ mahā satā ya/ mahā ka ru ṇi kā ya/ tar+ya thā/ oṃ tā re tut+ta re sarba duṣ+ṭi/ pra dumi ma ma kṛ te/ dze+e bha ya/ s+t+waṃ bha ya/ mo ha ya/ ban+dha ya/ :྅ hūṃ/phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa/ sarba duṣ+ṭi sto bha ni tā re swāhā/ zhesapa'ang ci 'grub tu bzla/ thun 'ji/khar/ye shes pa mdun du bzhugs pa la/ arnya nasashap+ta'i bar gyisamachod/ 'dod don gsolab btab/ dge ba bsngo/ skyed muḥzhesagashegs su gsol/ rang dam tshig pa'i nga rgyal gyisaspyod lam —267

chen shrī'i gsung rgyun gyi man ngag khro phu bsamadzad pa dang / saskya paṇ+ḍi tasamadzad po gung sprosapa'i snying po ni/ skyabasasmos sngon du bto / rang gi snying gar zla ba la tī/ de'i 'od kyis 'phagasam sgrol ma la/ mchod 'osathams cad kyis bskor ba badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ 'phagasama'i dbu gtsugs tu bla ma rdo rje sems dpa'i rnam pa can du bzhugs par gyur/yid kyis mchod pa dpag tu med pa sprul/ dngos su nyer spyod lngas mchod/dkon mchoge gsum la bdag skyabs mchi/ /sogasalan gsum/ tshad med bzhi spyi dang mthun/ swa bhā wasasngagasa'adon dang / shā n+ya ta'i sngags 'don bsam/ pad zla la rang semasatī las ut+pal haṃ gis mtshan pa las 'od 'phros/ sems can gyi don byas/'dus yongs su gyur pa las/ rang nyid sgrol ma sku mdog ljang khu/ mchog sbyin/ut+pal can/ g.yas brkyang ba'i phyed krung gis bzhugs pa/ mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa'i thugs gar rang dang 'dra ba'i ye shes sems dpa'/de'i thugs gar ting nge 'dzin sems dpa' tī/ de nas ye shes sems dpa' spyan 'dren dang / dbang bskur rgyas btab spyi dang 'dra ste/ don yod grub pas dbu brgyan/ ye shes sems dpa' nam mkhar bzhugs pa la/ mchod bstod ma byasan/ skabasa'adir mchod bstod bya/ snying ga'i tī gi 'od zer gyis snod bcud thams cad rje btsun ma'i rnam par bsgyur/ 'od zer spro bsdu dang snang stong sgyu ma lta bu la mnyam par bzhagayi ge bcu pa do li'i bzlasapasabya'o/ /thun 'jogapa na mchod bstod kyi mthar/ badz+ra muḥ zhesabadag bskyed kyi ye shesapa gshegs/ dge ba bsngo zhing dam tshig pa'i nga rgyal gyis thun mtshamasal 'jug go /'di'i rjesaganang ni/ phal cher spyi dang 'dra ba las/ bum pa zhigabaca'/ mdun bskyed kyi mthar/—269

la dkar po'i yu ba thugasakar 'dzin zhing / snyan gyi thad gar kha bye ba/ bcu drug lon pa'i na tshod can/ dar dang rin po che'i rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa/'od zer dpag tu med pa 'phros pa'i sku can du gyur/ 'dab mabargyad la lusadang grib ma'i tshul du rang dang 'dra ba'i sgrol ma dkar mobargyad zhal nang du bstan pa/ 'khor gyi tshul can/ rang gi thugs gar a las zla ba la haṃ dkar po/ de las 'od zer 'phros/ ye shes sems dpa' badz+ra samā dzaḥ dzaḥrba hoḥsabon gyi mthar sngags kyisabaskor bar bsamasal/ skyed a ma ra ṇi dzi wan+tu ye swāhā/ zhesaci 'grubatu bzla/ 'khor thamasacad kyi sngags kyang bzlosapar bsam/ bcom ldan 'das ma sgrol mas bdag dang semasacan thamasacad kyi tshe'i bar chad zhi bar mdzad du gsol/ tshe dang bsod nams dang ye shes kyi tshogs 'phel bar mdzad du gsol/ cesagasol ba btab/ mi dmigasapa'i ngang nasadage ba bsngo/'di'i rjesaganang gi cho ga ni/ kha che paṇa chen nyid kyi lugasasgrol ma ljang khu'i rjesaganang nyid 'dod pa sposapasachogago/ /kun dang thun mong ma yin pa/ /paṇa chen bzhed tshul dgu' ba'i tog/sgrub thabasasnying po mdor bsdusa'adi/ tshe sgrub zab pa'i mthar thug lags/ /sgrol dkar kha che paṇa chen lugasakyi sgrub thabasakyi le tshan no// //mthile/ / ༄tsho/ /'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang dang / /sgrol ma zhi khro la gas nas/ /nyin zhi mtshan khro sgrub pa'i thabs/ /lag len ngag 'don gsal bor bkod/ /skyabasasems sngon du 'gro bas/ rang gi mdun du sdong po dang bcas pa'i pad gdan dang / zla ba lahrīḥlasa'aphags pa spyan ras gzigs sku mdog dkar po/ phyag g.yas mchog —271—

sbyin dang g.yon pad+ma dkar po'i sdong bu 'dzin pa/ pad+ma thugs gar kha phye ba'i steng du tī las rje btsun ma sgrol ma zhi ba/ rang nyid la dgyesapa'i spyan gyisagazigs pa/ puṣ+ṭi nas/ ni waṃ te'i bar gyisamachod/ gur nasa'abyung ba'i rgyun bzhags tshang gsum/ phyaga'atshal nyer gcig tshar gcigayid kyisagasol ba drag tu btab pas/ rje btsun ma ranganyid la thim/ rang nyid sgrol ma zhi ba ljang sngon/ g.yas mchog sbyin g.yon ut+pal sngon po 'dzin pa/ zhabasagayasabarkyang gi rol pas bzhugs shing / dar dang rin po ches brgyan pa/ dbu skaphyed g.yon par bcingasashing g.yas cung zad 'phyang ba/ spyibo na zla ba tshesapa'i steng du 'od dpag med kyisamatshan pa'o/ /bstod pa tshar gnyisabartan te/ rang nyid lhar gsal drag tu btab/ bstod sgrub tu byed na/ lha ladamigasanasaslar tshar lnga btan pasamadun du 'gyur la/ de nyid thun bzhi la sogasapar sgom pa ni mamatha' yin la/ bstod pa ji tsam mang ba de bzang ba yin no/ /bzlasapa la mosan man ngag ltar dmigasapa gsal btab la/ skye( tā re tustu re tu re swāhā/ zhesabazla'o/ /rjesaspyan rasagazigasal tshangabastod zhig byasal dge ba bsngo/ mtshan mo gzhan snga ma dang 'dra ba las/ pad+ma thugs mar kha phye ba'i steng du/ hūṃ las rje btsun ma sgrol ma khromo zhesapa dang / rje btsun ma bdagalathim pas/ rang nyid sgrol ma sku mdog dkar mo lhag par khrosapa spyan gsum skra ser gyen du brdzes pa/ phyag g.yas kyis rdo rje 'phyar zhing / g.yon sa la brdeb cing thugs gar sdigs mdzub mdzad pa/ stag lpagasakyi stod g.yogs dang /gzigs lpags kyi sha 'gag can/ rin po che'i rgyan dang sprul ljang khu'i se ral kha 'phyang ba/ spyibo na zla tshes kyi steng du 'od dpag med kyisamatshan pa/ tshedapung 'bar ba'i dbus na pad nyi la/ g.yas bskum g.yon brkyang bas—272

'phro 'du las/ rang nyid rje btsun ma 'phagasam sgrol ma sku mdog dmar mozhal bzhi phyag brgyad ma/ rtsa ba'i zhal dmar ba/ g.yas nag g.yon ljang / steng zhal ser ba/ spyan gsum gsum dang ldan pa/ phyag g.yas pa rnams kyis cang te/ thod khragaral gri/ rdo rje/ g.yon rnamasakyisa.ut+pa la/ nor bu/ kha ṭ+wāṃ gadrel bu bsnamasapa/ zhabasagayon brkyang ba'i gar stabs can/ thod skam gyi dbu rgyan/ thod rlon gyi do shal/ phyag rgya lnga rnamasakyis brgyan pa/ stag lpags kyi sham thabs can/ sgeg cing khro la skra ser gyen du brdzes pa/ me dpung gi dbus na bezhugasapa'o/ /spyibor bh+rūṃ dkar po/ masi par hrīḥdamar po/ snying gar hūṃ sngon po/ lte bar a ser po/brla gnyis la khaṃ ljang khu/ snying ga'i 'od zer gyis u rgyan gyi gnas nas/ rje btsun ma 'khor dang bcas pa badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ a: nas/ ni we ta'i bar gyisamachod/ dzaḥ/ baṃ hoḥ slar yang thugs ga'i 'od zer gyisarigs lnga badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ de bzhin gshegasapa thams cad kyis bdag la mngon par dbang bskur du gsol/ zhesagasol ba btab pas/ oṃ badz+ra u da gaḥ.a bhi ṣiñtsa hūṃ/ pu ra ta s+t+waṃ/ zhes gsung zhing dbang bskur/ nang gi dbang bzhi thob/ rgyal ba rigasalngasadabu brgyan/ chabadz+ra dha tī shwa rī a bhi ṣiñtsa hūṃ / oṃ satwa badz+ra a bhi ṣiñtsa bh+rūṃ/ oṃ rat+na badz+ra a bhi ṣiñtsa traṃ/ oṃ dharma badz+ra a bhi ṣiñtsa hrīḥ au rkarma badz+ra a bhi ṣiñtsa a/ denasabazlasapa'i dmigasapa gsal btab nas/ oṃ tā re tustu retu re hūṃ phaṭa ces ci 'grub bzla/ thun 'jugatu lha sku 'od gsal du ga'i ste dgeb bsngo/ gtor ma 'bul ba ni/ ga' ma bde mchog ltar byin gyisabarlabs/ rang gi snying ga nas 'od cizer 'phros/ u rgyan gyisaganas nas/ rje btsun ma 'khor dang bcas pa badz+ra sa mā —274

ba zhig bya/ de nasamaṇ+ḍal phul la rdzasabazhi po'i khebasabasal te/ mngon rtogasakyi dbang bskur gyi dmigasapa de phog la/ bum pa spyi bor bzhag cing / khrusakyang byar bcugabum dbang ngo / /nang mchod sbyin/gsang dbang gi brda'o/ /chosa'abyung bstan/ sher dbang gi brda'o/ /me long bstan te/ dbang bzhi pa'i brda'o/ /lhag ma rjesakyi bya ba ni spyi dang 'dra'o/ /kun lasakhyad 'phagasasgrub thabasa'adi/ /rab dga'i zhing mchog u rgyan nas/ /byung zhing mtshan yang de ltar grags/ /snying po'i sgrub thabasamado tsam spel/ /u rgyan sgrol ma gnasakyi dbang phyug ma'i sgrub thabasakyi le tshan no// //dge'o/ /sgrol ma/ mkha' 'grom rdo rje ldan ma/grub thob pa ra he ta/ bin te bha tra/ /gha ma shrī/ sgeg pa rdo rje/ shākya rdo rje/ mngon pa dbang phyugabartson 'grus/ 'phagasapa/ / ༄༅/ /chaswā sti/ gser mdog gser gyi 'od 'phro ba/ /nor sbyin nor gyi dbang mo'i tshul/ /sgrol mdzad 'phagasam sgrol ma la/ /bdag cag bdag don min par 'dud/ /skyabasasems sngon du 'gro bas/ rang sgrol mar gsal ba'i snying gar two/ de'i 'od kyis rje btsun ma 'khor bcas mdun gyi nam mkhar badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ arnya nas/ shap+ta'i bar gyisamadza/gur nasa'abyung ba'i rgyun bshagasadang / tshad med bzhi spyi dang mthun par bsgom/ swa bhā wa brjod pasade thams cad rang bzhin med par bsgom/ shā n+ya tā stong par sbyangs/ paṃ las pad+ma dang / a lasazla ba'i steng du bri las dpag bsam shing gi yal ga bri gis mtshan pa yongs su gyur pa las/ rang nyid sgrol ma yid bzhin nor bu sku mdog ser mo lang tsho la bab pa/ g.yon ngos su brten pa'i dpag bsam shing gi yal ga las phyag g.yon pasayid bzhin nor bu'i 'bras bu 'thog par mdzad cing / g.yas pas sems can la sbyin pa'i tshul gyisabasnamasapa/ pad zla'i gdan la sgeg —276

pa'i stabs kyis bzhengs pa/ dar dang rin po che'i rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa/ snying gar zla ba la bri/ dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs gar hūṃ/bri las 'od zer 'phros/ ye shes pa dbang gi lha dang bcas pa badz+ra sa mā dzaḥdzaḥ& baṃ hoḥ dbang gi lha rnamasakyis oṃ badzibha wa a bhi ṣiñtsa hūṃ zhes gsungs shing / dbang bskur/ rin chen 'byung ldan gyis dbu brgyan/ rang mtshungs kyi sku dpag tu med par sprul nas/ sems can rnams kyi dbul ba'i sdug bsngal zhi bar byas par bsamasal/ oṃ tā re tut+ta re tu re swāhā/ zhesabazla'o/ /'jug tu dgebabasngo zhing / oṃ muḥ zhesapas ye shes pa gshegs/ dam tshig pa'i nga rgyal gyisaspyod lam bya'o/ /mchod chog ni/ maṇ+ḍal gru bzhipa tshom bu can mchod gtor gtsang masabaskor ba zhig bsham/ba4sasbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las maṇ+ḍal 'byung bzhi'i dkyil 'khor la gnas pa'i ri rab lhun por gyur/ de'i steng du paṃ las pad+ma nas dbu brgyan kyi bar bdag bskyed bzhin lha mo bskyed/ mchod pa spyi dang mthun par byin gyis brlabs/ oṃ tā rotut+ta re tu re arnya pra tīts+tsha hūṃ swā hā/ de bzhi du shap+ta'i b.raduminasaphul/ sna tshogs chu skyes bsil zer can steng bri las byung ba'i lha moni/ /dpag med gzi ldan gzhon sgeg nyi ma'i 'od 'dra rgyan rnams kyis spras pa/ /nyes pa'i skyon spangs srid pa'i mtsho las 'gro ba sgrol zhing de'i re skong phyir/ /'phags ma sgrol ma yid bzhin nor bu zhes grags de yis sgrub po bdag skyongs shig/gas yang phyag 'tshal nyer stogasogasabastod pa ci shesakyisabastod/ oṃ tā re tustu re tu rodha nai tshede hi swāhā/ zhesagang 'osabazla zhing 'dod don gsol ba dragatu btab/ dha rna gi gnasasu dmigasagasal yod na de'i ming 'jugags ma ba4 sbyangs/ skad cig gis pad+ma'i dbyibs can rin po —277

dar dang rin po ches brgyan pa sems dpa'i skyil krung gis bzhugasapa'o/ /spyi bo dpral ba spyan dang mgrin/ /dpung pa snying ga lte ba gsang / /pus mo gnyisadang zhabs dag la/ /gsang sngags rgyal po yi ge bcu'i/ /yi ge re re bkod par bya/ shar du rdo rje sgrol ma nag mo/ lho ru rin chen sgrol ma ser mo/ /nub tu pad+ma sgrol ma dmar mo/ byang du sangs rgyas sgrol ma dkar mo rnams rigs bzhi'i phyag mtshan 'dzin pa/ me sogs mtshams bzhir me tog sgrol ma dkar mo/ bdug pa sgrol ma nag mo/ mar me sgrol ma ser mo/ dri'i sgrol ma dmar mo/de rnams zla ba la gnas shing / zhi ba'i nyams can no/ /shar sgor rdo rje lcags kyu ma nag mo/ lho sgor zhags pa ma ser mo/ nub sgor lcags sgrog ma dmar mo/byang sgor dril bu ma ser mo/ 'di rnams g.yasabarkyang gi nyi ma la gnas shing khro mo'i cha byad rdzogs pa'o/ /ye shes pa spyan 'dren dang / dbang bskur rgyas btab spyi dang 'dra ba las/ gtso mo la don grub pas dbu brgyan/ 'khor rnams la gtso mo nyid kyi ngo bor gyur pa rin po che re res dbu brgyan/ otā re tustu re tu re da nai me da da swāhā/ goci khrub bzla'o/ /snying ga'i 'od zer gyis snod bcud thamasacad dkyil 'khor gyi 'bor lor gyur/ de rnams 'od du zhu/ dkyil 'khor la thim/ dkyil 'khesar yang rang gi snying gar bsdu/ gtor ma bsangs sbyangs/ 'bru gsum gyisabyin gyisabarlabs/ mchod pa byin rlabasaspyi dang mthun/ rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros/ ye shes sems dpa' badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ ut+pa la'i phyag rgya bcas te/ a kā rolan bcu gcig gisaphul/ arnya nasashap+ta'i bar gyisamachod/ lha dang lha min sogs kyisabastod/'dod don gsol ba btab/ yig brgya bzod gsol sogasaspyi dang mthun pa'i mthar/ oṃ tā re tut+ta —281—

ra༅༅/ /skyesaswā sti/ dusagasum sangasargyasathamasacad kyi/ /thugasakyi gsang ba 'dzin pa yi/ khro rgyal gnod sbyin sde dpon tshul/ /de la btud nasasgrub thabasabashad/ /drag sngagasakyi che ba phyag na rdo rje.u tsar+ya'i sgrub thabs ni/ skyabasa'agro semasabaskyed spyi dang mthun/ rang gi spyi bor bla ma mi bskyod pa'i rnam pa can/ dpal ldan bla ma dam pas bdag la byin gyisabarlab tu gsol/ lan gsum/ bla ma 'od du zhu/ rang la thim/ chos thams cad stong par gyur/ oṃ swa bhā wa shud+dha sarba dharma swa bhā wa shuzlonyunya/ lan gsum brjod/ hūṃ stong pa'i ngang las rang sems hūṃ du gyur/ badz+ra hūṃ las gnam lcags kyi rdo rjer gyur/ oṃ badz+ra pā ṇi sa ma ya s+t+waṃ/ lan gsum/rdo rje yongs su gyur pa las/ rang nyid phyag na rdo rje sku mdog dus mtha'i sprin ltar gnag pa/ phyag g.yas gnam lcags kyi rdo rje rtse dgu pa 'phyar ba/ g.yon zhags pa dang bcas pa'i sdigs mdzub thugs ga'i thad nas gnod byed la sdigs pa/ spyan gsum me stag ltar 'bar ba/zhabs g.yas bskum g.yon brkyang bas klu 'bum/ gnyan khri/ sa bdag rjonge spungs pa'i steng du/ pad+ma zla ba nyi ma'i gdan la rnam par 'gying ba/ stag lpags kyi sham thabs dang / thod skam lnga'i dbu brgyan/ rlon pa lnga bcu'i do shal can/khrag gi thig le zhag gi zo ris/ thal chen gyi tshom bus brgyan pa/ rin po che dang rus pa'i rgyan dang / dar gyi stod g.yogs can/ sma ra smin ma dbu skra kham ser gyen du 'bar zhing / nor rgyas dung skyong ser pos dbu la brgyan pa/ dga' bo/ nyer dga' dmar po'i snyan cha/ pad+ma/ chu lha dkar po'i dpung brgyan dang /'dab bzang dang rigs ldan nag pos se ral kha byas pa/ zhal mche ba gtsigs shing ljags 'gril gshin rje ltar khros pa/ sku bong che bas zhabs rgya —289—

mtsho'i gling du sleb cing / dbus tshangs pa'i gnas rigs khyab pa/ zha'(nas drag sngags kyi sgra sgrog pa/ khyung chen rigs lnga pho nyar 'gyed pa/ ba spu'i bu ga nas khro bo'i tshogs spro zhing / khro bos gtams pa/ dug lnga sreg byed me dpung kha dog sna lnga pa'i klong na bzhugs pa'o/ /dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥthugs gar hūṃ/ de las 'od zer 'phros/ ye shes sems dpa' gsang bdag 'khor dang bcas pa badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ o sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shrī ye hūṃ/ zhes ye shes sems dpa'i bdag la dbang bskur/ sku gang / dri ma dgachu'i lhag ma yar lud pa las mibaskyod pas dbu brgyan/ dzaḥrba hotsho rang dang gnyis su med par thim/ thugs gar nyi ma'i dbus su hūṃ/ de las 'od 'phros/ sems can grol bar byas te bdag nyid la thim par gyur/ rdorje khu tshur kha sbyor bcings la/ rang gi lce rdo rje rtse mo dgu pa rwa re re la snying po'i sngags dang bcas pa/ snying gar yang rdo rje rtse dgu pa/ lte bar khro chung tshon gang ba/ de'i thugs gar nyi ma la gnas pa'i hūṃ gi mtha' skor du sngagasa'aphreng dmar pos bskor ba/ 〉las steng 'og tu raṃ gnyis gnyis spros/ spyi bo dang rkang mthil gnyis su gnas par gyur/ sngags kyi 'khor lo g.yasasu bskor ba las/ me'i tsha tsha spros rgya je cher steng 'og tu chad de/ lus kyi nang thams cad gang / raṃ gnyis pa las byung ba'i me dang lhan cig tu gyur/ stod kyi ye shes kyi me thur la 'bar zhing smad kyi me gyen la 'bar bas rang gi nad gdon sdig sgrib thams cad bsregs par gyur/ ma/hā roṣa ṇa e raṃ phaṭa/ lanagasum brjod/ ba spu'i rtsa bar gnas pa'i khro chung rnams kyis sngagasadi ri ri bzlas/ de rnams las khro —290

arnya swāhā/ nasashap+ta'i bar gyisamachod/ dril bu sogasarol mo'i sgra dang bcasapa'i bstod pa ni/gdug pa 'dul byed gnod sbyin rgyal/ /'dul dbang chen po sprul pa'i sku/ /'jigs byed chen po drag po ni/ /sku mdog mthing nag gosasngon can/ /phyag g.yas lcags kyi rdo rje bsnams/ /bgegasarig brgyad khri rdul du rlog/g.yon pa sdigs mdzub sdebargyad 'dul/ /nyi zla pad+ma la sogs dang / /klu 'bum khri stong gdan la bzhugs/ /sku zhal shin tu rgyas pa ste/ /sprul gyi chas kyis rnam par brgyan/ /stag lpags rlon pa'i sham thabs can/ /spyan gsum gdug pa can la gzir/ /'jig rten 'dul ba'i dbang phyug can/ /dregasapa 'joms pa'i stobs po che/ /'jig rten skyong ba'i thugasarje can/ khyod la bdag cag phyag 'tshal bstod/ /lcang locan gyi gnas mchog na/ /gsang bdag phyag na rdo rje ni/ /yon tan thams cad sku la rdzogs/ /skyon med sku la phyag 'tshal bstod/ sku'i ba spu'i khung bu las/ /bdun 'bum sum khri'i khro bo sprul/ /pho nya nyi zer rdul dang mtshungs/ /gsang ba'i bka' sdod rnams la bstod/ khyung chen thugs lasasprul pa ste/ /gsung gi phyag brnyan re ma tī/ /sku las mgon po nag po byung / /nang gi bka' sdod gsum la 'dud/ /bde gshegs mya ngan 'dus gyur kyang / /thugs rjes 'khor ba'i tshul 'dzin pa/ /phyogs skyong gtsang rigs bdun cu lnga/ /phyi'i las mkhan rnams la bstod/ /cesabastod/ gtor ma gsum pa/charabu 'theb kyur bcas pa'i gtor ma de/ a kā phaṭalan gsum gyisabyin gyisabarlabs/ lha srin sdebargyad gzhi bdag dang bcas pa badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ thams cad kyang phyag na rdo rje'i skur gyur/ na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta a ba lo ki te oṃ 6bha ra 6bha ra hūṃ/ lan bdun —293

rnams kyi lus la thim/ khyad par lcang locan gyi gnas nas/ gsang bdag phyag na rdo rje'i lha tshogs 'bor dang bcas pa spyan drangs/ slob dpon dang mdun bskyed kyi thugs ka nas kyang / phyag na rdo rje'i sku che ba ri rab tsam/ chung ba yungs 'bru tsam/ yang chung rdul phran tsam bsam gyis mi khyab pa byon/ de dag thams cad khyed rang rnams la sib sib thim par mos mdzod/ rtsegabarjod/ rol mo'i sgra drag tu bya zhing / snying po lan gsum drag sngags lan gcig gi mthar/ skyed badz+ra pā ṇi kā ya a dhiḥtiṣ+ṭha oṃ/ zhogabazlas/ de brtan par bya ba'i phyir/ bum pa'i chus dbang bskur bar yang mos pa gyis/ zhesabarjod la/ ji ltar bltams pa nas/ shrī ye hūṃ/dbang bskur/ sku gang / drim dgachu'i lhag ma yar lud pa las mi bskyod pas dbu brgyan/ cesabarjod cing bum chusadabang bskur ro/ /de ltar sku'i rjes gnang thob pas/lus kyi sdig sgrib sbyangs/ bar chad zhi lubashalha skur sgoms pa la dbang / gsang ba'i bdag po'i sku dang / rang gi lus dbyer med par gyur pa'i mos pa mdzod/cesabarjod/ de nas gsung gi rjes gnang la/ slob dpon dgongs su gsol/bdag la gsang ba'i bdag po phyag na rdo rje 'phags pasnga/ tsar+ya'i gsung gi rjes su gnang ba ma lus pa rtsal du gsol/ ngag gi sdig sgrib sbyang du gsol/ ngag nus pa dang ldan par byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ zhesalan gsum/ khyed rang rnamasagasang ba'i bdag po'i skur gsal ba'i snying gar gnas lcags kyi rdo rje rtse dgu pa'i lte ba sbubs stong du gnas pa'i nang du nyi ma la hūṃ mthing nagalce yang hūṃ las byung ba'i rdo rje rtse dgu par gyur/ mdun bskyed kyi thugs gar rdo rje'i lte bar nyi ma'i steng du/ dbusasu tumatha' skor du rtsa sngags g.yasaskor du bskor ba de'i —297—

slob ma 'di rnams kyi rgyud la gsang bdag phyag na rdo rje 'phags pa u tsar+ya'i gsung rigs sngags kyi nus mthu thamasacad thogs med du 'jug par gyur cigaslar yang bum pa'i chus sngar bzhin dbang bskur ba las/ chu lhag ma yar lud pa mi bskyod par gyur pa/ sngar gyi rigs bdag dang gnyisasu med par thim/zhesabarjod pani khyad par ro/ /de ltar gsung gi rjes su gnang ba thob pas ngag gi sdig sgrib sbyangs/ bar chad zhi/ ngag sngags bzla ba la dbang / gsang ba'i bdag po'i gsung dang rang gi ngag dbyer med du gyur par mos mdzod/ de nas thugasakyi rjes gnang la gsol btab ni/ thugs kyi rjes su gnang ba stsal du gsol/ yid kyi sdig sgrib sbyang du gsol/ yid ting nge 'dzin dang ldan par byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ zhesa'adon pa spo/ slob dpon la mos gus dung ba byas pagaslob dpon gyi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/ mdun bskyed dang / phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi thugs ka nas thugs gnyis su med pa'i ye shes rnams rdo rje rtse dgu pa dpag tu med pa'i rnam par spyan drangs/ khyed rang rnams kyi thugs ga'i hūṃ gi yi ge la gnyis su med par thim par mos mdzod/ cesabarjod la/ rol mo dang / sngagasakyi mthar/ oṃ badz+ra pā ṇi tsit+ta a dhi tiṣ+ṭha snyi zhesabazlas/ slar yang bum pa'i chusadabang bskur ba gsung gi rjesaganang bzhin/ de ltar thugs kyi rjes su gnang ba thob pas yid kyi sdig sgrib byang /bar chad zhi/ yid stong nyid sgom pa la dbang / gsang bdag gi thugs dang rang gi yid dbyer med du gyur par mosamadzod/ de nasagasto dbang ni/ gtor ma 'di nyid bcom ldan 'das phyag na rdo rje u tsar+ya dngos su mos/ de la mos gusadung —299

yan chad gang / tha mal ba'i lusadang sdig sgrib sbyangs nas/ rang nyid phyag na rdo rjer gyur pa ni/ pad+madang nyi ma'i gdan la g.yas bskum g.yon brkyang gi stabasakyis bzhengs pa/ sku mdog sngon po/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis g.yasardo rje rtse lnga nam mkha' la 'phyar ba/ g.yon sdigasamadzub thugasakar mdzad pa/ dmar la zlum pa'i spyan gsum dang ldan zhing / skra ser gyen du brdzes pa/ klu chen po brgyad dang / rin po ches brgyan zhing / stag lpags kyi sham thabs can/ mi bskyod pasadabubargyan zhing / ye shesakyi me dpung 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa'o bzlasapa bya bar 'dod pas/ snying gi nang du nyi ma'i steng du/ hūṃ gi mtha' skoradu sngags kyi 'phreng bas bskor bar dmigasal/ sngags bzlas pa de las 'od 'phros/ rang gi sdig sgrib sbyang / bgegs rnamasabacom/ 'phags pa cimachod/sems can gyi don byas/ byin rlabasathams cad tshur 'dus te/ sa bon sngags 'phreng dang bcas pa la thim par bsam la/ oṃ ni le ba ra dha ra badz+ra pā ṇi ra dz+nyā pa ya ti swāhā/ zhesa'abum phrag bco brgyad bzlas so/ /'jug dge ba byang chub tu bsngo/ gtor ma dkar gasto ba4sa sbyangs/ oṃ lasarin po che'i snod du/ āḥlha'i bdud rtsi/ dbusasu hūṃ las ye shes kyi bdud rtsir gyur/ oṃ āḥshu lanagasum brjod/ rang gi snying ga'i hūṃ lasa'od zer 'phros pas/ gsang ba'i bdag po phyag na rdo rje la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs phyogasaskyong 'jig rten skyong ba dang bcas pa thamasacad kyisabaskor ba badz+ra samā dzaḥ pad+ma ka mal ye s+t+waṃ/ oṃ nīlo nas/ ba ya ti sa pā ri wā ra i rda bā ling kha kha khā hi khā hi swāhā/ lanagasum gyisaphul/ nyer spyod lngasamachod/ 'jigasapa'i hūṃ sgra ngesasgrog cing / /sogasakyisabastod/ 'dod—304—

ma/ dpungapa g.yas par mar me khyung dmar po mar me/ ya/ g.yon par dri chab kyi khyung ljang mo dri chab/ a/ brang gzhol du gnod sbyin gdul ba'i khyung sngon posaral gri/ swa/ sog phrag tu gshin rje 'dul ba'i khyung be con/ hrī: lte'og tu klu 'dul ba'i khyung dmar po lcags sgroganyu/ tshang rar dri za 'dul ba'i khyung ljang khu rdo rje/ dzaḥ sna la lcags kyu'i khyung dkar po/ hūṃ/ kha la zhagasapa'i khyung ser po/ baṃ/ gsang bar lcags sgrog gi khyung dmar po/ ho/ bshang sgor dril bu'i khyung sngo sangs/ thams cad kyang phyag g.yon pas rang mdog dang mtshungs pa'i sprul bzung nas zhal du gsol ba'o/ /oṃ āḥ&/ sa ma ya s+t+waṃ/ spyibo nas snying ga'i bar sprul pa'i bya khyung zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa rnams dang /oṃ āḥgyi sa rmā ya dzaḥ de nasalte ba'i bar yang sprul gyi khyung zhal gcig phyag bzhi pa rnams dang / oṃ urnyisne/ sa ma ya āḥ de nas rkang mthil bar nying sprul gyi khyung zhal gcig phyag drug pa dang / oṃ āḥ/ sa ma ya ho/ spyi bo nasarkang mthil gyi bar phyi nang thams cad du bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i khyung dbu dgu pa la sogs pa dbu phyag ma nges pa rnams kyisagang bar gyur/ rnam sprul gyi khyung de rnams thams cad sku mdog dang phyag mtshan sna tshogasapa'o/ /oṃ badz+ra dz+wa la raṃ/bdag lus dang khyung thams cad lasatshedapung 'bar bar gyur/ rang gisnying gar pad nyi la hūṃ sngags kyi 'phreng bas bskor ba/ de las 'od 'phros/ ye shesasems dpa' badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ dzaḥrba hoḥ yang 'od 'phros dbang gi lha badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ puṅge nas/ni waṃ te'i bar gyisamachod/ oṃ a bhi ṣiñtsa hu me sarba ta thā ga ta/ lkogasol ba btab pas/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya 〈ye hūṃ/ zhes gasdang—307

kun thar mchog la 'god shog/cesapa ni skyesamachogarasachung pa'i thugasakyi nying khu phyagardor gong khug ma gtum chung me 'bar ma'am/ khra thogasakyi mngon rtogasabla ma'i gsung lasabyung ba ltar bkod pa'i le tshan no// //dar rgyasa'aphel/ /༄tsho/ /phyag rdor gtum chung dmar po'i sgrub thabs/skyed swā sti/ sku lasadu ma'i 'phrul pa 'chang / /yan lagadrug cu'i gsang ba can/ /ma rung thamasacad mthar mdzad pa/ /phyag na rdo rjesabadag skyongs shig/skyabasasemasasngon du 'gro bas/ stong par bsgom/ stong pa'i ngang las pad+ma dang zla ba la rang semasa3 dmar po yongs su gyur pa las/ rang nyid phyag na rdo rje sku mdog dmar po/ g.yas rdo rje nag po rtse lnga pa 'phyar ba/ g.yon thugs gar zhags pa 'dzin pa/ stag sham dang / dar gyi sham thabs can/ rin po che dang sprul gyis brgyan pa/ mibaskyod pas dbu brgyan zhing / khrobo'i rgyan dang / cha lugasayongs su rdzogasapa/ me dpung 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa/ snying gar rang 'dra'i ye shes sems dpa' nag po de'i thugs gar ting nge 'dzin sems dpa'/ rdo rje'i lte bar hūṃ/ de lasa'od zer 'phros/ gsang bdag mthing ga'i lha tshogs badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ dzaḥ&2 hoḥganyisasu med par them pas/ rang nyid sku mdog dmar mthing du gyur/ rang gi phrag gong g.yas su sī khyung nag po dang / g.yon du gshog pa g.yu mdog can/gnyisakar sprul za kur bsgoms la/ rang 'dra'i 'khor dpag tu med pasabaskor bar bsam/ rmo badz+ra pā ṇi hūṃ phaṭa/ tsesasamasathamasacad sngagasakyi sgrasadi riri—3/34

mchi/ /sogs lan gsum/ tshogs zhing gi thugasaka nas 'od zer byung / rang gi tshangasabug nas zhugs/ 'khor ba thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i sdig sgrib thamasacad sbyangs/ rang nyid lha'i sku dwangs shing gsal ba 'od kyi rang bzhin du gyur/ rang gi snying ga'i hūṃ lasa'od zer phar 'phros te/ gtso bo'i thugs gar rega'od kyi lam de la brgyud nas/ rang nyid gtso bo'i thugs gar thim/ bdag gis dge ba'i rtsa ba des sems can thams cad sangasargyasakyi go 'phang myur du thob par gyur ciganya shā n+ya ta dz+nyā na badz+ra swa bhā wa at+pa ko3nya/ snod kyi 'jig rten 'od du zhu/ bcud kyi sems can la thim/ de rnams tshogs zhing gi lha tshogs la thim/ de rnams rang la thim/ de hūṃ la thim/ hūṃ yang nā da'i bar du bsdus te/ nā da yang mi dmigasapa stong pa nyid du gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las paṃ las pad+ma dang raṃ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hūṃ las sna tshogs rdo rje'i lte ba la hūṃ gisamatshan pa las 'od 'phros/ rdo rje'i sa gzhi/ rwa ba dra ba/ gur bla bre/ bsrung ba'i 'khor lo'i dbus su/ paṃ lasasna tshogasapad+ma dang / a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hūṃ mthing nag las 'od 'phros/ snod thams cad gzhal yasakhang dang / bcud thams cad phyag na rdorje'i skur gyur/ tshur 'dusayongasasu gyur pa las rdo rje nag po rtse lnga pa la hūṃ mthing nag gisamatshan pa/ de lasakyang 'od 'phros 'dus yongs su gyur pa lasarang nyid phyag na rdo rje'i sku mdog mthing nag zhal gcig phyag gnyisadamar la zlum pa'i spyan gsum dang ldan pa/khro zhing dregs pa bcu drug 'on pa'i lang tsho can/ zhal mtsheb gtsigs shing bzhad pa/ dbu skra kham pa gyen du brdzesapa/ rdo rje cod pan can/ sma ra dang /—315

smin ma rab tu 'bar ba/ spyan g.yas zla ba/ g.yon nyi ma/ dbus me'i rang bzhin can/ phyag g.yasardo rje rtse lnga 'phyar ba'i stabs dang / g.yon thugasakar sdigasamadzub gnod byed thamasacad la sdigs pa/ zhabs g.yas bskum g.yon brkyang ba'i stabs kyis bzhugs shing stag lpags kyi sham thabs dang / dar sngon po'i stod g.yogs can/ rin po tshere cod pan dang / klu wo po brgyad kyis brgyan pa ye shesakyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa'i skur gyur/ dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs skar hūṃ/ thugs ga'i hūṃ las 'od zer 'phros/ye shes sems dpa' sangs rgyasabyang chub sems dpa'i 'khor dang bcas pa badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ gong bzhin phyag 'tshal dang / mchod bstod bya/ dzaḥ& baṃ hoḥrgenyis su med par thim/ slar yang thugs ga'i hūṃ las 'od zer 'phros/ dbang gi lha badz+ra samā dzaḥ gong bzhi mardzo bstod byasal/ byang chub rdo rje sangs rgyas la/ /mchod chen ji ltar stsal pa ltar/ /bdag kyang rab tu bsgral slad du/ /nam mkha'i rdo rje deng bdag stsol/ /zhes gsol ba btab pas/ dbang golha rnamasakyis/ ji ltar bltams pa tsam gyis ni/ /lha rnams kyis ni khrus gsol ltar/ /lha yi chu ni dag pa yis/ /de bzhin bdag gis dbang bskur ro/ /zhes gsung zhing / bum pa'i chus spyi bo nas dbang bskur/ sku gang / dri ma dgachu lhag ma yar lud pa lasami bskyod pas dbu brgyan/ arnya nasashap+ta'i bar gyisagong skusko mchod/ bcom ldan phyag na rdo rje ni/ /sku mchog 'bar ba'i 'od zer can/ /gdug pa thams cad 'dul mdzad pa/ /rdo rje bsnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bcom ldan phyag na rdorje ni/ /gsung mchog 'bar ba'i 'od zer can/ /ngag gi 316— —
